desc: Ghostship Aftermath takes survival horror to a new level with random events and multiple story-lines. Your survival skills will be put to the test on a huge open-world military spacecraft with limited light and oxygen as you struggle to discover what happened, and fight to stay alive!

title: PC Virtual LAB
desc: PC Virtual Lab is a video game to improve learning in basic computer concepts.

title: The Shore VR
desc: The Shore VR is a first-person story-driven game with an atmospheric environment and narrations. You will play the role of a man who ends up on a mysterious island. Strong elements of Lovecraftian horror, struggle to survive in an unknown world.

title: Atlantis VR
desc: Enter the underwater world thriving with life! Let the aquatic beings guide you trough the mystery deeps and explore nooks and crannies of beautiful ocean landscape!

title: Home Legacy
desc: Free-to-Play social Virtual World: a theme park featuring fun people and fun things: plenty of games, rides and amusements, as well as advanced social interactions.

title: Montas
desc: Montas is a first person survival horror adventure that focuses heavily on exploration, immersion, atmosphere, story and interactivity. The player is cast into a dark and mysterious world with little introduction, and must do what is necessary to survive on a twisted ride full of intrigue and drama.

title: World of Guns: VR
desc: World of Guns: VR lets you delve into the inner workings of guns from the largest gears to the smallest screws now in VR

title: Prey: Typhon Hunter
desc: Вам предстоит сбежать с секретной лунной базы «Транстар». Шансы не в вашу пользу — к тому же при каждом новом прохождении опасности, с которыми вам придется столкнуться, задачи, которые предстоит выполнить, и предметы, увеличивающие ваши шансы на выживание, будут другими.

title: The Gleam: VR Escape the Room
desc: The Gleam is an escape the room game for the HTC Vive. Solve puzzles, decipher code, and unravel the mysteries of the "gleam" in order to escape from this claustrophobic hell.

title: Silent North
desc: Silent North thrusts you into the Swiss Alps, battling the elements, Infected, and other players. Fight solo or team up, scavenging gear and essentials. Intense PVPVE action ensures constant danger. Adapt, be resilient, and survive in this unpredictable, ever-changing landscape

title: Employee Recycling Center
desc: Abandoned by your co-workers after a terrible accident in the factory, you are trapped. Interact with your environment, solve puzzles and unlock up to 500 achievements in this new adventure for PC and Virtual Reality Headsets.

title: Police Enforcement VR : 1-King-27
desc: Police Simulator Built From The Ground Up For Virtual Reality!

title: ChefU
desc: Built exclusively for VR, ChefU puts you in your dream kitchen where you never have to wash dishes or clean up after yourself. Hone your cooking and knife skills with over 60 items to cook and dozens of cooking tools. Leave the mess for someone else to clean up.

title: Gambit!
desc: Gun up and wreak havoc in Gambit! – a 4-player campaign-driven shooter-adventure in a world of gangs, guns, and mayhem.

title: The Martian VR Experience
desc: Погрузившись в виртуальную реальность «Марсианин» от продюсера Ридли Скотта и режиссера Роберта Стромберга, вы побываете на красной планете и испытаете то же, что и астронавт Марк Уотни.

title: Klepto
desc: Welcome to Klepto where there's no place like a burglarized home. In this burglary simulation you'll explore, terrorize and loot your way to success in a variety of open-world sandbox neighborhoods. **VR is NOT required for this game.

title: Chamber Survival
desc: From a first person perspective, escape this terrifying room.

title: Orlando Theme Park VR - Roller Coaster and Rides
desc: Welcome to Orlando Theme Park VR! Are your palms sweaty already? Are you brave enough to face all toys and rides? Yes, this is a VR experience like you have never seen before!

title: #Archery
desc: #Archery brings out your inner archer in a way you have never seen before! Make pizzas, sell ice cream, deliver newspapers and much more - all with bow&arrow like there is no tomorrow!

title: (VR)西汉帝陵 The Han Dynasty Imperial Mausoleums
desc: Entering emperor mausoleum of West Han Dynasty of thousands of years, feeling the magnificence and stories of the tomb owner.

title: .redruM
desc: .redruM психологический хоррор, сочетающий в себе реализм и визуальные эксперименты. Вдохновленный пограничьем и заброшенными пространствами, а также реальными местами преступлений, вы играете за фотографа, который раскрывает личность убийцы. Это красная комната, где проявляются зловещие фотографии.
A simple puzzle game. Place 3D blocks in virtual reality and clear lines to earn points. How high of a score can you earn?

title: 2076 - Midway Multiverse
desc: Paying homage to classic side-scrolling shooters, 2076 offers the ultimate space combat simulation experience combining the genre's classic gameplay with new and original mechanics that only VR can offer: hit, grab, drag, push, etc. Enjoy a classic retro VR experience in a totally innovative way!

title: 22 Racing Series | RTS-Racing
desc: 22RS is the fastest physics-based racing game on Steam, while also pushing the boundaries of traditional racing design with it's competitive RTS mechanics. If you like racing really fast, challenging yourself and exploring new game designs - Then this could be the game for you.

title: 2MD:VR Football Unleashed ALL✰STAR
desc: 2MD: VR Football Unleashed ALL✰STAR is the massive sequel to the groundbreaking motion-controlled VR football game, 2MD: Vr Football. Draw the plays and throw, hand-off, catch, and run the ball before the clock runs out!

title: 3D Joys
desc: 3D Joys is a Memory game in VR

title: 7D Game （VR for VIVE）
desc: It's a game player could use voxels to create different WORLDs. It's a virtual reality game on SteamVR(HTC VIVE). Though the game is highly inspired by such great games like Minecraft and Besiege, it's specially designed for VR equipment, in which there are a fully developed physical system and more importantly an open-source product...

title: A Clever Label
desc: A documentary experience that explores the links between anti-LGBTQI lobbyists, politicians and organisations.

title: A Handful of Keflings
desc: The Keflings need your help! Visit a magical realm and lend the tiny Keflings a hand. Start by building a single home and work towards creating a thriving bastion of culture sure to be the envy of cultural bastions everywhere!

title: A Lost Room
desc: A Lost Room is an escape game without the boundaries of real world, powered by VR. In a place where anything can happen, what will you do to escape this huge complex alive?

title: A Show of Kindness
desc: A Show of Kindness is a three-act VR experience through which the user navigates an unfolding story frozen in time, crafted with meticulous detail by concept artist Peter Chan using a custom build of Tilt Brush.

title: A Story of Distress
desc: You and your brother set off to the big city of Aston in order to become successful merchants, but things go wrong when your brother gets murdered, filling your heart with pure rage. Take your vengeance on those who defied you. Use stealth to your advantage and try not to get consumed by rage.

title: A Ton Of Feathers
desc: an infrarealist kaleidoscope of storie mysterie and music.

title: A Very Bad Christmas Eve
desc: Could you save Christmas if you are the only Elf Santa Claus can count on? Challenge yourself in the single-player action-adventure puzzle game A Very Bad Christmas Eve tailor-made for the VR platform.

title: A Wake Inn
desc: Put your VR goggles on to explore dark corridors of an abandoned hotel using realistically controlled wheelchair, and face strange army of living dolls. But you won't be alone - mysterious voice will accompany you via shortwave transmitter. Just make sure, who really pulls the strings in this world.

title: A Writer And His Daughter
desc: VR story exploration game. A young girl discovers a magical fairy tale world and has to decide which world she wants to stay in. Part one of a trilogy.

title: A-Escape VR
desc: A-Escape is an escape room game built from the ground up for VR. Will you escape in time?

title: Abduction Prologue: The Story Of Jonathan Blake
desc: In this survival horror game, play as Jonathan Blake who is awaken at night to find that he is not alone. Work your way through the apartment and try to survive your attempted ABDUCTION.

title: Absolute Territory
desc: Fly futuristic starfighters with intense dogfights against slow warships and nimble enemy fighters. Choose your ship, customize loadouts with various guns and missiles. Use first-person cockpit or third person. Use power settings across engines, shields, and weapons to gain the advantage in combat.

title: AccuBow VR
desc: Take your archery training to the next level and practice anytime, anywhere

title: AcidPunk : Echoes of Doll City
desc: ACIDPUNK will immerse you deep into the dystopian metropolis of Doll City . Embark on a VR journey to a dark and psychedelic cyberpunk universe. Experience vibrant and trippy visuals while listening to a carefuly crafted soundtrack taking its inspiration from synthwave and psychedelic rock classics.

title: Across The Line
desc: Across the Line is an immersive virtual reality experience that combines 360°video and computer generated imaging (CGI) to put viewers in the shoes of a patient entering a health center for a safe and legal abortion.

title: Across the Valley
desc: Across the Valley is your friendly VR farm where you really lend a hand. Instead of clicking around in menus, you care for the animals and plants with your own hands. Instead of looking at the farm from up above, you yourself can relax in this hand-drawn paradise.

title: Adagio
desc: A short VR experience, Adagio places the viewer in a dreamy, Celtic landscape in the brief moment of darkness right before dawn. Are they alone or accompanied? Some say that as dawn breaks, you can witness ghosts tasting the morning dew.

title: Adapt or Perish
desc: This is more than just an odd looking strategy game, it is a strategy platform. Genetically engineer amorphic creatures & buildings, in real time, in an endlessly open world that adapts to your playstyle. Share, and even battle your designs. How much will they be worth?

title: Aeronaut
desc: Aeronaut is an interactive VR music video centered around the lead singer of Smashing Pumpkins, Billy Corgan.

title: Aery VR - Calm Mind
desc: Aery - Calm Mind is an interactive game experience that is designed to relax your mind and soul. Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

title: Aery VR - Little Bird Adventure
desc: Aery is a peaceful exploration game from the perspective of a little bird who decided to discover the world. Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

title: AESCULAP® OrthoPilot®Elite VR Palpation
desc: Assume the role of a surgeon during this gamified knee replacement surgery minigame in VR.

title: Aeternum Infecti
desc: Aeternum Infecti is a third-person, truly terrifying open-world survival game set in a haunting post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge cities and wilderness for food, medicine, and weapons while evading relentless infected. Explore a vast, desolate land where silence is deadly and survival is everything.

title: Age of Heroes (VR)
desc: “Age of Heroes” is a multiplayer combat VR game that emphasizes physical and intense boss battles. Pick up your weapons, choose your classes (Mage, Archer, Warlock, Priest), team up with other players, and banish evil demons to protect the world!

title: Age of ilcoin VR : Retribution
desc: Age of ILCoin Retribution is a virtual reality game set in a futuristic sci-fi action setting where the ultimate treasure is ILCoins (ILCs). You will become “The Miner” and your mission will be to earn and protect your coins from the space aliens pirates.

title: Agence
desc: Agence places the fate of artificially intelligent creatures in your hands. Will you help to maintain their peaceful existence, or throw them into a state of chaos? A dynamic film that merges cinematic storytelling, artificial intelligence, and user interactivity, Agence is never the same twice.

title: Ahros: One Warrior Chronicle
desc: Ахрос: Хроника одного воина - это приключенческая VR-игра, в которой вы можете летать на драконе и стрелять из больших и очень больших пушек проходя путь молодого воина, которому предстоит восстановить мир и порядок на землях, выжженных глобальной войной.

title: AHTS Ship Simulator
desc: Captain, command a 3000 ton anchor handling and tug supply (AHTS) vessel and navigate it in high seas to a nearby oil rig. You control it with powerful main engines and side thrusters. Two outside water cannons help against a UFO with a tractor beam and fires that make your mission difficult.

title: AI Rebellion VR
desc: Первый космический симулятор с поддержкой контроллеров Oculus Touch и HTC Vive. Когда военная космическая база под управлением искусственного интеллекта съезжает с катушек, не остается ничего другого, кроме как отправить одного из лучших межгалактических пилотов спасти положение и решить проблему.

title: Aim Assault
desc: Aim Assault brings the thrill of old-school arcade rail-shooters into the world of virtual reality. Blast through various enemies, master different gunplay styles, and race the timer to climb to the top of the global leaderboards.

title: Air Raid Over Britain
desc: Air Raid Over Britain (technical demo) places you in the heart of a small English town during the "The Blitz" (1940-1941). Uncover facts about WWII and experience an actual air raid by German HE-111s.

title: Air Traffic BLITZ VR
desc: Control aircraft around airports inspired by real locations while avoiding disastrous collisions.

title: AIR WARS
desc: AIR WARS is flight simulation game created with the history of air war. Board the aircraft that was actually used and feel the excitement of becoming a hero in history!

title: Airline Flight Attendant Simulator VR
desc: This is a consumer version of the professional VR training software developed by AVIAR and used by airlines and flight schools to train future cabin crew members. It's all there - insanely realistic virtual aircraft, equipment, gravity effects, sounds, and intense emergency situations scenarios.

title: Akpala
desc: Don't you want to play a magical battle, chanting magic with your voice in VR space? A thrilling action game that offers three new experiences like never before has arrived! Multiplayer VR game for up to 4 players, featuring 2v2 team battles and a battle royale mode.

title: ALaLa: Wake Mi Up!
desc: "Wake Mi UP!" is a VR party game which could be played by four people in maximum. There's a sleepy cat called ALaLa who has a magical power bringing everyone into her dream when she falls asleep. This time, it's a HIDE AND SEEK dream in the playing room! Now, let's protect ALaLa's dream!

title: Alcatraz: VR Escape Room
desc: "Alcatraz: VR Escape Room" is a story based puzzle game inspired by such classics as Crimson Room. You discover bits and pieces about your life from notes left behind from someone who is trying to help you escape.

title: Alexandria - Port of Worlds
desc: Cannes XR and NewImages Festival are proud to announce the launch of Alexandria, a new futuristic virtual world showcasing the best of international VR creation and designed to host immersive events throughout the year! 🕶️🌐🕶️

title: Alien Abduction Experience
desc: This is a deep immersion VR short play. Refer to the personal experience of many alien abductors in history, which will bring you unprecedented visual impact, and experience the experience of alien abduction. There is no complicated operation, you just need to take VR equipment and immerse in it.

title: Alien Abduction Experience PC HD
desc: This is a deep immersion VR short play. Refer to the personal experience of many alien abductors in history, which will bring you unprecedented visual impact, and experience the experience of alien abduction.You need to open the game or bring a VR device to immerse yourself

title: Alien Extraction
desc: Control an alien infested space station in this lighthearted VR simulation game. Guide Lenny the janitor through deadly and dangerous levels: sneak, burn, distract, pilot, blast and clean his way to safety. Check cameras, pilot drones and control the facility from the comfort of your security desk!

title: AliveInVR
desc: Control Ableton Live from VR. Ever wanted to use a giant Push or Launchpad from within VR? AliveInVR controls Ableton Live allowing you to trigger clips, play instruments and mix with a giant 3D Controllerist interface in VR.

title: All On Board!
desc: Built for board game lovers, All On Board! brings back the magic of game nights to VR. Enjoy adapted versions of your favorite titles with friends, lifelike physics, and thoughtful design that make every match feel real, like gathering around a table wherever you are.

title: Alone In The Forest VR
desc: Explore the forest, solve the puzzles, start the generators and call for help. Use the flashlight to defend yourself from the 'thing' that tries to kill you.

title: ALONE? - VR
desc: Immerse yourself in a true VR Horror game. Explore and experience a fully immersive world as you embark on an ghostly adventure unlike anything you have played before. Come face-to-face with terror itself as you look for your missing sister.

title: Alpine Ski VR
desc: Alpine Ski VR by Suchworks Studios brings the thrill of skiing to your desktop. There are three different game types: Slalom, Freestyle and Heliski. Beat the splits on the 6 slalom levels, pull some tricks on the 6 freestyle levels, or cruise around the 100km2 offpiste; complete with your own helicopter!

title: Altered Algorithm
desc: Altered Algorithm is an action-thriller VR experience blending the craft of film and games in a new way. In this story-driven game set in a futuristic 1983 LA, your playground will be detective work, head-to-head combat, and the ability to DYNAMICALLY interact with full motion video characters.

title: Alvo VR
desc: A high‑octane multiplayer shooter built for players who want speed, strategy, and seamless cross‑platform action. Alvo delivers fast, addictive VR firefights with tight controls, competitive modes, and intense close‑quarters combat that keeps you jumping back in.

title: Amazing Thailand VR Experience
desc: Discover Thailand through advance and interactive presentation, and learn more about Thai culture that you will fall in love with.

title: Amber Alert TOTAL VR
desc: Step into the shoes of a policeman in "Amber Alert TOTAL VR," a difficult VR horror game. Responding to a late-night call, you find a sinister cult of women abductors. Your mission: rescue a captive girl. Navigate perilous streets, evade cult members, and survive.

title: Amends VR
desc: A journey through the reflections of an upbringing with a now estranged mother.

title: Anandala
desc: Anandala is a virtual reality art experience where you explore a vast labyrinth of ever-changing, psychoactive abstract art and interact with curious and expressive artificial-life creatures.

title: Anceder
desc: Dive in the VR arcade shoot-them-up (shmup, shoot'em up, bullet hell). A lot of action is awaiting you. "Insert coin" and jump in the shmup !

title: Ancient Amuletor VR
desc: Ancient Amuletor VR is an action tower defense game that throws you into the ancient world to battle magical creatures, monsters and other legendary foes in single-player and cooperative multiplayer for up to three players.

title: Ancient Journey VR
desc: It is the first museum in the world from where you can set out for a trip to ancient times. It's the only occasion to admire ancient buildings, search through Egyptian temples, see under your eyes the beauty of Japan and feel the atmosphere of ancient temple in India.

title: Ancient VR coaster
desc: Ancient VR Coaster will take you on your very own private roller-coaster, an unique experience!

title: ANDERSON
desc: ANDERSON is a story-driven VR game inspired by classic point & click adventures. Experience a world of science and mystery, with the assistance of a peculiar simulated personality.

title: Andromedum
desc: Andromedum is a VR novel with stereoscopic environments and audio narration. HTC Vive motion controllers are required!

title: Angels of Amsterdam
desc: Angels of Amsterdam; a truthful recreation of a 17th century Amsterdam-café, where you share key episodes in the lives of Maritgen Jans, Juliana, Elsje Christiaens and Pussy Sweet: four fierce angels who were not getting their fair share of the Golden Age’s gold and took destiny in their own hands.

title: Angelus Brand VR Experience
desc: Enjoy the Angelus Brand VR Experience with a few games and a show room. Look at Angelus products while playing basketball or running through a challenging dodging game. Try to get the high score on both games for bragging rights!

title: Anima
desc: Anima by Vivia, a virtual reality music video experience.

title: Animal Planet: Amazon Odyssey
desc: Go on an incredible journey in Animal Planet: Amazon Odyssey an experience that will keep the childhood joy and wonder of animals alive by bringing people up close in every way. You will parachute into the jungle and make camp, before exploring the river and paragliding over massive cataracts.

title: Anime Girls VR
desc: Meet kind anime girls and dance with them to the cool songs. All this inside anime styled locations! Anime Girls VR will let you feel presence of characters like they would be next to you. Prepare for the great effort if you want to keep up with the girls!

title: Anime show 动漫时装秀
desc: двенадцать сексуальных девушек конкурируют между собой. Стань участником жюри развлекательного шоу и голосуй за девушек. Выбери, чья мечта стать победительницей в номинации Miss Anime Fashion исполнится.

title: Antarctic Adventure
desc: Experience Antarctic science at first-hand! A unique way of understanding why scientific research is so important to understand the planet we live in.

title: Antarctic Heritage Trust
desc: Step inside Sir Edmund Hillary’s Antarctic hut.

title: Anti Gravity Warriors VR
desc: Fight alien space robots and mutant monsters in this immersive, Sci-Fi, zero gravity environment. Battle to the death in this vr game!

title: Antiprism
desc: Antiprism brings classic shoot 'em up mechanics to VR and combines them with innovative single-player twin-ship gameplay. Control two ships at once as the pilots Jexen and Malik shoot hordes of enemies, dodge enemy fire, find and upgrade items, and beat hard bosses on their journey through The Gone.

title: Aonar
desc: This is an immersive cinematic storytelling experience based on Scottish folklore. Become a part of the lighthouse keeper's story, and take a journey with him on the Scottish Isles. This is an exploratory application.

title: Ape Hit
desc: What happens when it’s your first day on the job, your boss is an angry ape and there is no operator's manual? Embrace the chaos... go Ape Hit!

title: Apex
desc: The stunning new experience from the brilliant imagination of artist and musician Arjan van Meerten, Apex delivers a surrealistic and darkly beautiful apocalyptic vision set to an original score in the anticipated follow up to Van Meerten's Surge.

title: Apocalypse Mechanism
desc: The Angel descends，cleaning of human. For survival，human became giants too in our armor, Soul Force its beating heart. The last war shall begin.

title: Aquarist VR
desc: Получите лучший аквариумный магазин в городе! Создавайте, обновляйте, управляйте, наблюдайте. Посмотрите, сможете ли вы создать аквариумную империю.

title: Aquila Bird Flight Simulator
desc: Have you dreamed of what it would be ... to soar like an eagle? Aquila Bird Flight Simulator lets you experience soaring bird flight using a virtual reality headset. This is a soaring simulation, so you can make use of ridge lift and thermals like any other soarer in the skies...

title: Arashi: Castles of Sin - Final Cut
desc: Слейтесь с тенью, отправившись в отмеченное наградами VR-путешествие синоби. Овладейте навыками скрытного боя, проникая в замки феодальной Японии. Используйте широкий арсенал оружия, инструментов и техник, чтобы перехитрить каждого врага на пути и уничтожить Шесть Они Иги.

title: Arca's Path VR
desc: Вы заперты в волшебном мире Арка. Найдите выход из лабиринта и вырветесь на свободу.

title: Arcade Paradise VR
desc: Перенеситесь в 1993-й год и окунитесь в виртуальный мир Arcade Paradise VR, чтобы пережить невероятный опыт и ощутить могучую ностальгию по ретро-играм!

title: Arcane
desc: You have arrived on a small island with nothing but a stack of magical weapons. A local warlock has been summoning elementals and causing chaos. You're here to fight and brawl your way to the top of the island, restoring peace to this arcane battleground.

title: Arcane Assault
desc: A magic themed VR tower defense game. Face off against hordes of monsters as they descend upon you in waves. Place towers, cast spells, make quick getaways, and unleash total destruction to clear your path of all that comes against you!

title: Arcaxer
desc: Arcaxer is a turn-based VR RPG with first-person action-oriented combat & a third-person god-view overworld. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, claim equipment, & discover abilities in a science fiction simulation full of colorful AI characters & surprises. Choose your class & climb The Stack.

title: Archery Land
desc: Archery Land is a single, multiplayer VR shooting game, and Enjoy the thrilling feeling of hitting the target in our Archery Land by aiming the bow at the wide land.

title: ArcSine
desc: A first-person VR puzzle platformer that will push your dexterity to its limits. Learn numerous mechanics that help or hinder you as you navigate more than 340 dynamic environments to their end. An epic journey of mental and physical perseverance.

title: Arcturus Vision Camera
desc: Record 3D spatial videos with Arcturus Vision Camera and watch them on Steam Frame.

title: Arden's Wake
desc: The sea levels have risen, and a young woman and her father live in a lighthouse perched atop the ocean’s surface. When he goes missing, she must descend deep into the post-apocalyptic waters previously forbidden to her, embarking on a thrilling journey of family history and self-discovery.

title: AREA MAN LIVES
desc: AREA MAN LIVES. Or does he? A quirky radio drama unfolds around you in VR while you do your best to keep the radio station humming along as its new DJ. You record commercials, interview callers and try your best to piece together how your actions inside the station impact your listening audience.

title: Aripi
desc: "Aripi" is an exciting adventure about an astronaut forgotten in orbit and his dream that unexpectedly came true.

title: Arizona Sunshine
desc: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

title: Arizona Sunshine 2
desc: Зомби-шутер с чёрным юмором и верным псом.

title: Armed Against the Undead
desc: Ready for intense action packed zombie carnage? Armed Against the Undead lets you wield the largest variety of weapons and take on hordes of zombies, monsters, and more.

title: Armor Clash VR
desc: Armor Clash VR is an RTS game of modern warfare. In the virtual reality environment, you can build a base, command units above the sky. You will find it is also fun to play an RTS game in VR.

title: ARMS DOLL
desc: "ARMS DOLL" is a VR mecha action game where you become the pilot of a humanoid mobile weapon called an ARMS DOLL and fight against the enemy.

title: Arrowborn
desc: Arrowborn is multiplayer Player versus Player VR Archery. Load your quiver with deadly magical arrows, ready your shield, then leap through the air as you loose barrages on your enemies from all angles. Play with up to 10 players or Bots over a variety of exciting game modes to prove you are Arrowborn!

title: Arthur Owl's Word Block
desc: Meet Arthur Owl and his clever game Word Block. With around 200 included puzzles and even more in downloadable packs, you'll have plenty to do! If you're addicted to games like Wordle and love VR, this is for you!

title: Ascension VR
desc: Now updated with the War of Shadows expansion and support for motion controls! Come try out the expansion with the devs, Tuesday nights at 8pm Pacific. Ascension VR is the first deckbuilding Virtual Reality experience.

title: Ascent Spirit
desc: Оснащенный двумя импровизированными ледяными осями, ваш единственный шанс выжить - добраться до вершины этой священной горы и вернуться к своему ремеслу, прежде чем ветер освободит его.

title: Asgard's Wrath 2
desc: Масштабная ролевая игра в мире египетской мифологии с огромным открытым миром.

title: Ashen Arrows
desc: Ashen Arrows is a Nordic mythology-themed VR archery game featuring roguelike gameplay, tower defense elements, and puzzles.

title: Ashes of the Ark
desc: Built exclusively for VR, Ashes of the Ark puts you into a survival situation where zombies have taken over the failing space station. Handle the most realistic weapons with real-life movements, freely explore the Ark, and solve puzzles in VR. Can you stop the Flood before they reach the cryo-sector?

title: Asteroid Blaster VR
desc: Grab your laser guns and strap on your jet pack. Asteroid Blaster VR lets you jump into virtual reality space and start blowing up rocks and UFOs. Enjoy a quick gaming break or a marathon high score competition with the casual feel of a video arcade classic. Fly around, shoot stuff and have fun!

title: Astral Domine
desc: After crash landing on a mysterious planet, you must explore the ruins of an ancient alien kingdom to retrieve the energy sphere that can restore power to your spaceship. A single player interactive VR adventure designed for the HTC Vive. REQUIRES VIVE HEADSET AND MOTION CONTROLLERS TO PLAY

title: Astro VR
desc: Explore the real Solar System and thousands of star systems. Watch Phobos dash through the Martian sky or observe a sunset on a planet with multiple suns. Accelerate time, compare planet sizes, and visit scientifically grounded stars and exoplanets—in VR or on desktop.

title: AstroBlast VR
desc: Play the timeless classic in a 21st century finish. AstroBlast VR brings the feel of arcades back, only this time compete against players from all around the world.

title: Astroderps
desc: Astroderps is a fun puzzle game that you can play for all ages. Your goal is to guide your Astroderps from one portal to the next while avoiding dangerous obstacles.

title: Atoms
desc: 【Based on VR,type of MOBA game】. 【Single play with CPU】. 【Multiple plays as a pair of teams or antagonism】. 【3 heros to choose】. 【9 weapons can play】. 【Skill and equipment system】. 【Upgrading and combo rewards】. 【A strong sense of battle】.

title: Attack of the Bugs
desc: The ultimate VR tower defense game; YOU are the tower! Your enemies? Hordes of scream-inducing crawlers. Your defenses? Beloved childhood toys and whatever household objects you can craft into a weapon.

title: Audio Arena
desc: Audio Arena is a single player arena game in which the gameplay is generated by music.

title: Audio Forager
desc: Feel the magic of Machine Learning in this new experiment that combines over 44,000 sounds from Freesound.org, a data set created by Kyle McDonald and a touch of Cabbibo weirdness. Run your hands through a cloud of sound, select your favorite clips and make a drum set from this aural smorgasbord!

title: Audio Infection
desc: Pew... pew... enemy goes boom! We give you exciting music, intense gameplay, smart AI and epic weapons. It is up to you to deal with the infections.

title: Aurora
desc: Welcome to a whole new world of Ultraleap Hand Tracking.

title: Aussie Sports VR 2016
desc: Aussie Sports VR 2016 invites you into Australia’s sporting community to meet the players, see the fans, feel the passion and be a spectator at major events of 2016. Explore Australia's favourite sports and play mini games: AFL, Basketball, Cricket, Football and Rugby.

title: Automata Break
desc: Stop the escape of the infected automata in this Local Co-op Tower Defense First Person Shooter game for VR. Choose between playing solo or collaborating with a friend to build defensive structures and fight the Automata to avoid their escape.

title: Avem33
desc: An arcade style flying game, which takes you through a path into an endless city. Follow the trail as much as possible, but don't get greedy. The longer you stay alive, the more points you will get. Beat the high score!

title: Awake: Episode One
desc: AWAKE is an unforgettable, thought-provoking experience; seamlessly blending complex environments with photo realistic volumetric video to create a new benchmark in immersive cinema. You are a new presence in the story of Harry; a man obsessed with solving a mysterious lucid dream.

title: Awaken
desc: Set in beautiful worlds and designed solely for VR, Awaken is a captivating puzzle game and rhythmic music experience. Become an architect of light, awaken the universe and bring back the stars. Awaken features both a campaign mode and a level creation mode to build puzzles and challenge friends.

title: Axe Throw VR
desc: You've got a VR headset and some cool motion controllers, but what can you really do with them? Throw some virtual axes! In Axe Throw, a virtual axe throwing range becomes your playground.. or you can see how long you can fend off a zombie apocalypse in survival mode!

title: Axial Drift
desc: Axial Drift is an online-multiplayer FPS-Z modding platform where you can create your own maps, skins, weapons, and game modes using Unreal Engine 4.

title: Aztec Tower
desc: Aztec Tower is a free VR bow & arrow game about defending the temple of your people against the spanish conquistadors.

title: B. Braun Future Operating Room
desc: Experience how a surgery can look like in the future. Enter an innovative nanobot simulation and remove as many damaged vessels from inside your patient's body as possible.

title: B3
desc: B3 will be a first-person VR shooter where you have to defend your base from waves of attacking monsters.

title: Babel: Tower to the Gods
desc: Babel is a charming physics based puzzle game where you have to use precision, speed & careful thinking to remove redundant blocks from a tower of blocks without toppling it, to ensure the safety of it's worshipers!

title: Backrooms: Missing Persons
desc: Many have vanished without a trace, swallowed by the endless halls of the Backrooms. Now it’s your turn to step inside. Wander through unsettling liminal spaces, guided only by the constant hum of fluorescent lights. Are you the next to disappear?

title: BackRoomsNew
desc: This game is "BackRoomsNew" in game, after each level the game will be harder and in each level there will be all kinds of monsters that will try to catch you. Each level will have a task where you have to find a key or a lever and all sorts of things to open the door.

title: BAD BILLY 2D VR
desc: Billy is really angry! Billy's girlfriend Jessica was kidnapped by creatures from a 2D World. Billy has to follow the creatures into the 2D World to free Jessica.

title: Bad Mojos
desc: You are the last survivor, badmojos attacked the city.Bad mojos is Voodoo dolls with one single objective, to destroy all life and only in your power to stop them. Today is a bad day for badmojos. Take a gun in your hand and start to protect the city from evil voodoo.

title: Badminton Kings VR
desc: Experience the feeling of badminton in your home! Badminton Kings is a VR-sport game which you can feel a life-like badminton play in virtual reality applied realistic physical shuttlecock movement and spinning.

title: Baggage Inspector
desc: Baggage inspection! The words every traveller dreads to hear! Only this time, you're not the traveller, you're the inspector. Sounds exciting? No? Ah, if only you knew the things people put in their baggage! Now you can, in this casual VR-supported work simulator.

title: Bakemono - Demon Brigade Tenmen Unit 01
desc: Bakemono is an anime themed VR mech simulator.

title: Ball Out
desc: Discover a crazy Motorcycle - Football game that combines reactivity and speed! In Ball Out, get on several vehicles and compete against your friends or other online players on various tracks with one goal in mind: score as many goals as possible! Gain experience and customize your equipment to show your opponents what you are worth.

title: Balloonatics
desc: Pilot a weaponized basket while dodging enemy fire and collecting weapons and traps to take down your opponents. Invite your friends, shoot them down, avoid getting shot down.

title: Balls! Virtual Reality Cricket
desc: A Virtual Reality Cricket Game for the HTC Vive that emerges you right in the heart of the cricketing action. You find yourself in the middle facing a variety of bowlers from fast paced seam to off spin and leg spin as you try to hit a record score and join the Honours Board.

title: Banana Attack VR
desc: Shoot zombie limbs off and watch their ragdoll bodies fall then cook their delicious remains over the fire and feed it to your cute little fox!

title: Bandit Point
desc: Bandit Point is an immersive VR shooter game set in a quirky mechanical world combining both fantasy and science fiction themes, where player uses their special abilities to control enemy units and destroy the opposing, snobby automatons.

title: Bang Bang Land
desc: Примите участие в ряде испытаний по стрельбе, пока вы исследуете Bang Bang Land, заброшенный тематический парк, спроектированный Gun Nut, который пришлось закрыть из-за серьезных проблем со здоровьем и безопасностью! Можете ли вы помочь ему открыться?

title: BARDO
desc: Trapped in the void between death and rebirth, embody the essence of a Tibetan archer and confront hordes of reanimated and corrupt Tsen spirits. Exclusively for VR, BARDO is a fast-paced, atmospheric action game offering the most satisfying and challenging archery experience to date.

title: Barn Finders VR
desc: Put on your VR and discover a whole new Barn Finders’ experience! Feel how is it like to work alongside Uncle Billy…if you dare!

title: Barn Finders VR: The Pilot
desc: Put on your VR and discover a whole new Barn Finders’ experience with free Pilot! Feel how is it like to work alongside Uncle Billy…if you dare!

title: Basault VR
desc: BASAULT VR is a virtual reality movement shooter. Run, jump, swing around on your grappling hook and shoot with a variety of complex yet familiar firearms. Use those tools to survive and reach the end of this roguelite!

title: Base Defense VR
desc: A classic tower defense game made for VR!

title: Basic Car Repair Garage VR
desc: For car shows, trade shows and car people. A basic auto repair garage where you can run vehicle lifts up and down, look at animated transparent engines, install transmissions, and interact with mechanic tools and automotive parts.

title: Basketball Babe
desc: Basketball Babe is a fast paced arcade basketball shooting game. Hone your basketball shooting skill in the different scenes to get high score.

title: Basketball Madness
desc: Basketball Madness is a super fun VR sports and arcade game. Play and fight against the enemies that want to distract you from scoring. Basketball shooting has never been so hilarious and so challenging at the same time.

title: Batter Up! VR
desc: Batter Up! VR is a delightful casual cake baking game for the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. Bake cakes solo for your customers with an evolving variety of tools, make your bakery beautiful, and rake in the dough! Order your friends around as they play as your minions, fetching ingredients and helping you bake cakes!

title: Battle for the last chicken
desc: As a desperado, you join in a very thrilling death game for a large amount of money. The game has 100 people involved.

title: Battle of Kings VR
desc: The time of war has come! Take the command of your kingdom and use your strategic skills to defend the siege against your fortifications. You can’t win only by defending your Kingdom. Develop your economics, assemble and upgrade your army to defeat the enemy forces in a real Battle of Kings.

title: Battle of Red Cliffs VR
desc: 「Battle of Red Cliffs VR」 provides you with the chance to experience the great battle of Red Cliffs, one of the most historic battles from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Experience the novel gameplay features only available in VR.

title: BATTLESCAR: Punk Was Invented By Girls
desc: Are you punk enough? Battlescar is a coming of age immersive film narrated by Rosario Dawson that takes place in a 1970's New York City. Join Lupe and Debbie, two runaways who's adventures in starting a punk rock band take them to places they never expected.

title: BattleSky VR
desc: BattleSky VR is a Multiplayer VR flying first-person shooter, bringing Overwatch style gameplay to the VR platform. Each player picks a Hero with vastly different size, powers and gameplay style to engage in fast-paced aerial combats against other players.

title: Bazaar
desc: Fly on a magic carpet through the mystical land of Bazaar, collecting exotic trinkets for your journey! Beware dart traps, sea cobras, and hungry crocs that lurk around corners. Vandal monkeys have stolen relics from the guardian of the labyrinth - will you recover them in time or be trapped forever?

title: BCI VR Horror Attraction: The Mad Trail
desc: Meet BCI VR Horror Attraction: The Mad Trail created by members of BCI LAB room. This game gives you optimized fear by measuring brain waves during play. Also, you can check your shooting skills by scoring right after the expedition. Welcome to the tense BCI VR Horror Attraction: The Mad Trail.

title: Be
desc: Build, relax or explore in a beautiful world. Chill out next to a lake or build crazy structures (with friends!) Choose your own weather & time of day.

title: BE THE HERO

title: Beach Body Bros
desc: Embark on a ridiculous 4 minute musical journey through a world of pure muscle, intense strength, and stupid greatness.

title: Beach Bowling Dream VR
desc: A lucid dream about getting ship-wrecked on a deserted island and finding that the materials from your ship have been turned into a bowling alley by a friendly ghost of a pirate! A simple and fun room-scale VR mini-game. Can you unlock the pirate's treasure chest? The lock on it looks fairly brittle...

title: Beach Cry of VR
desc: Bikini zombies are coming! “Beach Cry” release upgrade “Beach Cry”, the game was made from Beijing Daxing media has got big update recently. It added level setting, five boss from myths and legends make debuts! Brand new magic theme let the game has a new life, more details waiting for you.

title: BeachHead Rogue
desc: BH Rogue is the next exciting iteration of the BeachHead brand. It blends the action FPS of the original BeachHead game with new Rogue-lite elements. Join the BeachHead defenders against the Musso Khan forces!

title: Bearly Escape
desc: Bearly Escape is a fast-paced VR action adventure where you play as a brave little bear on the run from a not-so-nice scientist. Use your wits, speed, and special abilities to overcome traps and make your great escape!

title: BEAT ARENA
desc: Strum, strike, and jam away! Liven up your VR gig! Perform on stage in a band as a pianist, a guitarist, a bassist or a drummer, all in VR! Grab your friends' play data and enjoy a VR jam session together! Perform your favorite songs from the BEMANI series in VR!

title: Beat Blaster
desc: Beat Blaster is a VR game in which the player must master the art of shooting, running and dodging obstacles and enemies. An original mix of styles with each level offering a new challenge.

title: Beat Boxer
desc: Exercise to your own music! Punch, dodge, and dance around the ring. BeatBoxer is a Room-Scale VR boxing game that puts you in the spotlight of your own boxing match. Play any song from Youtube or use Airplay to play a continuous stream of music from Spotify, Pandora, iTunes, or your favorite music app.

title: Beat the Beat Up!
desc: "Beat the Beat Up!" is a VR action/rhythm game, where you fight to the beat as the star of your very own Bollywood blockbuster! Do you have what it takes to save this movie?

title: Beat the Blitz
desc: Join Peyton Manning in Gatorade’s Beat the Blitz, a free-to-play VR experience. You’ll test your throwing skills on the field, travel inside the body to see how hydration impacts performance and more. See you on the field.

title: Become a Gladiator VR : 1v1 PVP
desc: You start your struggle to survive in the Colosseum without knowing who you are and where slaughtering is just entertainment. In the middle of the Colosseum, all you can rely on is your weapons, shields and skills.

title: BeefeaterXO
desc: Have you ever thought what's inside the mind of Dabiz Muñoz? Would you like to experience dreamlike from your seat? Immerse yourself into the Odyssey of Dabiz Muñoz with virtual reality.

title: Beer and Skittls VR
desc: Beer and Skittls is a strategic VR game that will challenge your skill level of throwing.

title: Beer n Pee Dreams VR
desc: Strap in for a pee-rific short adventure! In Beer n Pee Dreams VR, platforms surround you in 360 degrees while you're on a mad dash to the bathroom. Score beers and dodge barrels, all to the beat of rock, funk, and the classic Clair de Lune. All this with light-hearted humor.

title: Beer Pong League
desc: Get drunk and have a blast in a whole new way! Play against your friends and climb the rankings to reach the top of the League! Come join the party in Beer Pong League!

title: Beers and Boomerangs
desc: Игра в виртуальной реальности, где вам предстоит метать бумеранги в кенгуру, пытающихся украсть ваше пиво! Готовьте и подавайте напитки друзьям, но не забывайте защищать свой барбекю от этих назойливых кенгуру!

title: Behind You
desc: Behind you Can you control your nerve ? Do you have what it takes? From the depths of the manor house to the atmospheric underground and garden. It is always there just waiting, watching you, do you dare open the next door ?what awaits you ? And more importantly can you escape it ?

title: Beyond Power VR
desc: In Beyond Power VR, you are so powerfull that weapons are useless. Battle online and destroy everything in sight with your sheer power. Will you be able to dominate your foes and become the strongest?

title: Biathlon Battle VR
desc: Biathlon Battle VR - игра, посвященная биатлону. Этот вид спорта сочетает в себе лыжную гонку со стрельбой из винтовки. Участвуйте в чемпионатах, мчитесь на лыжах среди заснеженных лесов и гор и забирайте золотые кубки.

title: Big Booty Adventures
desc: Glory awaits! Hoard your treasures and battle enemies as you move through a physically challenging world. Learn to wield a variety of weapons and strategize your assault to obtain loads of booty. Explore the world to find hidden treasures to customize your playstyle and enhance your abilities.

title: Big Hit VR Baseball
desc: Do you have what it takes to hit a big league fastball? Step up to the plate!

title: BinaryBotsVR
desc: Binary VR is a virtual reality experience of HEX WORLD, Binary leaves in HEX WORLD with his friend DIMM.

title: Bingo VR
desc: It is unheard of that a casual BINGO! game is a weapon of choice which drives aliens to their homeworld and defeats them forevermore. Yet, it is based on a true story.

title: Biodigital
desc: Experience the singularity in this fictional story set in the year 2117. Biodigital tells the story of how humans decided to download their minds into machines.

title: BioFusion
desc: BioFusion is a VR co-op multiplayer, PvE, first-person-shooter, tower defense game. Swing on a grappling hook, ride a hovercraft, throw grenades, collect buffs, build towers and traps. Do what you must to keep the mutants from the Spores of Evolution.

title: Bitcoin VR
desc: Ever wanted to see real time bitcoin transaction in VR? Ever wanted to prune the blockchain with a bow and arrow? Enter the forest of satoshi!

title: Bitdude
desc: A VR game commemorating the arcade game everyone knows and loves from the 80's.

title: Bitslap
desc: Deep in the Andromeda galaxy, a lone warrior stands against an army of cubes. Due to quantum disturbances in the world line, cubes can only be destroyed in the order in which they appear.

title: Black Trail VR
desc: Black Trail is a VR shooter, set in an epic war in the Old West. Play as a seasoned bounty hunter and a vengeful Native American warrior, follow their interwoven stories, use a wide range of weapons, explore ravaged lands, and fight as you chase newly discovered artifacts to change the fate of war.

title: Blackbox
desc: Blackbox is an emotional rollercoaster ride through the childhood memories of Sami, a Syrian boy, who shares personal stories of happiness and joy intertwined with unspeakable moments of sadness and remorse.

title: BlackForge: A Smithing Adventure
desc: BlackForge: A Smithing Adventure is the ultimate VR weaponsmithing simulator! Become a legendary blacksmith, crafting mighty blades and impeccable tools as you hone your trade in a mystical forge.

title: Blackjack Bailey VR
desc: Blackjack Bailey VR is a casual casino blackjack game you play in Virtual Reality against a cute and charismatic dealer that goes by the name of Bailey. It's simulated gambling so there are no real money transactions, it's just for fun and practice!

title: Bladeline VR
desc: Bladeline VR is a game designed to make players enjoy powerful sword actions. Get the best score, prove your performance and be the best swordsman ever!

title: BladeShield
desc: Survive wave after wave of enemy AI bots in this intergalactic VR game. Switch between shield and blade with the click of a button, charge up your light blade by blocking incoming laser bolts, and unleash a powerful EMP blast!

title: Blanket Heavy With Nightmares
desc: Blanket Heavy With Nightmares is an art installation created By Finnish artist Suvi Solkio in cooperation with Kajaani Art Museum and Kajaani University of Applied Sciences.

title: Blast Beat
desc: Blast Beat - это ритм-игра в виртуальной реальности, в которой вы сражаетесь кулаками. Наносите удары в ритм с музыкой от электронной, металла, поп-музыки, мировых хитов до многих других музыкальных жанров. Снимите стресс и сожгите калории с помощью захватывающих упражнений!

title: Block'hood VR
desc: Block’hood VR is a neighborhood-building simulator that celebrates the diversity and experimentation of cities and the unique ecosystems within them. Budding city planners will have access to 200+ building blocks to create unique neighborhoods and discover the implications of their designs.

title: Bloodstream
desc: Unique VR mechanics that help you fight IN STYLE. Your sweet sick ninja moves unlock power attacks. Smash the earth, crash meteors, whirl fire tornadoes. Blood!

title: Bocce Time! VR
desc: It's time to head to the park for some VR bocce action! Bocce Time's various courts will have you throwing, bowling and spinning to win in online matches of up to 8 friends or single player against AI. Closest to the pallino wins, folks! It's Bocce Time!

title: Body of Mine
desc: Body of Mine is an award-winning VR experience that allows you to step into the body of another gender and discover the stories of transgender individuals.

title: Bombyx
desc: Psychedelic shmup zones with Gravatar & ZeroG! Fast, fluid, comfortable movement. Challenging enemies, met with powerful weapons. Sandbox gameplay at your own pace. With colorful graphics, interactive music, VR & Controller support.

title: Bonfire
desc: You’re Scout 817, a member of the not so elite Space Force. You’ve just crashed your spaceship on a strange planet. Your only tools for survival are a fading bonfire, a robot and a limited supply of nourishment cylinders. And what's that sneaking around out there in the dark alien jungle?

title: Boofle's Home
desc: Hello, my name is Boofle! Come and join me in my virtual world – there’s lots of fun things to explore and interactive activities for you to do! You can watch me on the swing, help water my flowers and catch butterflies!

title: Book Of Merlin
desc: "Book of Merlin" In the game you will act as the  descendant of Wizard Merlin, you need to solve  different puzzles remained in the Magic Tower  with your wisdom. You will get the unique power  from the book of Merlin after crack the seal!

title: Boom Boomerang
desc: Master the skill of throwing and catching virtual boomerangs to destroy bombs before they explode in this challenging and unique arcade-style VR game.

title: BoomXR
desc: Ninja rhythmic boxing workout

title: BossHunter VR
desc: BossHunter VR is the first version of the game where players will have to fight many interesting opponents, use multiple weapons, and a unique mechanic of its kind where the player directly commands a weapon to execute something with the help of speech. The hunt is on!

title: Bounce
desc: Bounce is a VR physics-based puzzle game for HTC Vive and Oculus Touch. Players are tasked with helping their playful robot companion, D1G-B, bounce, sling, shoot, and roll his way through an increasingly complex labyrinth of rooms on a galactic spaceship making his way to his final destination.

title: Bowl VR
desc: Bowl VR is a high quality bowling simulation for virtual reality. It has fully featured bowling alleys with accurate physics and ball control, along with local multiplayer that delivers endless hours of fun.

title: Bowling at the Lake
desc: Bowling at the Lake is a nice getaway game to play the popular sport of bowling. Surrounded by a lakefront park, enjoy and relax with the sights and sounds of nature as you bowl that perfect game.

title: Bowslinger
desc: Ever wanted to shoot an apple off someone’s head? Step into the world of Bowslinger, a VR archery game for the Vive. Grab a bow & arrow and William Tell your way to becoming a master archer. Train your speed and precision with various challenges that would make Robin Hood himself jealous!

title: Box: Boxing
desc: Box: Boxing - многопользовательская игра в виртуальную реальность с захватывающим геймплеем и уникальной графикой. Сразитесь с процессором или другими игроками в самых безумных сценариях, которые вы когда-либо видели, и станьте чемпионом мира Box: Boxing!

title: Boxing Coach
desc: A professional aerobic boxing VR fitness game. There are 23 boxing moves, 54 combinations of actions, and a long-term training plan with gradually increasing difficulty can be automatically generated according to the goal, duration, and intensity.

title: Boxing Saga
desc: WBO boxing punch force before naming authority The first domestic sports Title boxing game VR IP As a boxer, kept in the ring to beat the opponent, won the champion gold belt, and the endless battle in order to protect it.

title: Boxplosion
desc: An intense particle colliding experience for Virtual Reality. Interact with particles in unique new ways.

title: Brainland
desc: Designed for the rehabilitation training of the elderly and people with disabilities, this VR game provides a simulated learning environment for players to develop their motor, cognitive and life skills as well as express through artmaking within the playful experience.

title: Break Time!
desc: Break Time! is a physics based destruction game for Virtual Reality.

title: Breath of Spirits
desc: With the power of the Spirit, defeat the enemies and purify the land of elves. Gain different elemental abilities and various Elf`s costumes in single play mode, or cooperate with other players and survive the horde in multiplayer mode.

title: Breathe Peace World
desc: Enter a Virtual Reality storybook world and learn how to Breathe Peace. When you're ready to return home, you'll know exactly how to Breathe Peace in any situation, anytime, anywhere!

title: Breathless
desc: Sci-Fi VR Music Video Experience

title: Brew-Ha
desc: Walk in the shoes of an alchemist for a medieval town. As a player fulfill orders of potions and throw them at the patrons for a high score in this VR game. Beware the witch she’ll curse your customers and make everything more complicated! Save the citizens of the town and become a master alchemist!

title: Brick Stack VR
desc: Surround yourself by three walls of falling bricks as you work as fast as you can to clear them.

title: Bridge Constructor Studio
desc: Bridge Constructor Studio — это новейшая игра из популярной серии. Испытайте свои инженерные навыки в этой физической головоломке, которая сочетает все лучшее из предыдущих игр с яркой и современной графикой. Это настоящий подарок для увлеченных строителей!

title: Bridge to Nowhere
desc: Are you looking for a brief, immersive, and exciting experience to demo VR to first-time users? What about a quick way to get your heart pumping? Then Bridge to Nowhere is the game for you. Step onto a squeaky bridge 80 feet in the air as high winds surround you. Do you have what it takes to jump off?

title: Bridge Trek
desc: Face your fear of heights! Bridge Trek provides you with a safe environment to conquer your gephyrophobia or acrophobia in virtual reality. Build your way up from the pillow padded first bridge, to the perilous glass bridge in the sky!

title: Bring to Light
desc: Trapped in the city subway system due to a sudden disaster, you explore the depths of the tunnels to find your way out. The further you explore, the more you realize there is more to this disaster...and the lurking shadows are following your every move.

title: Broken Spectre
desc: 25 years ago your father climbed the mountain and never came back. Now he’s calling for you. Experience the award winning, narrative eldritch horror game like you haven’t before in the Director’s Cut. Can you unravel the mystery of your father who disappeared in the remote wilderness years ago?

title: Bubble Labs VR
desc: Bubble Labs is perfect way to introduce people to VR. The controls were designed with beginners and kids in mind, so that people of all ages can play. Create, mold, and experiment with liquid physics using Nvidia's flex particle physics! You will be amazed with the physics and colors of this world.

title: Bulk Dominoes VR: Kinetic Rush
desc: Build and create domino chain reactions, knock them down, then push 1 button to set them back up again. It’s fun and easy! Plus you will not have to worry about accidentally knocking them down while you're building.

title: Buried Alive: The Annihilation VR
desc: Buried Alive: The Annihilation is an immersive and intensive VR shooter. Survive and uncover the truth in the Annihilation!

title: BurnerSphere
desc: BurnerSphere is an immersive social VR experience where players explore VR documentary content filmed at Burning Man. Navigate iconic art installations, engage with interactive workshops, and connect with friends or meet new ones to go on adventures. Experience Burner Culture like never before!

title: Buzludzha VR
desc: Embark on an immersive Virtual Reality adventure and discover one of Europe’s most iconic, abandoned structures. Fly the helicopter, play the grand piano, climb the 70m high tower, mess around with a wine gun, all while you uncover the secrets of this UFO-shaped communist legend.

title: BVRGER VAN
desc: BVRGER VAN is a frantic and fast-paced Virtual Reality game where you are tasked with the upkeep of your burger van business. Cook burgers, hotdogs, and much more as you journey your way to becoming the best burger van in town!

title: BYTEWORLD
desc: Welcome to BYTEWORLD, the ultimate sandbox experience that aims to bring streamers and viewers together like never before!

title: C.S.S. CITADEL VR
desc: Are you ready to survive and escape from the C.S.S. CITADEL?

title: Cactus Cowboy - Desert Warfare
desc: Cactus Cowboy Returns in His Most Thrilling VR Adventure Yet – "Desert Warfare"!

title: Cairo's Tale: The Big Egg
desc: Cairo's Tale: The Big Egg is a VR animated short about the adventure of young talented mage Cairo and his best friend, who just got surprised by a giant egg that fell off and broke the roof of Cairo’s flying house. Though being afraid, they decide to figure out what happened…

title: Camelbirds
desc: Оседлай гигантскую птицу и мчись к победе! Обгоняй соперников, используй разнообразные инструменты и преодолевай препятствия на захватывающих трассах. Докажи, что ты лучший наездник в этих безумных гонках!

title: Candy Kingdom VR
desc: Candy Kingdom is a wonderful VR candy shooting game! The kingdom needs a new king! Will you be the new king?

title: Capsule
desc: Capsule is a challenging VR escape game developed for the HTC Vive and Valve Index.

title: Captain ToonHead vs the Punks from Outer Space
desc: Ever wanted to beat a T-Rex up with a chancla, while building powerful towers that shoot piñatas, hot sauce and heat-seeking fireworks? Captain ToonHead is the VR tower defense game of your cartooniest dreams.

title: Captcha Kills
desc: A crossover between Among Us and the Turing Test. In this multiplayer battle royale, you deceive others into believing you are artificial intelligence and not human. Hide amongst the AI, eliminate players you believe are human, and be the last person standing to win.

title: Cargo Breach
desc: Cargo Breach is an Intense VR Arcade Shooter with Unique Weapon Mechanics. You hunt down escaped creatures in dark atmospheric spaceship corridors. All presented in stunning AAA graphics.

title: Carlos III y la difusión de la antigüedad
desc: "Charles III of Spain and the antiquity" tells the story of how Charles III funded the excavations that discovered the ancient cities of Herculaneum and Pompeii, spreading the knowledge acquired throughout Europe and America.

title: Cartridge Monsters
desc: Cartridge Monsters is a VR Creature Collector. Capture and train over 65 unique monsters and navigate through four expansive dungeons, two in each town. Defeat formidable bosses and thwart the evil Django.

title: Case Files: The Death of Paulette Williams
desc: A short, choose your own adventure detective experience, where your choices matter.

title: CasinoXR
desc: CrapsVR is now CasinoXR! Experience the most realistic Vegas action of CasinoXR on SteamVR featuring Blackjack, Craps, and Roulette!!! Fast-paced casino action! Voice commands allow you to shout "Hit Me!" to receive a card in Blackjack, or "Hard Ten" to place a bet in Craps! Fast bet menus in Craps speed up the action!

title: Catch Flex
desc: Ваше тело и есть контроллер. Режьте блоки, ловите кольца, пинайте, топайте и уклоняйтесь под десять треков с ручной разметкой. Вас видит телефон или вебкамера: без геймпада и датчиков. Сразитесь вдвоём на одном экране, размечайте песни или попробуйте экспериментальный VR-режим. Демо бесплатно.

title: CatTag: Create
desc: CatTag: Create is a multiplayer VR sandbox game where players use hand-based movement to explore, build, and play custom worlds together. Create maps with physics blocks, animations, collision events, and programmable circuits.

title: Cattle 101 -  Sample Library
desc: Transforming access to livestock information, one species at a time.

title: Chained: A Victorian Nightmare
desc: Chained: A Victorian Nightmare is a haunting VR adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic tale, A Christmas Carol. Prepare to be transported into a bone-chilling journey of self-discovery.

title: Chainless
desc: Escape from prison and swing your way through the city in floating chains, avoiding various obstacles, trying not to fall and not to get caught.

title: Chamber 19
desc: Pilot a drone to shoot enemies and dodge patterns of bullets. Fight bosses and get powerups that enable some crazy action! Can you pass the Human Intelligence Test in your Chamber?

title: Chambered
desc: Chambered is a single-player, story-based VR shooting game with an emphasis on weapon progression. Featuring trackpad locomotion, 13 guns, and 140+ weapon mods, Chambered is sure to keep you playing for hours.

title: Chernobyl Again
desc: Chernobyl Again is an adventure game adjusted for Virtual Reality headsets for a more immersive and engaging experience level. The story full of challenges and turbulence will let the players transform into a character trying to save the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant.

title: Chess VR: Multiverse Journey
desc: Board a spaceship and commence a game of wit in the vast universe! Take the lead, attack ferociously but defend cautiously, and give your opponent the final blow. You may also follow the ship to travel, guess which mysterious scene you will end up?

title: ChessVR
desc: ChessVR brings the game to life. Play against the AI in 4 difficulties or try yourself at some chess challenges.

title: Chiaro and the Elixir of Life
desc: A young engineer named Chiaro gives life to a steam powered robot called Boka, and together they embark on a quest for the fabled Fountain of Elixir, in order to restore the lost race of alive machines to the world.

title: Chicks and Tricks VR
desc: Chicks and Tricks VR is a 2 player local-multiplayer party game for VR. The farmer and the fox battle together in catching as many chickens as they can! Earn a point for every chicken the farmer has saved or the fox has eaten. The player with the most points wins the round.

title: Child Of Ault
desc: Child Of Ault is a tower-defense/shooter hybrid, with an emphasis on presence and presentation. In the game, you play the role of boy who uses his magical toy weapons to protect against dark forces.

title: Child of the Wind
desc: Navigate your oriental ship safely across the many table-top seas using two hand-fans to influence the wind. Steer enemy ships into ruins and avoid natural dangers, including thrashing whirlpools while collecting your cargo and bringing it to safety in a beautiful, Japanese-inspired environment.

title: Children of Colossus
desc: Children of Colossus is a VR action game for HTC Vive. The player will challenge 5 different colossus to win the opportunity for human's development. All the player can rely on are one wand and one sword, he must move or squat to dodge the attack of colossus, and take chance to strike back.

title: ChillaxVR
desc: Go to different beautiful, relaxing and chill environments using VR, taking a break away from the real world and virtually stepping into a land you only wished you could travel to. Become involved in the game and the environment where you not only play the game – but also become part of the game

title: Chocolat Rush
desc: Прямо сейчас, в окружении сверхмощной армии шоколада, происходит самая сладкая битва в истории виртуальной реальности. Устраните толпы наступающих шоколадных монстров с помощью игрушечного пистолета!

title: Chocolate
desc: Chocolate is a 3-4 minute reactive linear VR music video experience for the song by Giraffage that sets you as a robot in a cat-centric world of colorful chrome in which your hands interact with your environment and everything dynamically moves and changes to the music.

title: Chop It
desc: Chop It is a VR rhythm game about karate and friendship. Be karate. Gaze in awe as the Sensei launches himself around the Pagoda raining building materials on your head.

title: Chunky Orbits
desc: Get up-close and personal with Gravity. Chunky Orbits is a simulation of free-floating objects in space based on real life physics. Each object in the scene attracts each of the others in a cosmic tug-of-war that we call Gravity. Toss out a few boulders and contemplate the wonders of the Universe.

title: Circuit Slinger
desc: Circuit Slinger is a VR rhythm game where players purge corrupted code to a beat.

title: City VR
desc: City VR allows you to discover new perspectives to look upon cities like never have before. Touch and feel the skyscrapers, teleport around, walk like a giant, take snapshots of favorite views and moments, or simply enjoy the sunset from the top of the world.

title: City Z
desc: Put on your armor, choose a rifle or a shotgun - now you are part of a special forces group. Shoot your way out of a skyscraper full of zombies.

title: CityWarHeroes VR
desc: In 2050, alien spaceships suddenly approach peaceful earth. The spacecraft lands in Incheon, South Korea, making the area a shambles. You'll have to fight against aliens as armed special forces, armed with armor and weapons packed with the most advanced technologies of the future. But what if the aliens are cute?

title: Clark | HOOVA VR
desc: Hoova, a room-scale VR experience, explores a dark, dystopian future and investigates topics of isolation, dependency and identity in Virtual Reality.

title: Clazer
desc: Clazer is a simulation that allows you to experience the art of sport shooting from the comfort and convenience of virtual reality.

title: Clean VR
desc: Clean VR is a small scale relaxed VR experience for HTC Vive. Your mission should you choose to accept it is to organize the house before the time runs out! Or you could just let yourself loose and smash the piano with random objects.

title: Cliffstone Manor
desc: Enter a mysterious manor full of surprises and intrigue. Cliffstone Manor pits you against an eccentric millionaire inventor who wants to try and recruit you for his mysterious “Enterprise”. Do you have what it takes to solve the puzzles and meet his challenge?

title: Climb VR New York Parkour
desc: Climb New York VR is a great Climbing game where you can free run. In Climb New York VR, you can freely do everything you want to do in real life, where you can complete the parkour by jumping over the buildings, where you can time travel through portals.

title: Close Encounter VR
desc: Experience the thrill of a UFO sighting and the terror of an alien abduction as you come face to face with extraterrestrial beings! Don't worry, everything will be fine in the end, I promise!

title: Cloudborn
desc: NOW OUT OF EARLY ACCESS! Cloudborn is a truly immersive VR exploration/adventure game, an incredible audio-visual experience that will move you into a world of awe and wonder. Explore the remnants of a lost civilization to uncover a hidden fate. Are you ready to ascend?

title: CloudBound
desc: CloudBound is a VR platformer where the player uses a Grappling Hook gun to swing, climb, and fling their way to the top of each level. Using our DFoV System ("Dynamic Field of View") we've managed to dramatically reduce simulation sickness to the point that users can move comfortably at high speeds!

title: CloudCity VR
desc: Build your magnificent metropolis from scratch in VR. Keep your citizens happy and grow your economy to watch your city prosper around you. Experience your city in a full day/night cycle in rain or shine from both giant and first-person perspectives.

title: CLOUDED VR
desc: Upload your mind to the cloud and immerse yourself in a dystopian virtual holiday at the Cloud Hotel. This VR experience is a satirical commentary on our relationship with the virtual world through personal devices.

title: Cloudrift
desc: Player One and Player Two try to stay atop the colourful, wibbly wobbly cloud, while mysterious and powerful items fall from the sky. A procedurally generated experience like no other!

title: Club Dance Party VR
desc: - Exciting dance time for those who are tired of work! Experience the real rhythm through realistic rhythmical VR! New conceptual club dance party within your home! - Club Dance Party VR –

title: Clutch: The Drift Simulation
desc: Clutch is an effort to create the closest to real life car drifting simulation but in a “game” form. The goal is to create a professional level game that closest simulates real driving with the largest support for modding. The secondary goal is to mimic the fun of real life drifting and community.

title: Coaster
desc: Experience the thrill and sensation of 4 unique roller coaster experiences. Feel the wind rush through your virtual hair as you ride some of the most enjoyable and immersive VR coasters on the market.

title: Coaster of Carnage VR
desc: Coaster of Carnage VR is a short (about 8 minutes) horror genre rollercoaster experience. Guts and gore, clowns and cadavers, blood and bones, spiders and a cohort of Satans rejects! Great for scaring friends and family! Not intended for the faint of heart.

title: Cockroach VR
desc: Если вы ищете виртуальную реальность с реалистично отображенными гигантскими тараканами, то эта игра для вас!

title: Code51:Mecha Arena
desc: Code51:Mecha Arena is a post-apocalyptic wasteland style mech arena game. As a pilot, you put on your VR headset, sit in the cockpit, drive your giant mech and fight your foes, which are also mechs driven by rival players.

title: Coffee Trainer VR
desc: Learn how to make coffee.

title: Coffee VendoR
desc: Tired of paying for VR mini games? Well now you can enjoy some mini games for FREE with Coffee VendoR.

title: COG (Center Of Gravity)
desc: Destroy asteroids and run up the score against your friends in COG (Center of Gravity), a stunning VR homage to the classic arcade game, Asteroids. Rift and Vive controllers supported.

title: Cogito

title: Cold Start: The Callisto
desc: A sci-fi VR exploratory puzzle game, The Callisto pushes the boundaries of VR with stunning visuals, dynamic puzzles, and a rich storyline that unfolds piece-by-piece through your own exploration.

title: COLD VR
desc: Время — ваше главное оружие! Двигайтесь, чтобы замедлить его.

title: Color Connect VR - Puzzle Game

Наслаждайтесь чисто боевым удовольствием и спасайте человечество от его обреченной судьбы.

title: Combat Troops VR
desc: Combat Troops VR is a dynamic military shooter game that will put your coordination, teamwork, and survival skills to the test. Whether you're taking on the enemy alone or working with your team, every mission is a thrilling challenge that requires quick thinking, precision, and skill.

title: Comets Wake
desc: Come join the adventure of Comets Wake. Explore vast archipelagos of floating islands with infinite variety. Find waterfalls, lava lakes, towers, ruins, giant mushrooms, and more! Choose from a huge array of weapons from guns to swords, or even a mage staff.

title: COMPLEX a VR Puzzle Game
desc: - A puzzle game for HTC VIve and Oculus Rift

desc: While studying a new shrinking spell, a wizard receives a package from an old friend, but doesn’t adhere to the warning attached.

The story is set in age of ancient times where the players will explore the game's dilapidated world, the Yan Valley, which is occupied by evil beasts, carrying the sacred gift of the gods to complete a quest against evil.

desc: Go from alone in the forest, to leading your army to victory! Choose your weapons and level up to unlock new skills, kill enemies to earn loot and gold, and construct a village to raise an army. The open world is full of enemies and villages, all of which are ready for combat.

title: Constricted VR
desc: Constricted VR - Now Available Test your puzzle-solving skills in Constricted VR. With varying difficulties and many different environments, you will be challenged in ways you won't expect. *Please Note: HTC Vive Required*

title: Cop Academy
desc: Cop Academy is a VR party game where two teams battle it out through a series of challenges. Cooperate with your teammates or ruin your opponents' game...or both! Earn the most points to prove yourself and help your team join the ranks of Otterwa's police department, the proud graduates from Cop Academy.

title: Cosmic Awakening VR

Explore the mysteries in a short linear experience, or try to survive as long as you can against unknown horrors.

title: Cosmos Crash VR
desc: The first person shooting & puzzle VR game.

title: Country of One
desc: Country of one is a virtual sandbox that lets you live our your island fantasies. Extremely precise construction controls allow you to build anything from a tiny shack to a giant castle, what your island will end up like is up to you!

title: Country Road VR
desc: Country Road VR is a virtual petting farm designed to help with relaxation by providing a serene, comfortable environment. Our petting farm is suitable and fun for all ages!

title: Cove Point Fun Center VR

title: Crazy Machines VR
desc: With Crazy Machines VR the award winning puzzle game classic enters the Virtual Reality! Complete many crazy chain reactions and experience a rousing adventure surrounding the odd Clumsycorns! Or just mess around in the ingenious new interactive toy rooms.

title: Crazy Saloon VR
desc: Crazy Saloon VR : The Virtual Saloon Experience. Discover the Old West with this quirky saloon simulator built for HTC Vive.

title: CREAM SODA CLUB
desc: Добро пожаловать в мир фантастических вечеринок группы CREAM SODA! В этой вселенной, собранной из идей группы, вы - промоутер клуба, в котором идет премьера нового альбома. Успех вечеринки в ваших руках — устройте полный солд аут!

desc: Creep Rides is a pack of 3 virtual reality rides on a track, just like the haunted mansion ride that you may have tried in an amusement park.

title: Crimen - Mercenary Tales

Experience visually captivating comic book graphics, while being entertained by the mercenary humor of the tavern’s patrons and their over-the-top deeds!

title: Crisis on the Planet of the Apes

title: CrisisActionVR
desc: CrisisActionVR is a multiplayer co-op FPS VR game. Competitive confrontation, team adventure, cooperative survival and a series of different games to meet the FPS VR game different fantasy. Invite your friends, take up arms, fight together!

desc: Welcome to the vibrant and mysterious world of Crowe in VR now updated with a NEW BONUS MODE, Survival Arena! Room scale puzzles, tactical bow & shield combat, damage dealing magical cross-pistols and gorgeous cinematic visuals that will sweep you to an alien world where science fiction meets high fantasy!

title: Cruo Domine
desc: Survive in a hostile space environment with randomized damage, drop and enemy strength. Adjust difficulty yourself dynamically with upgrading weapons, but be careful not always the upgrade succeeds.

title: Crypt Hunter
desc: An action VR roguelike.

desc: Crystal Blast is a single-player action-adventure game that offers a visually mysterious VR experience, created with Unreal Engine 5. Our goal is to survive in this mysterious cave and witness the remnants of past events while progressing towards the exit.

title: Crystal Raiders VR
desc: Enter the castles full of treasures and dangers. Choose your weapon to fight, avoid traps and overcome obstacles to survive all the way through and to find the lost dwarven artefacts. Play alone or in co-op up to four players!

title: Crystal Reign
desc: Battle hordes of woodland creatures, strategically place weapon towers across the landscape, enter your weapon tower and unleash a rain of fire on your enemies, and annihilate your enemies with your ultimate attack in hand-to-hand combat!

You now have the fate of the whole planet in your hands. grab up your weapons and protect the final fruits.

It provides a unique experience that allows you to face hundreds of enemy archers with melee weapons. Slash arrows more powerfully, and get a higher score by cutting in a row!
