With cool power-ups & customized avatars. Get full game Horror Simulator VR to unlock more maps＆content and have more fun!

title: Horrors of Space
desc: An alien creature is loose on your spaceship and it’s out for blood. Run, hide, use the resources at your disposal and work with your fellow crew members to get off the ship before it’s too late.

title: HOST
desc: Ваш космический корабль потерпел крушение на неизвестной планете, и вы прокладываете свой путь по ее темным неизведанным тропам. Единственное ваше орудие — руки и смекалка. Сумеете ли вы с их помощью разгадать все секреты и тайны?

title: HOT GIRLS VR
desc: Welcome to the world full of beautiful, hot girls, meet them all, play with them at the party and... Do what you want. Everything depends on your imagination.

title: Hot Pot VR
desc: Hot Pot VR — это увлекательная кулинарная игра с эффектом полного погружения, в которой вы отправитесь в путешествие по всему миру на простом фуд-траке. Сможете ли вы приготовить традиционные блюда каждого континента? Испытайте себя и улучшите свои навыки!

title: Hot Squat 2: New Glory

title: House Builder VR
desc: Путешествуйте по миру и сквозь века, чтобы создавать культовые проекты! Остерегайтесь неприятных температур и опасной фауны! Теперь в VR, чтобы полностью погрузиться в приключения...

title: House Flipper Pets VR
desc: Никакие пятна на полу, уничтоженные ковры или погрызенные тапочки не смогут перевесить радость, которую вы испытываете, играя со своим четвероногим другом. В HF: Pets VR и время, проведенное с собакой, и ремонт квартиры - не что иное, как отдых!

title: House Sitter Escape Game
desc: "House Sitter Escape Game" is an escape game in Virtual Reality (VR) and PC (non-VR). Enter the house of the family 02500L3 and enjoy the peace, while it lasts. Puzzles and challenges awaits you. Multiplayer up to 4 players.

title: Housekeeping VR
desc: Housekeeping VR is a physics-based action game with a 70s futurist style for the Vive and Rift. It's a race against the clock as you completely destroy luxurious apartments in an attempt to make as much money as you can, and buy the biggest arsenal of tools to do the job!

title: Hover Skate VR
desc: Hover Skate is a physics based hoverboard simulator for VR with over 250 skateboard tricks to learn and master.

title: Hover The Edge
desc: A fast-paced and challenging VR, hoverboard based adventure, you're an extractor for a well-funded group of individuals who manipulate the past to hunt for ancient artifacts.

title: Hoverboards VR
desc: Hoverboards VR is a light-cycle-like game of 3D snake in VR! Hoverboards VR uses a unique locomotion technique that translates a player's movements within their play-space into movement of the board itself, mimicking the natural feel of surfing or snowboarding.

title: hoVRboard
desc: Extreme VR freeriding with a unique physics-based locomotion method – Explore three open-world-like levels and race your way through >60 challenges! Do tricks! Build your speed boost! Grind on rails! Blast away obstacles! Defy gravity!

title: Human Delusion
desc: A transformation from being restrained inside the human experience to being free and present. Human Delusion is an exploration of one’s emotions, consciousness, mind and their perception of reality. Are you ready to choose true Freedom?

title: Human Within

title: Hundreds of Mysteries:Wendy's Home2

title: Hunt the Thailand Hidden
desc: Find all the hidden objects in the room before time runs out. Enjoy a puzzle game which bringing you to discover a Thailand hidden and make you know about Thailand better.

title: Hunt Together
desc: Feel the thrill of a hunt in a 1v1 Duel or up to 1v3 Hide and Seek mode that will push your wits, perceptiveness, and courage to their very limits. Employ an array of items, triggers, and skills fit to your class to outsmart and defeat your foe - a terrifying Ghost or a dauntless, vigilant Hunter.

title: Hunter Beat
desc: Hunter beat - захватывающая игра в виртуальной реальности, созданная специально для людей, которые хотят отвлечься от повседневных забот, переключиться на позитивные эмоции, способствует переконцентрации.

title: Hunting Simulator VR
desc: Get your heart racing and blood pumping for the thrill of approaching prey and pulling the trigger with perfect timing and aim. Perfect your hunting skills behind the rifle by practicing on nature's bounty in this virtual reality experience.

title: HVRGUN

title: HyperBody

Navigate mysterious realms and affective tales, and immerse in a psychedelic, rhythm-fueled cosmos. Experience a meditative, aestheticised trance!

title: Hyperstacks

title: I Am Sakuya VR: Touhou FPS Game

title: I Hate Santa

title: I'm Hungry

You can definitely learn how to make fries, hamburgers and milk shake in the VR world and possibly the real world, as well! The game takes advantage of the VR technique, and it perfectly shows a realistic vision of a fast-food kitchen to the gamers.

title: Icarus Six Sixty Six
desc: Icarus Six Sixty Six is an intergalactic musical VR experience.

title: ICED VR

title: IKAROS
desc: A virtual reality game project using "redirected walking technology" that can enhance immersive adventure experience.

title: In - Sight
desc: The game without a purpose. A designed world emphasizes you.

title: In Memory
desc: Step into the memories of a prisoner of war and let the story unfold.

title: Inbound

title: INCARNA: R•AI•D

With a bomb timer set for one hour, can you discover the inner workings of the game and complete the challenges in time or is your fate inescapable?

title: Inevitable VR

title: Infinite Art Museum

title: Inhumanus
desc: Inhumanus is a story-based Sci-Fi singleplayer / co-op (up to 4 players) virtual reality shooter. Use a variety of guns to survive a complex full of aliens, robots, and mutants.

title: InMind 2 VR
desc: Попадайте по цветным нейронам, влияйте на эмоции и помогите подростку найти свой путь. InMind 2 сочетает аркадную стрельбу с историей взросления Джона: разные решения ведут к 20 концовкам. Приключение, вдохновлённое наукой, доступно с VR-шлемом и без него.

title: Innkeeper VR
desc: Step into the shoes of a medieval tavern keeper in a bustling fantasy world! In Innkeeper VR, you control every detail of your tavern, from cooking to cleaning, serving to managing unruly guests.

title: Innocent Forest 2: The Bed in the Sky
desc: The “FullDive Novel”: Visual Novels meets Virtual Reality in this ultimate immersive reading experience. With character dialogue voiced by high-profile voice actors, and illustrated pages turning into 360-degree VR animated scenes, you will be absorbed in the story, and feel as one with the protagonist.

title: Innocent Forest: The Bird of Light
desc: The “FullDive Novel”: Visual Novels meets Virtual Reality in this ultimate immersive reading experience.

title: inRun
desc: Почувствуйте магию классических аркадных гонок с инновационной системой мультиплеера в открытом мире и опциональной поддержкой виртуальной реальности, которая впервые в гоночной игре не вызывает укачивания.

title: Inside The Park VR
desc: Inside The Park VR is an immersive virtual reality baseball simulator developed for the Valve Index. Designed to make you a better player, Inside The Park VR delivers on this promise with immersive visuals, realistic physics, and dynamic data to make you the best baseball player you can be.

title: Interkosmos 2000
desc: Interkosmos is back! Jump into a year 2000 space shuttle for an even crazier VR adventure. Grab a wrench to fix failing systems, load floppy disks, and steer your ship to safety. Experience the funny story, master the retro controls, and try not to die!

title: Internal Light VR
desc: “INTERNAL LIGHT VR” однопользовательская игра разработанная для современных шлемов виртуальной реальности Oculus Rift, HTC VIVE в жанре приключенческий квест.

title: Into The Darkness VR
desc: Into the Darkness VR takes full advantage of VR tech. Your skills will be tested as you uncover the sinister secrets concealed within a secret base, hiding the consequences of the AI experiments of today. Face the many challenges dismembering robots and using realistic physics to your advantage.

title: Into the Rhythm VR
desc: Into the Rhythm VR is a drumming experience brought to virtual reality. You are given drum sticks along with 6 drums. Follow the dropping notes to play the awesome music you always wanted. All you need is a place to sit, and motion controllers to strike with rhythm!

title: iO Inner Self - The Lava Planet VR
desc: Help iO defend the dangerous Lava Planet in this first-person VR shooter as hordes of enemies are unleashed in increasingly difficult waves! Use your gun and shield to get to the end and then beat your high score!

title: iOMoon
desc: iOMoon is a made for VR first person exploratory experience where you pilot a research vehicle equipped only with a flare and camera, into the heart of Jupiter's moon iO. Explore and survive while gathering photographic evidence in a fantastic world full of surprises.Original Soundtrack by award winning composer Garry Schyman

title: Iragon
desc: An Erotic RPG Game with a story about magical girls, elves, and a bisexual sorceress.

title: Iragon: Prologue
desc: The Prologue to an Erotic RPG Game with a story about magical girls, elves, and a bisexual sorceress.

title: Iron Blood VR
desc: Iron Blood VR – командный Sci-Fi шутер с различными героями. Каждый герой имеет свое уникальное оружие и умение. Сумасшедшую динамику игре придает общее умение всех героев – телепортация к союзнику. Луч телепортации смертельно опасен для противников.

title: IrreVRsible
desc: The Virtual Reality has transformed everyone into evil zombies, IrreVRsible makes you fight for your survival against hordes of VR zombies using guns and katanas. Will you survive the IrreVRsible?

title: Isle of Pan
desc: Photograph strange creatures and open portals to surreal realms in this photography adventure. Isle of Pan is an alternative perceptual experience that recreates the joy of instant photography in the form of a supernatural walking sim.

title: It Belongs in a Museum
desc: It Belongs in a Museum is a Rogue-lite, treasure hunting, artifact collection VR story game. Join a shadow organization and help its weakened, resurrected goddess search for magic treasures to undo the curse they unleashed in dungeons, tombs, lost cities, and ancient ruins.

title: It's a Trap
desc: Can you survive the deadly traps in unexplored catacombs? Reclaim the legendary Crystal of Truth before the Nazis and you will see the world differently. Test your wisdom, courage and moves in a real challenge. Only in VR.

title: ItazuraVR Safe for Work
desc: Communication game watching women's livesThe cousin you used to play together suddenly came back and started to live next door. She has grown into a fine, young woman. She is alone, so you are asked to look after her…

title: J15 Jet Fighter VR (歼15舰载机)
desc: The J15 Jet Fighter is a modern air combat VR Game, You will be driving the J-15 fighter, carrying out training missions and combat missions on the Liaoning aircraft carrier.

title: Jaguar I-PACE Concept | Virtual Reality Experience
desc: Discover Jaguar I-PACE Concept - a preview of our first all-electric performance SUV - in a fully interactive Virtual Reality experience. HTC Vive customers can now explore the design and engineering stories behind I-PACE Concept through a blend of cinematics and immersive VR technology.

title: JAM GODS
desc: Become the superstar you've always wanted to be in an immersive extreme basketball experience like nothing else before. Drain deep threes, dunk from anywhere, swat away shots, catch soaring alley-oops. Are you ready to become the chosen one?

title: Jamie's Toy Box
desc: Jamie's Toy Box is a VR playroom simulator heavily inspired by toys and child-like imagination. Interact with all the fun toys and mystery buttons at your disposal or build your dream structure. But do not be fooled, this is more than just a simple room. Let your imagination run free!

title: Jank Cube VR
desc: Jank Cube is a fun VR physics sandbox filled to the brim with cool unique objects for you to interact with using the fully physically simulated player rig in maps made from the ground up for VR.

title: Javols VR
desc: Discover in Lozère, Javols, the capital of ancient Gévaudan completely reconstituted in Virtual reality

title: JETBOUNCE
desc: JETBOUNCE is a platformer and exploration game where you collect items to unlock new levels, unlock abilities and power-ups. A Collect-A-Thon where you fly, jump and bounce in non-linear levels. For the fans of old-school platformers from the N64 era.

title: Jida Chronicle Chaos frontier VR
desc: The greater the intensity of the brandishing, the higher the damage, and blocking, dodge, shooting and headshot, you will be dripping with sweat for mission accomplished. This is a game that could make you do exercise, Raise your sword and gun up, accept the challenge！

title: Jigsaw 360
desc: Relax while completing beautifully detailed spherical jigsaws. The new way to experience a traditional puzzle. Suitable for all ages with between 18 and 200 pieces. Add custom scenes - thousands freely available online.

title: Jinxed
desc: Take a ride with Jinxed, our very own master of mystery. He will entertain you as you travel through his strange and captivating world.

title: John Lazarus - Episode 1: Dead Man's Origin
desc: Fight demons, creatures, and criminals while exploring vivid and surreal dream worlds. Discover the dark past of anti-hero John Lazarus in this first episode of a multi-part VR horror action-adventure.

title: John's Wizard Dungeon
desc: John's Wizard dungeon is a VR escape room, where the player will have 5 minutes to collect clues, decipher a code, and steal the elixir of life.

title: Journey to the Centre of the Cell
desc: The Journey to the Centre of the cell takes users on a journey to the microscopic world. Explore the surface and interior of a cancer cell, exploring and learning about cellular anatomy and processes.

title: Journey Up
desc: Поднимитесь в небо по невозможной башне в одиночку или по сети с друзьями. Играйте в VR или в режиме блинчика. Симуляция физики всего тела. Несколько биомов, в каждом из которых вас ждут новые испытания, платформы и рукоятки для прыжков, лазания и качания. Продолжайте карабкаться вверх

title: Joy Flight
desc: Joy Flight is an open world arcade VR flight game where players will explore, unlock runways with daring landings and complete missions across a large chain of islands! Free to Play

title: JUMP
desc: JUMP, developed by Endeavor One Inc., enjoy the first large scale virtual reality jumping puzzle to utilize the awesome power of SteamVR! JUMP is a VR Only experience!

title: Jupiteration
desc: Jupiteration is a Sci-Fi shooter game designed for virtual reality headset HTC Vive & Oculus Rift + Touch

title: JUST BAT (VR CRICKET)
desc: JUST BAT is a revolutionary new VR CRICKET game that allows you to master the art of batting. An innovative new control system allows unrivalled control of shots in any style and direction. Set high scores and compete with others around the world.

title: JUST ONE MAN
desc: You are the OVERPOWERED ONE-MAN ARMY. Stylishly slaughter enemies with weapons, combo attacks and devastating abilities while listening to banging beats. Choose your own playstyle and invent the wildest combos to achieve the highest scores imaginable.

title: Kamile: The Fall
desc: KAMILE is an interactive VR experience set in 2084. You are Kamile. Your husband is a genius scientist responsible for a huge breakthrough in AI development. When work-related incident turns into family drama you’ll be forced to fight and flight to protect your son and his secrets.

title: Karga
desc: In the game "Karga," players become hero defenders aided by a dragon to battle the witch Hag and her dark army. Armed with elemental revolvers and special skills, they combat various foes. The hero's abilities and weapons strengthen with each battle.

title: KART CHASER : THE BOOST VR
desc: Shout out to all racing fans! ‘KART CHASER: THE BOOST’ has finally made it to the VR world! Immerse yourself in the virtual reality world, take the wheel and feel the thrill of the most realistic kart racing that you've ever seen!

title: Karting4Fun
desc: Jump into a race full of adrenaline, sharp turns, and wild contact. Bumping and shoving opponents is not only allowed—it’s encouraged!

title: Keep Watching VR
desc: Keep Watching is a virtual reality horror game. The goal is simple. Escape. You'll need to keep watching though, they move when your back is turned.

title: Kessler Effect
desc: «Эффект Кесслера» — это первый российский интерактивный приключенческий фильм в формате виртуальной реальности, в котором зритель напрямую взаимодействует с известными актерами, сам является одним из главных героев и может влиять на развитие сюжета и финал.

title: Kid Pilot VR
desc: Kid Pilot - это игра-приключение в полётах, где вы паритесь сквозь удивительные миры, просто двигая рукой. Исследуйте красивые окружения, зарабатывайте значки, открывайте секреты и преодолевайте сложные бои с боссами, становясь Топ-пилотом!

title: KILLING A SUPERSTAR
desc: Killing a Superstar brings a new VR interactive experience with immersive sense of drama. The story will start in different spaces at the same time. Viewers can use the map function in the film to freely switch among different scenes. The viewers need to answer the key questions to solve crimes.

title: Killing Zombies
desc: Surrounded by darkness, and undead creatures coming in from all angles. As the resistant soldier, you have been assigned to do one thing – kill them all. Killing Zombies is a 4 player online co-op horror survival shooter for the HTC Vive, with wave-driven VR gameplay from Front Range Software.

title: KIN
desc: Покоряйте инопланетные ландшафты, сражайтесь с врагами и решайте головоломки, чтобы узнать свою историю в KIN — платформере.

title: Kindled Cavern
desc: Kindled Cavern is a cave exploration adventure for Virtual Reality filled with sights to behold. Waterfalls, bamboo forests, giant turtles, abandoned bridges and scaffolding, subterranian lakes, and ancient arches fill this explorable cavern. Not to mention the ghosts!

title: Kinese
desc: A meditative VR experience about wonder, discovery and awe.

title: King Crab
desc: Копайте траншеи, стройте стены, исследуйте пляж и защищайте свой замок из песка от прилива — на ПК или в VR.

title: King of my Castle VR
desc: King of My Castle Vr is a Medieval Cartoonesque Tower Defense in which you will play an archer who must defend the King's Tower. You can teleport to 5 different locations to defend the city. A game for the whole family and guaranteed archery sensations!

title: Kingdom City Drowning Episode 1 - The Champion
desc: [24MIN RUNTIME] - Enter the vast chaotic depths of Kingdom City in a brand new narrative series for high-end VR headsets. Follow Brooks, James and Maika, three delinquents bound by violence, trauma and love on a journey of survival through an endless metropolis of depravity and crime.

title: Kingdom Run VR
desc: Kingdom Run VR is an action-packed fitness game; explore trapped tombs, avoid dangers, collect gems and eliminate enemies!

title: Kira
desc: Lose yourself in a Faerie workshop full of mysterious structures, magical devices, and colorful beasts. This is a mini-experience designed to highlight the immersive qualities of VR for friends and family, allowing them to explore each nook and cranny of a fantasy scene.

title: Kitten Cannon
desc: Pick up kitty. Pet kitty. Load kitty into cannon. Fire kitty. Amaze.

title: Kitty Rescue
desc: Oh dear, Kitty is always getting herself into a pickle. Luckily, you’re here to save the day. You must defy death to save our careless kitten from the dangers of a construction site, rescuing her from 3 perilous scenarios. Hope you don’t have a problem with heights!

title: Kiya
desc: Kiya is a five minute virtual reality piece telling the story of two sisters valiant but unsuccessful efforts to try to rescue their third sister, Kiya, from a deadly attack by her ex-boyfriend. Using two separate recorded calls to emergency workers, the experience puts the viewer on scene as the tragic events unfold.

title: Knife Club
desc: Welcome to the club. Knife Club puts your reflexes and throwing skills to the test. With head to head online combat, it is the adrenaline pumping multiplayer experience the VR community has been waiting for.

title: Koliseum Soccer VR
desc: Koliseum Soccer VR is the most epic game of table soccer in VR. Also called Babyfoot, Foosball or Kicker, it is one of the most iconical arcade game ever. We recreated the gameplay that everyone knows but with a twist. Now you can dribble your way to the goal, manage to keep a clean sheet when 3 balls are on the pitch... and many more!

title: KONGFU VR
desc: The earth was invaded by the demon race again.This time, they have gathered ancient fierce beasts. As one of the most valiant warriors, Defend them with your weapons! - Defend! The! Frontier!

title: Kongfusion
desc: Kongfusion is an action packed kung fu rhythm experience where the player takes on a horde of space kung fu masters. Slam into your opponents on the beat and show everyone who's boss with a variety of weapons.

title: Konrad's Kittens
desc: Окунись в виртуальный мир Котёнка Конрада — первого виртуального котёнка, который кажется совсем настоящим. Заботься о Конраде каждый день, как будто он твой настоящий кот. Исполняй его желания, отвечай на его потребности, играй в занимательные мини-игры и выигрывай доступ к 50 аксессуарам.

title: Kooring VR Wonderland:Mecadino's Attack
desc: Kooring VR Wonderland : Medicano's Attack contains 6 mini games, with special experiences in VR. In the mysterious Wonderland, you can devour exhilarating magical experience!

title: KOTH
desc: Climb your way to the top of the map and defeat the Koth.

title: KRAKEN
desc: Take control of the mighty Kraken and wreak havoc on the seven seas! Plunge to the depths of your humanity as you smash through history’s greatest nautical empires.

title: Krieg
desc: Built from the ground up for VR, Krieg is a team-based fantasy multiplayer competitive game. Thrown into the middle of a war between The King's Army and The Ancients, only the strongest will survive. This war of epic mercenaries and guardians will decide the fate of the realm.

title: KryptCrawler
desc: KryptCrawler brings classic first person, grid based Dungeon Crawler gameplay to your PC and VR. Descend into the unknown and explore the perilous depth of the sinister tombs and crypts you are thrown into, armed with nothing but a map and your wits.

title: Kubz VR
desc: Kubz brings one of the most famous puzzle game of all time to the Virtual Reality world! Play with an HTC Vive in a 3d rooms with very realistic Tetrominos falling from the sky. Your goal is the plug them in the grid as fast as you can or everything around you will be destroyed.

title: KungFu Town VR
desc: KungFu Town VR is a simulation KungFu game based on character AI and character skeleton creation. In the game you can attack on other people by fist, pick up weapons, AI characters can be crushed, cut, beheaded and so on.

title: Kunlun Fight
desc: It is a first person VR fighting game With KUNLUN FIGHT official authorization, you can train your reaction and boxing technique, and fight against the best martial arts masters in the world. All characters use motion capture！

title: Kygo 'Carry Me' VR Experience
desc: Join superstar electronic musician Kygo in this incredible virtual reality experience inspired by the hit song “Carry Me.”

title: Kyiv: from dusk till dawn with Lenovo Explorer
desc: VR-тур «Киев с утра и до рассвета» — это: 6 локаций. Более 20 минут контента. Интерактивные игры на каждой локации. Полностью иммерсивное приложение.

title: Köln 3D
desc: Explore parts of Cologne like the historic Old Market in the old town and the Gottfried-Hagen-Street in Cologne-Kalk (the office of the developer!).

title: LabTrainingVR: Personal Protective Equipment Edition
desc: This basic-level course is designed to enhance laboratory scientists' ability to identify how personal protective equipment (PPE) can help reduce the risk of exposure to hazardous materials, prevent transmission of infectious agents, and demonstrate how to don and doff PPE in the correct order.

title: Labyrinth Escape
desc: Labyrinth Escape – очень сложная игра, в которой вам предстоит найти выход из различных лабиринтов, не забывая при этом избегать бомб, мин и других опасностей.

title: Land of Towers
desc: “Land of Towers” - это семейная VR-приключенческая игра, погружающая игрока в удивительный мир Средневекового Кавказа. В этом мире не нужно спешить: здесь нет места обыденным боевым сценам, зато есть место для медитативного исследования и творчества.

title: Lander 8009 VR
desc: The high tech armoured suit VR flight simulator where you flight using the power contained in your gloves

title: LandPort
desc: Today, the intelligent revolution is taking place. Release in the field of art and design and industry has become the focus of research in art and technology majors. The theme of the project is "Creating the future" is a response to the times when the intelligent revolution is taking place.

title: Language Lab
desc: Это не стандартное приложение для изучения языка. Это кроссфит среди приложений для изучения языков. Никаких упражнений с вариантами ответов, никакой грамматики. Только непосредственный контакт с языком, точно так, как вы учили свой родной язык.

title: Larkin building by Frank Lloyd Wright
desc: The Larkin Building build by Frank Lloyd Wright in 1904 is one of the most famous office building off all time. It has been demolished in 1954 and there where no color picture of the building till now. In this VR experience you can walk through the building and explore the spaces, furniture and atmosphere.

title: Laserboy VR
desc: Laserboy VR is a fast-paced, retro-inspired VR arcade shooter. Dual-wield laser weapons, slow down time, and battle relentless waves of enemies across various arenas. Collect power-ups, upgrade your abilities, and chase the ultimate high score in endless arcade action.

title: Last Chance VR
desc: This is a very simple and easy VR game. Just enjoy yourself inside the VR world!

title: Last Hope Z - VR
desc: Разработанная специально для виртуальной реальности, игра "Last Hope Z" дарит невероятный драйв гонки и шутера сразу. Крути руль, стреляй метко, открывай новые пушки, меняй и прокачивай автомобили, и спаси своего четвероногого друга!

title: Last Mage Standing
desc: In Last Mage Standing you are a young mage, standing alone against a horde of undead. Your goal is to survive as long as possible - use your fireballs and weapons to defeat the attackers!

title: Lathe Safety Simulator
desc: Play Lathe Safety Simulator and learn how to operate an industrial lathe. Follow the tutorials, identify all the major lathe parts and turn a work piece.

title: Lavrynthos
desc: Lavrynthos is an independently created VR short, a funny and philosophic story that places you at the heart of the labyrinth of Crete to tell you the story of the unlikely relationship between the Minotaur and his next meal: a girl named Cora.

title: Leave No One Behind: Ia Drang VR
desc: Leave No One Behind is a tactical RTS war game. Experience the hardest battles fought during the Vietnam War in 1965 between the US Army and the Army of the Northern Vietnam for landing zones X-Ray and Albany and for Plei Me special forces camp with incredible level of immersion provided by VR.

title: Led It Rain VR
desc: Play for FREE. Motorcycles, guns, monsters and bikini-babes. Led It Rain VR is first person shooter motorcycle driving racing game. Faster you drive and shoot monsters more score you obtain. Each race track has three laps of horror and adrenaline. Scream!!

title: Lems
desc: Lems is a VR Reverse Platformer. Use the platforms attached to your controller to guide little creatures through their quest to find a new lair. Find the best platforms to use, and show your skill and agility by carrying the Lems safely across 100 levels.

title: Lemuria: Lost in Space
desc: Lemuria: Lost in Space is a unique adventure, full of mysteries, puzzles and shocking discoveries. It's a combination of point 'n click adventure, RPG and survival game.

title: Let Hawaii Happen VR
desc: Visiting Hawaii as a tourist is amazing. But when you get to “Let Hawaii Happen” with a local as your guide, it’s a totally different experience. Start by paragliding into an island of your choice. Then, upon landing, a local will give you the most personal tour of their island — virtually-speaking.

title: Let's Bowl VR - Bowling Game
desc: Welcome to Let's Bowl VR! This is an amazing bowling game for virtual reality with realistic physics and cool graphics. It's a great way to surprise your friends and have fun with the company playing a classic bowling game without leaving your home.

title: Let's Create! Pottery VR
desc: Let's Create! Pottery VR – отличный способ сбросить повседневный стресс и прийти в внутреннему спокойствию. Это творческая практика с мощным терапевтическим и воодушевляющим эффектом, для которой совершенно не нужно выходить из дома.

title: Letzte Worte VR
desc: Trapped in a strange shattered world lost in fog, you take a trip down memory lane. The past not only hides memories of your relationship between you and your brother, but also the suppressed event that may has led to his suicide. Face your deepest fear in this built-for-VR adventure.

title: Levels
desc: Levels is a Virtual Reality First Person Shooter aim trainer experience with the goal to get a better score each playthrough. There are four different levels with different types of targets. The faster you complete the level, the more points you get.

title: Light and Dance VR - Music, Action, Relaxation
desc: Step into a world where music is all that matters. Lay down and relax to watch the colors and patterns change to your music, dance or challenge yourself in one of the music driven games. Many amazing environments and dance floors are waiting for you to dance the night away!

title: Light of Mine
desc: Light of Mine will leave your head spinning in terror. Experience 360 degrees of VR terror as you use your candle to explore an ancient temple with danger lurking in the darkness. Light of Mine is made by nonPareil Studios. We are a studio that provides better futures for adults on the autism spectrum. #PoweredbyAutism

title: Light Tracer (VR & NON-VR)
desc: Light Tracer – VR платформер-головоломка, где игрок – богоподобное существо, сопровождающее принцессу на вершину башни Bellbatis. Пройди все препятствия и доставь принцессу к её цели!

title: LightStrike
desc: Welcome to the LightStrike VR Arena, where you face challengers that are out to destroy you before you can destroy them. Players stand on floating Game Pad areas floating high above the future world surface.

title: Limberjack
desc: Known to chainsaw-wielding loggers around the world as ‘limbing’, the art of stripping felled trees of their branches is exciting, but very dangerous. Welcome to Limberjack! Grab your Husqvarna chainsaw, and pursue your dream of becoming the undisputed greatest limber alive.

title: Liminal Lands
desc: Liminal Lands is a VR journey through a virtual wetland ecosystem. Travel through the salt marshes and see the behaviours of the surrounding elements change and respond with each movement. The artwork sheds light on the unseen dynamics of the wetlands.

title: LIMINAL PHASE
desc: LIMINAL PHASE — это VR-игра в жанре экшен/хоррор в атмосфере 90-х. Деритесь со злобными монстрами, решайте хитрые загадки и исследуйте темные уголки затуманенного видеоиграми разума.

title: Limita Luminii
desc: Joc narativ în realitate virtuală. Marcat în copilărie de trauma Primului Război Mondial, un pictor român trăiește în 1939 panica începerii unei noi tragedii, clacând treptat și evadând în spațiul abstract al propriei arte.

title: Linea VR
desc: Remastered VR-version of Linea, the Game! The goal is to survive for more than 60 seconds on each level, dodging platforms and objects, listening to bitpop soundtracks.

title: Little Awesome Dudes
desc: Experience life living in your mom’s basement, if you aren’t already! Step into LADS, build a tabletop colony, promote capitalism and defeat spooky enemies!

title: Little Witch Academia: VR Broom Racing
desc: Soar through the skies, hunt for ghosts, and become the best witch racer in the world!Experience the thrill of flight across more than a dozen tracks! Cast magic to speed up and slow other teams down as you race to finish first! Purify the school’s restless spirits in ghost hunting missions.

title: LiveOnIdol
desc: LiveOnIdol VR is a casual adventure game using VR controllers. We're going to show Jenny, the main character of a beautiful girl, to a VR controller camera in various places in her particular costume. It is a game that completes the photo book called LiveOnIdol by taking pictures.

title: Lo-Fi Lounge
desc: A lounge for meeting others and vibing out to live Lofi and Retrowave.

title: Load Slinging VR Training
desc: Train your professional skills in Load Slinging VR Training safely and in full correspondence with international standards!

title: Loading Human: Chapter 1
desc: In this VR adventure, your dying father - an esteemed scientist - summons you to his Antarctic base to undergo an intensive interstellar quest: retrieve the Quintessence, an elusive energy source that will help reverse the aging process.

title: Local Paper Small Town
desc: Local Paper Small Town is a 2-player co-op puzzle game about spreading happiness around a quirky papercraft town. Team up with a friend, using a physical newspaper and VR, to discover Smalltown and its charming cast of characters by communicating and relating between both formats.

title: Lockdown VR: Kidnapped
desc: Backpacking was all fun and enjoyable, until you and your friends hitchhiked a ride to your next destination. Will this be your final destination? Alone or with up to 6 players, explore, gather clues, and escape before its too late!

title: Lockdown: Stand Alone
desc: You're alone in an abandoned post-apocalyptic city with a mission to nuke the entire area. Lose track of what’s real by immersing yourself to the unparalleled sense of scale and depth Lockdown: Stand Alone offers. Step inside one of the most immersive and challenging VR games to date.

title: Locked In VR
desc: Locked In VR is an escape room type experience. The player must use his wits and senses to find his way out of the basement and uncover the terrible truth about his imprisonment.

title: Lodestone -  The crazy cave adventures of mad Stony Tony and his encounter with the exploding rolling stones
desc: Lodestone is a single player action spellcaster made exclusively for VR. Hold the power to summon and bend stones at your will, prove yourself against enemies while exploring an underground world and do your best to get to the end! We dare you!

title: LooWarVR
desc: 《LooWarVR》 is a casual shooting game, Background, a boy went to his grandpa’s house in summer vocation, in the toilet he got many unexpected visitors- flies. So the battle began. we exaggeratory restored the battle filed just as we are in the toilet shooting the flies when we were young, to help players to remember their childhood .

title: Lord Darydikilkil
desc: Lord Darydikilkil is a VR experience taking place in a detailed world inspired by MediEvil or Beetlejuice. Unravel your character's dark secrets and fulfill your vengeance! In story mode, the plot is narrated and commented in English or in French, and you can access to all chapters and mini games individually in the unlocked section.

title: LOST CAVE
desc: At an old cave where ancient ruins lie, an unknown life slowly lurks beneath. Put on your gear, become an adventurer, and explore the caverns filled with many secrets.

title: Lost in Spice
desc: Lost in Spice is a cooking game for Oculus Rift in which you play as an abducted human forced to cook Earth food for aliens at the Intergalactic House of Planets. Now you have to dice up weird ingredients, cook them, and submit them in the time limit to get a good score. And if you don't, you'll be vaporized!

title: Lost in the Ocean VR
desc: Lost In The Ocean VR is one of the first survival game, developed specifically for Virtual Reality. Care about your primal needs, craft useful items, start a fire, survive…and build your way out!

title: Lost in the Rift - Reborn
desc: Одна из самых напряженных VR хоррор игр, в которую вы когда-либо играли, которая отправит вас раскрыть ужасную тайну и встретиться лицом к лицу со своими страхами.

title: Lost Legends: The Pharaoh's Tomb
desc: “None have disturbed my slumber and escaped alive!” A voice booms as you realize you're trapped in a tomb with an ancient Pharaoh; you need to escape! Escape VR partnered up with Escape Games Canada to create the ultimate VR escape room experience- Lost Legends: The Pharaoh’s Tomb.

title: Lost Route
desc: Lost Route is a driving thriller video game made for room scale VR.

title: Love Quest VR: Los Angeles
desc: Build relationships with intriguing characters through thoughtfully chosen questions. To win a girl's heart, you'll need to ask all questions correctly and eventually invite her on a second date. Can you unravel her desires and emotions to make her your girlfriend by the end of the game?

title: Lucid Dream Simulator
desc: A very trippy escape room like game filled with puzzles, enemies, and many areas waiting to be explored!

title: Lucky Fish Bread
desc: Wake up the fish bread fairies to learn a variety of menus, satisfy the customers, and protect the store from villains to become the FISH BREAD CHEF of the world!

title: Lucky Night: Poker Games
desc: Exciting Blackjack and Texas Hold'em games in VR.

title: Ludicrous Speed
desc: Run, jump, and wall-grind through an infinitely-generated track in VR! Dodge deadly hazards and collect rings using natural physical movements, surrounded by a surreal pulsating neon world that reacts to whatever music you're listening to!

title: Lumberjack VR
desc: Experience the thrilling life of a Lumberjack in virtual reality with Lumberjack VR, an arcade action game for the HTC Vive. Fight your way through waves of logs, lumber and bombs with nothing but an axe in your hand.

title: Lunapark VR
desc: Lunapark Coaster will take you on a night ride in an old amusement park! It's not for a fainthearted, hold on tight and let's go!

title: Lunar Odyssey
desc: Don your xEMU Spacesuit, explore the Orontius Crater, and Lunar Module in an immersive first-person VR experience with out of this world accuracy and interaction. Follow real-life procedures, launch the Apollo-era Lunar Module, play Space Golf, and experience the moon like never before.

title: Lunar Stone - Origin of Blood
desc: Lunar Stone is an exclusively designed first-person shooting story in VR. Unique dodging system strengthens combat against the dark force creatures. The magical stones will lead you on a magnificent adventure. With the help of your beloved companions you will find the answers.

title: Lust for Darkness VR: M Edition
desc: Enter the Yelvertons’ Victorian mansion and discover the eldritch reality of Lusst’ghaa - now in a more accessible Virtual Reality cut! Inspired by the works of Lovecraft and Zdzisław Beksiński, this psychological horror guides you through an intriguing plot filled with occult themes.

title: LyraVR
desc: LyraVR is a music creation app that offers everyone a unique music-making experience. Make music in 3D and interact with music sequences from entirely new perspectives in virtual reality.

title: Machine Crisis (陨星危机)
desc: Machine Crisis is a sci-fi VR shooter, player fight gigantic bio-mechs with guts and wits

title: Machizzle
desc: Physics bending VR puzzle game - get your ball to the goal, by obeying the laws of physics. Or bending them to your will.

title: Mad Gun Range VR Simulator
desc: Представляем Mad Gun Range VR Simulator! Погрузитесь в атмосферу настоящего современного тира! Теперь Вам не нужно идти на полигон, чтобы пострелять. Благодаря невероятно реалистичной графике, Вам гарантировано полное погружение!

title: Mad Hunting Simulator VR
desc: Enjoy the pleasure and courage of VR hunting in an indescribably realistic and beautiful open world created to be reunited with nature while hunting. Go hunting and pre-entertain yourself in the detailed territory of the hunting house, full details of the objects around you!

title: MADE VR : Interactive Movie - 01. Run away!
desc: One day, JURI gets kidnapped and wakes up in dark basement. Desperately seeking her way to escape, JURI runs into a random guy who is indeed another hostage. And someone is chasing them! Who kidnapped them and why? Would they be able to survive?

title: Madrid Noir
desc: Madrid Noir is a 45 minutes mystery adventure that unfolds across two acts in this VR film. With her uncle declared dead, a disenchanted young woman must delve into her memories to pick up his shadowy trail. Solving the puzzles of the past ain't gonna be easy!

title: MageWorks
desc: Get ready to embark on an epic journey into the mystical world of wizard school loan debt. This fantasy themed staff crafting and spell combat game puts you in the shoes of a mage that works tirelessly to earn gold - and give it back.

title: Magic Blast VR
desc: "Have you ever wanted to fight with magic?" "Magic Blast VR" is an action game to fight with magic in VR! In this game you can create original magic, and fights a lot of enemies. This game features "Magic Form" system. It can set your own form and shoot magic!

title: Magic Combat VR
desc: ファンタジーな世界で自分自身が魔法使いになって、他のプレイヤーと戦う対戦型マルチVRゲームである。 その昔、戦争で人口が激減してしまった世界で生きるために魔法が開拓された。魔法技術が発展していく中、魔法使い達は己が培ってきた能力の優位性を証明する為に競うようになった。

title: Magic Hour
desc: With Magic Hour, get started with VR photography! Take beautiful pictures by exploring an island lit in the perfect light and experiment with an accurate virtual SLR camera that incorporates all the physics of a real camera, in VR.

title: Magic Madness VR
desc: Magic Madness VR is a free-to-play PvP arena game where every spell starts in your hands. Choose your hero, master five elements, and battle online with up to 4 players. Draw, cast, strike, and leave your mark in every match.

title: Magic Tavern
desc: Use your magic spell to destroy the mugs and goblets that materialize in front of you. Hit the hourglasses for some extra time!

title: Magician's Gambit
desc: Chess! Magic! VR! Play this age-old Game of Kings against the best strategic mind in the Kingdom - a master tactician and chess paragon unlike any other. Word is he has never been defeated... Will you rise to the challenge?

title: Magitek VR
desc: Magitek is a journey into the realm of elemental magic. With over 30 unique spells in 4 elements, your skills grow by practicing each class. Each class of magic operates by technique, flowing movement for water magic or strong stiff movements for earth.

title: MagixHome™ VR
desc: MagixHome VR is an experimental home design game where you can use your VR headset to explore and design your own virtual room. You can add new furniture, change wall and furniture material, teleport across the room, or even toss things around.

title: Magnificent Ships: Volume 1
desc: Ship lovers rejoice! This is a collection of six finely-detailed vessels to explore at full-scale or remotely control in miniature form on a boating lake using a VR headset.

title: Magnificent Ships: Volume 2
desc: Ship lovers rejoice again! This is another collection of six finely-detailed vessels to explore at full-scale or remotely control in miniature form on a boating lake using a VR headset.

title: Maid of Sker VR
desc: Maid of Sker VR — это хоррор от первого лица, действие которого происходит в удаленном отеле с жуткой историей из валлийских легенд. Сразитесь с порождением кошмара — Тихими. Не паникуйте… и не дышите!

title: Major League Gladiators
desc: Major League Gladiators is a 2-player co-op shooter for VR. Each taking control of one of two classes, players will have to survive endless rounds of enemies by combining their unique movement and combat abilities as well as maintaining each others resources.

title: Malazard: Magic Defense
desc: Unleash the magic inside you!Purify the demonic legion with a set of powerful abilities.The collapsing world relies upon you, experience what it means to control all Magic!

title: Mall Town
desc: There's not much to do when you're stuck in a small town in the middle of nowhere. In Mall Town you're task is to revitalize your town with the one thing every town needs - a Mall! Add stores to attract customers the use your earnings to expand your Mall.

title: Marble Pop Paradise
desc: Looking for some stress relief? Sit back, relax and explore mesmerizing scenery while solving stimulating marble pop challenges. Let your worries disappear as you travel to different calming environments and work through the levels with your favorite music playing in the background.

title: Mare
desc: A VR puzzling adventure, with a AI companion. You find yourself embodying a mysterious artificial bird. Together you venture on a adventure while unraveling a mysterious narrative and the secrets hidden within the world of Mare

title: Marius
desc: This VR experience is good choice for all who want to see a great artificial cartoon-style environment in VR. The library beams you into new world where Marius, the librarian, lives between a really disorganized magic library. It’s the first demo of the newly founded VR Studio “Granola Studios”.

title: Mark's Magnificent Marble Maze
desc: Unwind from the stress of daily life with this magnificent marble maze. Sometimes all you need is a place to let your mind wander.

title: MarksmanVR
desc: MarksmanVR is an archery action VR game that focused on archery physics and medieval fantasy setting. You'll be playing as "Zachery the valiant mercenary archer". if you are looking for a stationary VR game that solely focused on archery. I would like to invite you to this game.

title: Marlene Betwixt
desc: Marlene is a tense and immersive psychological horror story in which you star as the protagonist Ewan Brody. Ewan is on his way to visit his estranged sister at her remote cottage after hearing the news that his Niece Marlene has gone missing or possibly something worse. . .

title: Marrow Marrow
desc: MASTER YOUR MOVEMENT. VANQUISH THE VERMIN. Experience all the exhilarating high-intensity action you know and love from arena shooters up close and personal in VR. Zero in your aim, hone your movement, outwit the vermin, and soon you’ll be flying through levels leaving a wake of destruction.

title: Mars Flight VR
desc: Mars Flight VR is a helicopter simulator that lets you explore Jezero Crater, the landing site of Perseverance rover on mars.

title: Master of the Tattooverse
desc: Master of the Tattooverse is a story-driven tattoo game that allows you to create and share art pieces in a wacky universe. Enjoy the freedom of creating your own tattoos for extraordinary clients. Use templates or just do it freehand, satisfy your customers and expand your own tattoo portfolio.

title: MasterRunners
desc: MasterRunners is a free-to-play, hand-based movement VR multiplayer game packed with fun and variety. It offers a one-of-a-kind experience that stands out in the VR space. Whether you're into fast-paced action or just looking to hang out with friends, MasterRunners has something for everyone.

title: Match It!
desc: Simple but fun... how fast can you clear the dome of blocks! Built for VR-only, and it's a great game for people who don't like a lot of motion. Requires two controllers.

title: Max Mustard
desc: Max Mustard - это платформер в стиле made-for-VR с 40 уникальными уровнями, 4 нелепыми боссами и 8 мощными апгрейдами. Никаких скучных кусочков! Это идеальное сочетание бонусов от первого лица и классического платформера от третьего лица. Это VR-платформер, от которого невозможно оторваться.

title: Maxi Pool Masters VR
desc: Maxi Pool Masters приглашает вас в игру в веселой и инновационной игре в пул.

title: Mayflower Reflections
desc: Mayflower Reflections is an exciting VR film that explores the story of the Mayflower Voyage of 1620. Hear the captivating story of the Plymouth Colony as you are immersed in their journey. Become inspired as you learn how the actions of these early travellers laid the groundwork for modern America.

title: Maze Run VR
desc: Maze Run is a rogue-like escape runner for VR. 100'000 square feet procedurally generated maze, destructible and paintable.

title: MeCatVR
desc: Be a cat in a cozy witch’s house in VR. Explore at your pace, parkour over the clouds, and unveil the house secrets. Relaxed, family-friendly and no text, no HUD, no pop-ups.

title: Mech League Boxing
desc: Mech League: Boxing is an adrenaline pumping, metal punching spectacular. Get your robot suit ready for action as you rise up the robot ranks. Punch, dodge and fight your way to the title match and the glory!

title: MechaLeague
desc: Высокоскоростная многопользовательская онлайн-кроссплатформенная VR-игра. Захватывающая механика движения с качанием рук и крюками. Несколько вращающихся игровых режимов и регулярные обновления с дополнительным контентом.

title: Meet the Miner - WDR VR Bergwerk
desc: Ever worked hundreds of meters beneath the earth, bent down in dark, narrow shafts, hitting coal out of the walls? Probably not. Now you can: The WDR, Germany’s largest public broadcaster, presents the interactive VR experience “Meet the Miner – WDR VR Bergwerk”.

title: Mega Overload VR
desc: Mega Overload is retro arcade action brought to virtual reality! Join the front lines on the Crystal Asteroid to defend the Milky Way from the endless onslaught of the Mega Bots. You'll collect various power-ups as you fight against a wide variety of robots in this easy to learn but hard to master game.

title: Meme Dragons
desc: In the year 4020 humanity discovered sleeping dragons on Mars. Being the great patrons we are, we hooked them up with some gene therapy and now they’re sentient! Fire. Everything’s on fire.

title: Memory's Abyss (Chapter Zero)
desc: Inspired by the likes of LSD: Dream Emulator and Yume Nikki, explore a liminal, inhuman, and colossal world in this relaxing puzzle platformer. Discover new types of movement as you wander strange yet familiar landscapes, slowly uncovering the story of where you were and where you will be.

title: Mental Asylum VR
desc: Immersive horror experience. Try to get out of it alive.

title: Merper VR
desc: Animate your 3D models intuitively in virtual reality.

title: Metachromium
desc: Metachromium is a spatial app browser that works side-by-side with OpenVR. Run cross-platform spatial apps inside your regular apps! So meta.

title: Metal Assault
desc: It`s finally here! The first episode of Metal Assault! The most hardcore thrilling VR shooter action presented in CES with HTC and PPGUN is finally coming to Steam. Intensive 30 minutes of the real arcade style shooter experience, dodging bullets, hitting explosive barrels, riding crane and fighting against all kinds of vicious enemies...

title: Metal Gunner
desc: Action game without motion sickness even in extreme movements! Battle with various enemy robots and enjoy thrill and action.

title: Meu
desc: Meu lets you explore, record and share your body movements along with unique psychedelic filters and adaptive music that you control with your movements. Create your own body language communication with friends who have VR or share your moves as animated gifs.

title: Microcosm
desc: Build tiny voxel worlds in virtual reality! Microcosm is the game I've wanted to play in VR ever since I saw the Oculus Rift Kickstarter way back in 2012. I picked up a Vive last year, but no one seemed to be making the voxel game I wanted. Finally, I just decided to build it myself.

title: Microwave Yourself
desc: Microwave Yourself is a casual VR puzzle game. Interact with items and combine them in a microwave (along with your head!) to unlock unique visual effects, music, and a message to advance your progress. Find all combinations to escape your torment...

title: Mighty Monster Mayhem
desc: Destroy entire cities, disturb the population, and watch the world crumble as a terrifying monster in Mighty Monster Mayhem!

title: Milkyway Funland
desc: Milkyway Funland is a collection of stunning, exciting, and fun VR games and experiences. The game takes you to the galaxy’s best amusement park in the 31st century. In this space station, everyone can try and experience incredible and impossible things from the past, present, and future.

title: Mind Labyrinth VR Dreams
desc: Mind Labyrinth VR Dreams is an emotional journey through your alternative world in dream-like environments and atmospheres...

title: Mind Muscle VR
desc: Improve your fitness level and mind-muscle connection using virtual reality and the power of visualization.

title: Mind OVR Matter
desc: Ever wanted to stop bullets with your mind? Levitate? Inspired by popular sci-fi movies, Mind OVR Matter gives you the power to control objects with your mind.

title: MINE!
desc: This VR Shooting Gallery single player game has three levels of game play challenging you to defend the mine from invading forces. From your static vantage point you need to shoot as many aliens as possible, as fast as you can. Are you able to stop them stealing your crystals?

title: Minesweeper Peak VR
desc: A port in VR of the classical Minesweeper game from Windows. Remember the digits that tell you the number of adjacent mines? It's the same here, except that adjacency works in three dimensions. See and feel the structure of this 3D grid of potential mines—straight in VR.

title: MineSweeper VR
desc: Знаменитый "Сапёр" теперь в виртуальной реальности! Классический геймплей с потрясающим управлением и отличной атмосферой!

title: Miney Company: A Data Racket
desc: Data mining takes on a new dimension in Virtual Reality!

title: Mini Golf Aeons
desc: Experience the ultimate mini golf adventure! Navigate through desert, encounter prehistoric creatures, and brave the frozen icebergs of Antarctica, all with stunning courses based on real-life greens and precise physics. Enjoy solo or multiplayer modes with friends for a fun-filled VR experience.

title: Mini-Market Simulator VR
desc: Run your own mini-market, starting from a humble corner shop and growing into a bustling retail hub. Stock shelves, assist customers, and manage your store in an immersive VR environment.

title: Minigolf VR
desc: Minigolf VR is a multiplayer social minigolf game for the HTC Vive, Oculus Rift and Oculus Touch. Play with friends, and experience a social gaming like never before!

title: MiniTracks
desc: Racing game where you will be able to drive on mini tracks full of leaps and obstacles with many vehicle models to choose from. In addition to desktop mode, you can play VR mode too.

title: MISKATONIC
desc: Miskatonic is a fantastical VR shooter game. The game will transport the player visually, as well as through their senses, while also navigating a meaningful narrative of the magical world of Miskatonic University.

title: Missing Pictures : Abel Ferrara
desc: For every movie made, dozens of pictures remain missing forever. The VR documentary experience MISSING PICTURES: Abel Ferrara gives the director a chance to tell the story that would otherwise never be told.

title: Missing Pictures : Catherine Hardwicke
desc: For every movie made, dozens of pictures remain missing forever. In the VR documentary experience MISSING PICTURES: Catherine Hardwicke, the American filmmaker tells how she unsuccessfully tried to adapt the cult book "The Monkey Wrench Gang", a precursor to eco-activism.

title: Missing Pictures : Lee Myung Se
desc: For every movie made, dozens of pictures remain missing forever. The VR documentary experience MISSING PICTURES: Lee Myung-Se addresses the place of the father figure in Korean culture, based on the personal history of the filmmaker.

title: Missing Pictures : Naomi Kawase
desc: For every movie made, dozens of pictures remain missing forever. In the VR documentary experience MISSING PICTURES: Naomi Kawase, the famous Japanese filmmaker tells a love story, involving a bicycle road trip and self-acceptance, a project she ended up abandoning.

title: Missing Pictures: Tsai Ming-Liang
desc: For every movie made, dozens of pictures remain missing forever. In the VR documentary experience MISSING PICTURES: Tsai Ming-Liang, the Taiwanese filmmaker looks back on his childhood in Malaysia in the 1960s.

title: Mission: ISS
desc: Take a trip into orbit and experience life on board the International Space Station! In this Emmy-nominated simulation, learn how to move and work in zero-gravity using your controllers. Dock a space capsule, take a spacewalk, and let real NASA astronauts guide you on the ISS!

title: MissionX Beta
desc: A competitive multiplayer free-roaming Shooter game

title: Mixed Estate
desc: Mixed Estate is designed to bring solution for you to be confident in purchase.

title: Mixture
desc: Play as 2 characters at the same time - Alchemist & Knight. Traverse dangerous barren worlds of living metals, ores and crystals to find means of redemption.

title: MLB Home Run Derby VR
desc: WELCOME TO THE ONLY OFFICIALLY LICENSED MAJOR LEAGUE BASEBALL GAME IN VR! Baseball is back for 2026 and it's your turn to step in the batter's box! Crush towering home runs, chase record-breaking scores, and own the derby. Every team, every ballpark, right here and no place else.

title: MOAR - Appeteaser
desc: The sandbox version of Mayhem on a Rainbow - VR. It offers endless fun with arena and wave shooters, spiced with mini games and upcoming new features. A glimpse into the wacky apocalypse where zombies fly in slow motion and chickens lay airstrikes! Saddle up your unicorn and fire up the spaceboat!

title: Mocap Fusion [ VR ]
desc: Create full-body motion capture using custom avatars and VR hardware. Include facecap, lipsync, eye tracking and more. Export entire mocap scenes directly to Blender using built-in automation - from recording to rendering in minutes!

title: Model Kit Simulator VR
desc: a casual simulation where players can assemble and paint simple model kits in VR

title: MOMO.EXE VR
desc: Ужастик, где тебе нужно выполнять различные задания от МОМО, которые получаешь на свой телефон. Главное помните: не пишите МОМО!

title: Monster Collector
desc: Monster Collector is a physics based VR melee combat game. You can fight all kinds of unique monsters in the sandbox. Dragons, Demons, Mythological Creatures. Each creature can bring you different experience. You can tear them apart, slice them to half.

title: Monster Maze VR
desc: Monster Maze VR is a Halloween theme game with monsters that you can shoot. You will be teleported in spooky scenes, where you need to find your way out of the mazes. A HTC Vive is required to play this game.

title: Monster Showdown VR
desc: Monster Showdown is an action packed VR shooter. Increase your chances of survival against an ever growing horde of monster by exploring your environment and strengthening yourself by picking up Perks, Ranged Weapons and Melee Weapons.

title: Monster Showdown VR Prologue
desc: Monster Showdown: Prologue is the first 3 maps of an action packed VR shooter. Increase your chances of survival against an ever growing horde of monster by exploring your environment and strengthening yourself by picking up Perks, Ranged Weapons and Melee Weapons.

title: Moon Landing VR
desc: Ever want to casually explore our solar system from the comfort of your own home? Now you can in Moon Landing VR - Have Fun While Learning!

title: Moonatees
desc: Moonatees is the most realistic VR space manatee simulator. You play as a freshly recruited, clumsy manatee in zero gravity playground. You face mundane tasks and an incoming asteroid that you have to beat without opposable thumbs in a zero gravity environment.

title: Moonshot Galaxy™
desc: Planetary challenges in exotic branches of the galaxy!

title: Motion Serpentine
desc: Motion Serpentine puts you in direct control through your webcam—your hand movements guide the snake in real time. Tackle five solo modes or compete in global 1v1 ranked duels. Activate powers like speed boosts and vision expansion with intuitive gestures.

title: Moto VR
desc: Moto VR - игра о мотоспорте и связанных с ним других развлечениях на мотоциклах.

title: MotoX
desc: MotoX is an immersive motocross/motorcycle racing game where players can experience the speed, danger, and adrenaline of a virtual Motocross experience. Ride through 7 unique worlds that you can explore on your own in time trails.

title: Mount Wingsuit 2
desc: Are you ready to up your wingsuit game to the next level? Mount Wingsuit 2 has everything that made the original great, plus all it needs to be the definitive wingsuit VR app. There is a whole new mountain, new game modes and a vast, open world.

title: Mr.Hack Jack: Robot Detective
desc: В игре Mr Hack Jack: Robot Detective вы можете распутать вереницу загадочных робопреступлений. Решайте головоломки и общайтесь с весёлыми, но довольно бестолковыми полицейскими роботами.

title: Munch VR
desc: Help Munch become the biggest fish in the sea by grubbing your way up the food chain in a virtual reality where big eats small.

title: Mutant Boxing League VR
desc: Welcome to Mutant Boxing League, a single-player VR game built to make your daily workout something fun and challenging. Every opponent has a different style and a trick up their sleeve, so you need to punch, jab, block, dodge and slip to become an unstoppable boxing champion.

title: MuX
desc: Build sound.

title: MVR
desc: Climb, Surf, Or Push off walls as fast as you can through handcrafted levels that test your speed and skills.

title: My RC Buggy! VR
desc: My RC Buggy! VR is a RC car themed room-scaled VR game with an emphasis on part collection -- Mix and match parts and take on different race tracks!

title: My Way VR
desc: A 360 degree video player that enables you to watch videos from all over the world. It detects geographical location of the video, so you can choose the place you want to visit.

title: MYRNEscapes
desc: A single player exploration game, with audio-reactive elements set to the music of MYRNE's Circles EP

title: Mysterica
desc: Experience VR combat as if you were an anime character with special abilities!Draw a magic circle with your own hands! Swinging the sword sends a slashing wave into the air.PvP and PvE VR action game. Enjoy the speedy and tense combat.

title: Mythlink
desc: Mythlink is a VR-only monster battling game. Improve yourself and your Mythlink through training exercises, battle online against others, and emerge with the best Mythlink Unity ever formed!

title: N.a.N Industry VR
desc: N⸱a⸱N Industry is a VR puzzle game where you build a "factory" by placing action blocks in space, arranged so that the inputs move towards the expected output location—their blocks possibly modified, split or combined along the way.

title: Naau: The Lost Eye
desc: Naau: The Lost Eye is a VR action, adventure, and easy puzzle game with physics based mechanics. Explore ancient ruins, sky cities, and canyons.You will have bow, crossbow, various weapons and too many enemies.This game is created exclusively for VR.

title: Nano Shift
desc: Search for secrets and hidden evidence of humanity’s broken past in this tensely immersive Room-Scale VR puzzle mystery game. Navigate your way through houses, prisons, and through time, piecing together clues of who released the Nano Virus that still ravages the surface to this day.

title: Nature Treks: Together
desc: Nature Treks: Together is a place to connect with others using a combination of shape, color, and sound. Or simply relax on your own. Intuitively transition deeper to rediscover the benefits of expression, the value of emotion, and escape into a powerful sensory experience.

title: NatureFly
desc: NatureFly - это опыт виртуальной реальности, который позволяет вам путешествовать по различным фантастическим сценариям. Он содержит 12 различных чудесных сценариев леса, озера, пустыни и каньона, которые вы можете исследовать. Существует также режим открытого мира, где вы можете летать, как хотите.

title: Naughty Or Nice
desc: Help Santa get ready for Christmas by loading children's gifts into Santa's Sleigh using a magical candy cane slingshot. However do not miss otherwise the children end up on the naughty list. Made for the HTC Vive.

title: NBA 2KVR Experience
desc: NBA 2KVR Experience предоставит вам потрясающую возможность выйти прямо на площадку, где Пол Джордж, игрок матча всех звезд, будет помогать вам советами и подсказками. Участвуйте в легких в освоении и веселых баскетбольных мини-играх в виртуальной реальности с доступом ко многочисленным усилениям Gatorade, улучшающим ваши характеристики.

title: NEKROTRONIC VR
desc: Nekrotronic VR is an intensely immersive sci-fi shoot ‘em up. Featuring insane action and creepy ghosts from the feature film Nekrotronic.

title: Nemesis Realms
desc: Be the massive raid boss in VR, smacking heroes around with your awesome powers. Be a multi-headed dragon spewing fire, or an arcane entity wielding the power to tear down worlds. Only possible in the ultimate VR bossfight game: Nemesis Realms!

title: Neolithic Dawn
desc: ВЫЖИВИ В 10 000 ГОДУ ДО Н. Э. ОХОТЬСЯ НА МАМОНТОВ. ПРИРУЧАЙ ВОЛКОВ. ЖИВИ, УМИРАЙ, ВОЗРОЖДАЙСЯ И ПРОДОЛЖАЙ СВОЙ РОД ИЗ ПОКОЛЕНИЯ В ПОКОЛЕНИЕ В ГРАНДИОЗНОМ ПРИКЛЮЧЕНИИ НА ВЫЖИВАНИЕ В ОГРОМНОМ ОТКРЫТОМ МИРЕ. НЕОЛИТИЧЕСКОЕ ПЛЕМЯ — СИЛА!

title: Neon Seoul: Outrun
desc: In a future where the AI we created have become our gods, a new breed of rebel has emerged - The OutRunners. Weaving through seas of automated vehicles, operating off the grid, these rebels risk their lives on hoverbikes built for insane speeds. Welcome to the future. Welcome to Neon Seoul.

title: NervBox
desc: Explore NervBox, the multiplayer VR physics sandbox where imagination is your greatest tool. Continuously evolving with new tools and community-driven features, NervBox invites you to build, break, and reshape the boundaries of virtual reality.

title: Net VR Theater
desc: Welcome to the next evolution of streaming! Gather your community in a hosted virtual 3D cinema-themed space!

title: NetStars - VR Goalie Trainer
desc: From the creators of Goalie Challenge VR comes the Ultimate Goalie Experience! Feel the thrill of goaltending while honing your hockey skills in the most realistic goalie simulator available. NetStars is a virtual reality goalie game designed to improve performance through fun, fast and informed play.

title: NeverBound
desc: NeverBound is the gravity-shifting shooter that brings you mind-bending combat and puzzles in multi-gravity environments. You are as dangerous from below as you are from above. The rules have changed. High ground is relative.

title: Nevrosa: Primal Ritual
desc: Primal Ritual is an Action Adventure Open World game built exclusively for VR. Explore uncharted Mist World, fight unknown creatures and reveal dark secrets that hide in these unexplored lands. Stunning graphics, epic fights, rich and twisted story in unique steampunk word.

title: Nevrosa: Spider Song
desc: Увлекшись последними наблюдениями, Уильям и не предполагал, какое испытание готовит ему судьба. Однажды подарив свою кровь этому миру, Уильям начал древний ритуал — а Магия Крови всегда привлекает самых невероятных существ, пострашнее местной фауны…

title: New Zealand Virtual Debating Chamber
desc: New Zealand Parliament’s Virtual Debating Chamber (VDC) is a Virtual Reality experience that takes you on a guided exploration of the heart of New Zealand's legislature. It is captured through Photogrammetry and 3D scanning for an immersive and interactive experience.

title: Night Of The Living Dead VR
desc: NOTD VR is an exploratory experience that captures the original spirit of the film in black and white, immersing users in a 3D recreation of the film’s farmhouse set. Exclusive interviews with film experts and original cast and crew enrich the experience with insights into the horror classic.

title: Nightcrawler VR Bowling
desc: A bowling game for city slickers who like the night life vibes. Keeps track of your score adding extra points for strikes and spares. Reset at any time.

title: Nighttime Terror VR: Dessert Defender
desc: Nighttime Terror: Dessert Defender is an expanded version of the award winning VR game. Fight your way through six unique levels and defend your desserts!

title: No King No Kingdom VR
desc: No King No Kingdom VR — это уникальная стратегия в реальном времени от первого лица. Управляйте своими слугами напрямую, постройте собственное королевство и соберите могучую армию в виртуальной реальности. Оседлайте драконов и спасите человечество!

title: No Way Out - A Dead Realm Tale
desc: No Way Out: A Dead Realm Tale is a chilling VR experience that takes you to hell and back! Race against the clock as you solve puzzles in this haunted mansion caught between our world and the Dead Realm. Will you escape? Or will you become just another lost soul trapped in Huxley’s Mansion?

title: Nock: Hidden Arrow
desc: Nock: Hidden Arrow is a stealth archery dungeon crawl full of sneaking, shooting, throwing, and the occasional surprise bout of frantic combat. No potions, xp, hit point management, or penny pinching for gear upgrades. The focus is on action, feel, and theme.

title: Noda
desc: Noda is a space to build and share 3D mental models – mind maps, storyboards, network or flow diagrams, project plans – to enhance productivity, understanding and awareness.

title: Non-Virtual Reality Games
desc: VR without the headset. Games without visuals. Each player gets one of the VR controllers, no headset needed. All included games only use vibrations and sound to convey the game, while you play in the real world.

title: Northern Lights
desc: Travel through the Northern Lights, D.Tiffany's song as imagined by Jack Rothwell.

title: Nova Jumper
desc: Jump through different worlds to find your lost sheep.

title: Novus
desc: Gorilla Tag meets FPS. It's that easy.

title: Numbers & Letters
desc: Numbers and Letters. Practice math, solve equations using addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. Improve your literacy skills. Complete the word by finding the missing letter. Earn achievements and rank on leader boards. Numbers Archery and Numbers Whack now available.

title: Nuremberg: VRdict of Nations
desc: VR–детектив от медиагруппы «Россия сегодня» в жанре документального расследования.

title: Oathbreakers
desc: Oathbreakers is a multiplayer fantasy VR RPG that incorporates a unique blend of strategic precision-based realtime action combat, with unrestricted player vs player competitiveness, in a relaxing survival RPG themed environment.

title: Oblivion Tesseract VR
desc: A potential girl with the curse of blood...finally awaked from the slumber...A mysterious cube unveiled all the secrets of her thrilling dreams, Family's history, paranoid space of time and eternal curse…

title: Obscura
desc: A new reality of fear. What you see may follow into your dreams, that will soon turn into nightmares.

title: ObserVRtarium
desc: Interact, immerse, inspire. Step into our virtual museum and explore our collection of amazing Space objects.

title: Oceans We Make
desc: Oceans We Make is a 5-minute, award-winning experience designed for impact. Using stunning visuals and straightforward gameplay, this underwater experience will leave you thinking about our beautiful oceans and what we can do to save them - all in under 5 minutes.

title: Octoshield VR
desc: Ever wanted to throw a shield at your enemies with all your might? Now you can. Octoshield is an action packed arena game in which your only weapon is a shield. Throw it at your enemies to anihilate them, but don't forget to protect yourself with it, or you will get hit by lasers!

title: Odyssey: The Deep Space Expedition
desc: «Одиссея» - это одно- / многопользовательская аудиовизуальная игра в жанре космического приключения, в которую играют на стандартном мониторе или в виртуальной реальности. Цель игры - найти планету, пригодную для жизни, но чтобы добраться туда, игроки должны защитить корабль от астероидных штормов.

title: Off The Chains Disc Golf
desc: Off The Chains is a lighthearted Disc Golf simulation you can play with friends! Unlock new discs with unique stats and customize your own collection. Enjoy a casual game or challenge others to a match.

title: OH？ME
desc: "OH?ME" is a pixel-art puzzle game about growth, memories, and farewells. Play as a ghost exploring the fragments of your past, uncovering hidden clues to different endings. Will you move forward, find warmth in memories, or lose yourself in time?

title: OK Bob
desc: OK Bob is a short atmospheric escape room game. Find clues, read notes, and solve puzzles to ultimately make your escape. OK Bob was created exclusively for VR.

title: Okay, Panic!
desc: Enhanced for the Valve Index Controllers. Unlock tapes, tackle dozens of Microgames and compete in global leaderboards. It's time to panic!

title: Old Town Stories
desc: Old Town, 1927. Ignithium technology has caused a huge leap leading to the dawn of war robots. In a city of smuggling and crime, Rose, an upper class girl, joins the Irish mafia to fight off Rusty Jack's robotic mafia, using advanced weapons in a frantic adventure to write her story in Old Town.

title: Omega Blade
desc: Shoot, slash, dodge and survive to blade combats in multiple kind of challenges to test your skills and claim your place in the Omega Blade hall of fame.

title: Omega Pilot Evolution
desc: Omega Pilot Evolution — это высокоскоростные гонки в футуристическом сеттинге, раздвигающие границы антигравитационных полётов. Участвуйте в захватывающих гонках в VR или играйте на обычном экране от первого или третьего лица.

title: On Closer Inspection
desc: Experience the Australian War Memorial’s collection in VR! View and explore a Mark IV tank from WW1; a Hudson Bomber and an Avro Lancaster from WW2; the Adelaide Class Frigate; and the Bushmaster. Featuring video, audio, photos, and facts to bring to life the history of these important items.

title: On Point
desc: On Point is an arcade-inspired VR first person shooter, filled with Warioware-style minigames. Think, aim, and blast your way to a high score through endless shooting minigames, but don't hit those bombs or you'll run out of lives!

title: One Giant Leap
desc: Fly across the moon in VR with a motion-controlled jetpack

title: One More Delve
desc: One More Delve is a physics-based VR dungeon crawler. Fight, loot, and survive in up to 3 player co-op as you delve into randomized dungeons. Loot new armor and weapons to configure your own playstyle. Choose from one- and two-handed swords, axes, bows, shields and spells to help you in the dungeon.

title: Only DWARVES DIG Proper HOLES
desc: Как дварфу, ваш обязанностью является копать в поисках легендарной кирки. Собирайте драгоценные камни, продавайте и улучшайте. Всё в великолепной виртуальной реальности. Семейное развлечение.

title: Open Blocks
desc: Blocks lets you easily create 3D objects in virtual reality, no matter your modelling experience. Using six simple tools, you can bring your applications to life, create a volumetric masterpiece, or simply let your imagination run wild.

title: Operation Armstrong
desc: Your infiltration team must stop an army of lunar-bots from crashing the moon into our Earth! The field operative, wielding the VR headset, must sneak through each enemy outpost while their team of hackers will assist using their smartphones! Strap in for some Asymmetric-VR-Stealth-Party gameplay!

title: Operation Chromite 1950 VR
desc: Please enter ‘Incheon landing operation’ as crucial reason of victory in Korean war on 1950. You experience all from the landing operation to the end as an unit of landing troops.

title: Operation Pill
desc: Operation Pill is the story of a small and brave pill that gets into your body and saves it from pathogenic bacteria. Arm yourself with an electrostatic shield and a germicidal cannon and save your body!

title: Orb Labs, Inc.
desc: In this room-scale VR action-puzzle stealth game, infiltrate a mysterious company's secret underground lab protected by deadly laser systems. Throw "orbs" to move, hide, defend, attack and survive!

title: Orbital Strike VR
desc: Orbital Strike VR is a tactical space combat sim that places you and up to 3 friends as pilots for Starfall's forward fleet. Fly through space using unique hand-jet thrusters, command powerful fire support, and open a path for your capital ships in this thrilling sci-fi adventure.

title: Orc Assault
desc: Once upon a time all was peaceful and serene in the far off land of Camalon, but the silence has been broken as the Orc hordes have returned to the peaceful kingdom to claim the land that they once held most sacred.

title: Orc Hunter VR
desc: In the roomscale VR wavegame Orc Hunter you have to defend yourself against endless hordes of orcs. To do so you can either use swords in close combat or fight them with a bow or magic staff from a distance.

title: Orch Star
desc: Orch Star is a real-time strategy game set in an immersive space universe where orchs and elves fight for domination. Crush your opponents as you lead a rebellion through the campaign, or challenge other players in online battles to conquer the galaxy.

title: Orion13
desc: Orion13 is an action-packed VR sword combat adventure. Escape a dystopian robot society, take harrowing jumps atop skyscrapers, traverse catwalks, dodge lasers, navigate minefields, and steal a spaceship to find your way home...Compete in the Orion13 Arena for your chance at glory.

title: ORKANA CONFLICT VR
desc: In the distant future, you take over earth's army on the planet Orkana. But the planet is not as uninhabited as expected. In rts based and first person combined gameplay you fight as a commander against the aggressive enemy and conquer the planet orkana.

title: Ornament Express
desc: Investigate strange oddities in Ornament Express, where you’re hired to recover your client’s belongings from an eccentric thief and his train of stolen artifacts. Explore a cabinet of curiosities throughout the train, visit carts holding odd puzzles, odder objects, and find hidden away secrets.

title: OUBEY VR - Samurai
desc: Inside the art - Oubey Samurai In this VR you’re in a tight space surrounded by the deep red of the painting. Discover “the picture behind the picture” whilst also leaving your own tracks in the painting.

title: OUBEY VR – Cosmic Voyage
desc: Inside the art - Cosmic Voyage This VR takes you on a cosmic journey through the universe of OUBEYs paintings. Starting on Earth you are led into the far distant depths of space and back...

title: OUBEY VR – Reise der Monaden
desc: Inside the art – Reise der Monaden This VR takes you to the very centre of the monad universe where you’re totally surrounded by the enchanting diversity of the painting’s elements. And you can touch these elements too, play with them, fly them and let them cavort freely through the depths of space.

title: Outatime
