desc: Those boards don't work on water! Outatime is a futuristic multiplayer hoverboard racing game. Lean-to-move system designed from the ground up for VR. Race against the clock and other hoverboarders in a futuristic setting. Will you claim victory, complete the race, or be out of time...

title: Outbreak in Space VR - Free
desc: Simple, solid, old school, 3D, challenging, intense Virtual Reality game.

title: Outta Hand
desc: Outta Hand lets you embody one of the Hand-People, wide-eyed, hop-happy lab experiments with the power to jump great heights, leap impossible lengths, and shake hands from… really, really far away. Like a whole big dining room away.

title: Oval
desc: Oval takes your skills to a whole new level with thrilling and competitive multiplayer battles. Break your speed limit and go faster than ever without motion-sickness thanks to Oval's unique technology. Create, share or play awesome community maps using the multiplayer level editor.

title: Overboard
desc: A ridiculous VR game about fighting bloodthirsty and increasingly deadly sharks using makeshift weapons. Elevate the battle from the open ocean to the skies, and even into space! The sharks will stop at nothing to devour a tasty human.

title: Overture Music Visualization
desc: Overture Music Visualization is a music visualization experience for Windows, capturing audio in real-time from any source and creating effects that react to your music. It currently includes a stable desktop version, as well as a VR demo that supports the Oculus Rift.

title: OVRDARK: a Do Not Open story
desc: OVRDARK: Dive into the chilling sequel to 'DO NOT OPEN' in this intense VR experience. Explore a cursed mansion, face your former companion turned ruthless enemy, and unravel dark secrets. Can you survive the ultimate horror in virtual reality?

title: Paleo Dive
desc: Explore five prehistoric oceans on desktop or in VR. Photograph 48 species from three perspectives, collect DNA samples, and expand your walk-in aquarium. Upgrade your equipment and return to base before your oxygen runs out.

title: Pane In The Glass
desc: Pane In The Glass takes the genre of VR window washing to new EXTREME heights! Grab your sponge and squeegee, then soak up the fast and frantic action as you splash, wipe and squeak your way up the ever increasing tower of windows!

title: Panic Station VR
desc: Panic Station VR - жанровая игра VR FPS, в которой вы побеждаете демонов и направляетесь к месту назначения в виртуальном современном мире. Попробуйте очистить игру в срок, используя два оружия и специальные навыки.

title: Panzer Panic VR
desc: Сражайтесь с друзьями в динамичной танковой сетевой игре для VR!

title: PAPER BIRDS
desc: Paper Birds is a 30 minute interactive story about a young musician in search of true inspiration. Starring Ed Norton, Joss Stone, and Archie Yates, this VR film offers unique moments of interactivity, inviting you to conduct music, unlock portals, light up the invisible world, and more.

title: Paper Valley
desc: Paper Valley – приключенческая игра в виртуальной реальности, где вы можете проверить свое умение метко бросать бумажные самолетики. Запускайте самолетики в воздух и искусно направляйте их к цели в прекрасном фэнтезийном мире. Раскройте тайну недуга, из-за которого он стал таким безжизненным…

title: Paradise City VR
desc: Welcome to Paradise City - the city that never sleeps. Prepare yourself for an amazing experience full of beautiful girls. Explore area and discover multiple locations where you can meet and watch naughty girls. You’ll feel like in a real paradise... So… are you ready to see all of this?

title: Paralax Vr Aim Trainer
desc: Paralax Vr Aim Trainer is a program designed to help you achieve the best performance in a wide variety of VR games though structured scenarios focusing of the core aspects of aim development (Aiming, Flicking, Tracking and Reaction time) with data to track and support progression

title: Paranormal Hunter
desc: Paranormal Hunter — это групповая хоррор онлайн-игра от первого лица с поддержкой VR. Исследуйте места с привидениями, обращайте страх в смелость и сражайтесь с паранормальными явлениями.

title: Pararea--Social VR for Everyone (Beta)
desc: Pararea is a brand-new VR social product, which has online communication, entertainment, social and other innovative virtual space services.

title: Particulate
desc: PARTICULATE is a VR particle physics sandbox and a creative tool. Create and save beautiful scenes by placing and recording the motions of a variety of tools. Control millions of particles using a highly-optimized custom engine.

title: Party Pumper
desc: Born in the vibrations of music, Party Pumper is a game about parties and for parties! Player's goal is to entertain the audience by mixing a music samples. Combine this with a dance movements and fun party gadgets action, interact with partygoers crowd and pump the party!

title: PartyLine VR
desc: Welcome to the party! Have you ever wished your friends could join in the fun of VR? Partyline VR is a collection of virtual reality experiences where up to 8 people can use their smart-phones/tablets/computers and join in the fun. No app download required!

title: Passengers: Awakening VR Experience
desc: Awaken on the Starship Avalon as it hurtles past Mars towards the Homestead Colony. You quickly realize that there are critical malfunctions onboard and fellow passenger Jim Preston needs your help to fix them.

title: PaulPaul - Act 1
desc: Paul is a VR narrative experience where players try to figure out their identity through exploring surroundings and events in a futuristic and often changing environment.

title: Penn & Teller VR: Frankly Unfair, Unkind, Unnecessary, & Underhanded
desc: Penn & Teller’s F U, U, U, & U включает в себя более дюжины беспощадных трюков, которые поразят ваших гостей и позволят вам посмеяться над их растерянностью.

title: Perceptio
desc: Perceptio is a VR puzzle game set on a small floating Japanese aesthetic island.

title: Percussive VR
desc: Percussive VR is a collection of virtual musical instruments you can play in your home! Learn, practice, perform, or just play — your own creativity is the limit.

title: Personal Disco VR
desc: Enter a disco dance floor like you've never seen it before. It's private and it's personal and you get to choose the dance partner. Choose between a number of different dance partners with their own looks, personality and dance style.

title: Perspectives: Aleppo-Helsinki
desc: What would it feel like if Helsinki was the city of Aleppo and you were there? What kind of possibilities does virtual reality offer to journalism?Aleppo-Helsinki is an immersive journalism pilot project developed together with Yle (Finnish Broadcasting Company).

title: Pets & Stuff
desc: Pets & Stuff – a cute, fun and relaxing game where you become a skilful groomer and veterinarian using a variety of tools, meds and stylish accessories. Let your imagination run wild!

title: PHANTASIA
desc: Escape To PHANTASIA!

title: Phantasma VR Director's Cut
desc: Phantasma Director's Cut is the new improved version featuring easier puzzles, a new ending and a strong narrative where you step into the shoes of a deranged mind searching for the truth about a conspiracy involving a TV Show hosted by an annoying Bunny called Flappy.

title: Phantom Bound
desc: Everhollow is in danger! Fight the haunted halls with your arsenal of gadgets, discover new upgrades and abilities, and unravel the dark secrets of Shadowthorne Manor in this cozy horror, Metroidvania-like ghost hunting adventure.

title: Photo Studio
desc: Фотостудия - попробуйте себя в роли профессионального фотографа!

title: PhyxBox
desc: PhyxBox is a physics based sandbox in VR, construct anything you can imagine!

title: Pinball Evolution VR
desc: Experience the immersion of Virtual Reality Pinball with The Summoning. Designed from the ground up for Virtual Reality the game features cutting edge physics, detailed physically based rendered graphics, full motion controller support and all the features you’d expect from a real Pinball table.

title: PingBall VR
desc: PingBall is an easy to grasp, physically accurate and intuitive crossover between racquetball and breakout.

title: Pipeline VR
desc: Pipeline VR is a hectic virtual reality puzzle game, that pits you against a rising tide of torrential water. With the residents of Pipesville in desperate need for plumbers, can YOU solve their plumbing emergencies?

title: PIRATADO 1
desc: PIRATADO 1Game for HTC Vive and Oculus rift CV 1.Sci-fi war action shooter.Science-fiction space simulator.

title: Pirate Defense
desc: Pirate Defense eschews the traditional tower defense model by letting you get as close as to the action as you dare. Each map features multiple branching pathways which are designed to reward players who make strategic choices in their tower placement and choice.

title: Pistol Master!
desc: As a new Pvt on camp Greenwood you will be tested to sharpen your skills as you quickly try to finish each trial. Good luck Pvt as you try your best to work as quickly as possible.

title: PITCH-HIT ARCADE
desc: A fun and challenging VR Baseball Experience! Catch your own hits! Smash stuff with baseballs! Choose different batting options and so much more!

title: Piwall
desc: Play a neon pinball machine in the arcade room and take a look at the released and upcoming JanduSoft games.

title: Piñata
desc: Could you find empathy with a Piñata? Perhaps you just want to exercise or relieve some stress? The Piñata HTC Vive experience is designed to question your moral compass; what will it be, the chainsaw or the watermelon?

title: PLANET LEV MATADERO
desc: PLANET LEV-MATADERO is an immersive art experience. This oniric universe hosts animated sculptures with sound installations, as well as concerts and live audio-visual performances of artists from all around the world.

title: Planet Smasher
desc: Like puzzles? Like explosions? Well then, let's smash some planets together... Play in 2D with keyboard and mouse, or turn it up to eleven and experience full-on planet smashing glory in Virtual Reality with the HTC Vive or Oculus Rift.

title: Planet-A
desc: Planet A is a purposeful Metaverse. A geo-spatially correct Digital Twin that has been created created for gameplay and education, and getting to know places that may or may not-yet exist in the real world. This is just the beginning - start your journey.

title: PlanetFate
desc: Defend your planet against aliens and asteroids in this room-scale VR game. Set mines, position orbital laser and torpedo defense units and watch out for threats from any direction. Do you have what it takes to prevent the destruction of your planet?

title: Plank not included
desc: One of the BEST experience for your VR parties and for newcomers that have never tried virtual reality before. Plank not included is a virtual reality (walk the plank) experience. You will experience acrophobia (fear of height) Now you can choose between the plank and the tightrope experience.

title: Playing God
desc: An interactive narrative, FMV, sci-fi VR experience.

title: Ploko
desc: Ploko is a relaxing VR experience where each model you build comes to life before your very eyes. With your camera, explore these miniature worlds, discover their hidden secrets and let your imagination run wild.

title: Plunker
desc: This is a (45 to 90 minute) indie VR game where things happen and then you laugh.

title: POCKET CAR : VRGROUND
desc: 'POCKET CAR: VR GROUND' is a game where you make your own AI mini-car. Customize your own car to participate in the game, and win the race through various strategies and 'PIT IN'.

title: PoligonVR
desc: Imagine a virtual world where you can create or be anything you ever wanted. PoligonVR is a powerful community driven sandbox where we give you the necessary tools to turn your dreams into virtual reality.

title: Poly Quest
desc: A Virtual Reality dungeon adventure. How many crystals can you collect?

title: Pond Scum: A Gothic Swamp Tale
desc: VR-платформер на основе диорам. Знакомьтесь с новыми друзьями, съедайте старых и помните: звоните своей маме.

title: Pong It! VR
desc: Pong It! in Virtual Reality! Play a game of Ping Pong with your friends in Virtual Reality! Shape your skills in Training Mode or engage in a scored match against the A.I. Beat your own record and those of others in our Endless Mode or test your reaction speed and accuracy in our all-new Whack-a-Mole Mode!

title: Porsche Hall of Legends VR
desc: The Hall of Legends is an exciting VR brand experience based on momentous stories: Witness iconic moments from the history of Porsche Motorsport, discover the secrets behind the success of Porsche, and collect the Porsche DNA to unlock the new Porsche Formula E car.

title: Portable Farm
desc: A 3D idle farming game for VR that uses a portal to allow users to see and interact with the scene presented inside of it, while inside of any other VR game

title: Potato Party: Hash It Out
desc: Prepare to laugh when you and your friends gather (virtually or physically) for this quick-draw asymmetrical VR game! Be the artist in VR, or guess what's being drawn as one of 1-8 challengers with the free iOS/Android app. Just don't eat the artist.

title: Potioneer: The VR Gardening Simulator
desc: Potioneer: The VR Gardening simulator is a virtual reality game where players tend their virtual garden. Using the 3d visuals and room-scale tracking that HTC Vive provides, players explore the wilderness looking for plants and craft their home using wood, hammers, and nails.

title: Power Link VR
desc: The Power Link game reforms the traditional wire loop game in a rather creative way. This game requires you to pick up and guide the metal piece from top to the end of maze without it touching. In virtual world, we can design mazes unlimitedly which makes the game more interesting and exciting.

title: Power Solitaire VR
desc: Power Solitaire VR is a delightful version of the Klondike solitaire card game that introduces unique game play only possible in Virtual Reality. Play alone, against an intelligent robot, or live multiplayer with others online. It's a social VR game the whole family already knows how to play.

title: Power Tools VR
desc: VR game that gives you an adrenaline rush from chopping, lopping, slicing, dicing or shaping blocks using different power tools. Or you can even take a more artistic approach and see what you can create using the tools to sculpt the block.

title: Power Washer Hero
desc: Use your power washer to move objects, put out fires, and clean grime away.

title: Powerboat VR
desc: Take the helm of a variety of different ocean vessels from small sport boats all the way up to large commercial vessels. Dynamic seas, Day/Night cycle, RADAR, GPS, "IALA A" Buoyage with NavAid/AtoN lighting systems provide a realistic sailing environment. VR & Non-VR modes supported.

title: Pray in VR Medieval Christian Churches
desc: Эпидемия не позволяла нам ходить в церковь молиться. Но у нас все еще есть способ молиться. В церкви VR держите крест в руках, слушайте духовную музыку и молитесь Богу. Личное пространство для вашей души!

title: Premortal VR
desc: Premortal VR is a medieval VR-only game. Explore and survive the procedurally-generated wilderness. Gather resources and craft gear. Build formidable bases. Overcome all boss trials to ascend!

title: Pressure Washer
desc: A VR cleaning simulation game. Grab your Pressure washer and aim for the dirt. Wash all the mud and stress away. Just sit back and relax, sink into happiness and joy.

title: Primal Carnage: Onslaught
desc: An experiment in prehistoric virtual reality combat. Fight hordes of hungry dinosaurs with an arsenal of powerful weapons to make them extinct again!

title: Prison Simulator VR
desc: Погрузитесь в мир Prison Simulator VR и примите на себя роль тюремного охранника. Управляйте сложной жизнью за решеткой и раскрывайте тайны этого беспощадного места. Уважение получают только те, кто умеет проявлять твердость. Каким охранником станете вы, зависит только от вас.

title: Prisoner 518
desc: It's 2049, deep space, on a corporate-run prison. An explosion within not only sets you free, but it also sets rolling a series of events that changes everything.

title: Private Property
desc: Private Property - the brand new VR zombie shooter set at the end of the XIX century Montana provides endless hours of great fun! This coop multiplayer allows players to team up to jointly defend the Private Property from hordes of Zombies.

title: Profundum
desc: Profundum is a virtual reality adventure game set in a steampunk world, in which you are challenged to solve puzzles and discover secrets lurking in a mysterious underground complex.

title: Progeny VR
desc: Progeny is a VR game that takes place during those few seconds between “You Died” and videogame resurrection. It presents players with a sci-fi world, seen only through their deceased character’s memories, and a choice: which of those memories do they take with them into the next life?

title: Project VR Wild Hunt
desc: Welcome to the Wild Hunt Project VR - this is a 100% transfer of the hunting process in VR, with a huge variety of wildlife and a rich arsenal of hunting weapons.

title: Proton Pulse
desc: Get ready for Classic Arcade Brick-Breaking Action from a whole new perspective in Virtual Reality!The entity known as M.O.A.I. has attacked, and the fate of the world is in your hands! You have been chosen to compete in the most diabolical game of atomic paddleball ever to grace the 3rd dimension.

title: PROTON VR
desc: ProtonVR is a VR Roguelite Retro Shooter dream-inspired by classic 90s shooters and movies. Customize your weapons arsenal, buy attachments, upgrades and choose your playstyle. Fight commandos, cyborgs, robots, zombies and much more!

title: Psalm VR
desc: "Psalm VR" – это психологический хоррор в VR, где вы оказываетесь в жутком мире, увиденном через линзу старой камеры. Темнота скрывает нечто невидимое... Оглядывайтесь, прислушивайтесь... оно уже следит за вами. Осмелитесь ли вы заглянуть в тень?

title: PST VR (Primary Surgical Treatment)
desc: “Primary surgical treatment” это виртуальный симулятор, разработанный для образовательных целей. Погружаясь в симулятор с комплектом Oculus VR, Вы, используя медицинские приспособления, можете попробовать решить задачу по обработке раны и помочь пациенту начать восстановление.

title: PsychLabVR
desc: PsychLabVR is a virtual research center that is freely available on Steam. Our first alpha experiment involves simulated social scenes to measure social anxiety. This data will be used to create an empirical foundation for a free, automated intervention to treat social anxiety disorder.

title: Pumpkin SculptrVR
desc: Pumpkin SculptrVR is a FREE pumpkin carver that makes it easy to create and share brilliant Jack'O'Lanterns. Carve at massive scale or shrink down to add tiny details. With Pumpkin SculptrVR’s intuitive tools, your imagination makes anything possible.

title: Punch Bomb
desc: DO YOU LIKE TO PUNCH THINGS?!Punch Bomb is a virtual reality arcade game where you punch things! Two fully playable game modes with more coming during Early Access!

title: Punch Pad Workout
desc: This is a workout plus memorization game, where the player must punch the pads, in the correct order that each combination is called out, over 3 rounds.

title: Puppet Blaster
desc: You wake up in the desert and find yourself surrounded by some not too friendly ghouls. Blast your way out with your twin blasters! A unique control method lets you control a violent little action figure's arms and shoot Ghouls (not Zombies!) right in their dumb looking faces!

title: Puppet Fever
desc: Act like a freak, play with your friends and discover the magic of the virtual puppet theater! This is hot seat multiplayer in VR like you’ve never experienced before. Social party game for up to 4 players locally, or many more on live stream!

title: Puppy Chef Academy
desc: Puppy Chef Academy is a Virtual Reality cooking experience designed to help you learn how to cook without the stress and mess of a real kitchen. Throughout your adventure you’ll cook tasty recipes, learn about cooking, and even make some friends along the way!

title: Purgation
desc: You awake gradually. You are in a dark cell. You are drifting in and out of consciousness between bouts of violent hallucinations. You are physically weak and have no memory of who you are or why you are here. You are alone and you are scared, very scared. The voices in your head tell you that you should be.

title: Purgatory Fell
desc: Purgatory Fell is a psychological thriller set in 1955. Explore the declining mind of a man who cannot sleep. A progression of nightmares reveals hints about who you were, and what you are becoming.

title: Putridness VR
desc: Суровый зомби шутер в Виртуальной реальности с реалистичными механиками, крайне опасными врагами, литрами крови и расчленёнкой. Новичкам и казуалам тут не место.

title: Puzz/LR
desc: Every puzzle you solve restores a lost memory. Rebuild the seven memory-rooms of the Archive's first Archivist in a voice-narrated story campaign — then race your rival ghost through timed trials and Grand Prix championships. Free to play, in VR or on your desktop.

title: Puzzle Island VR
desc: Puzzle Island is a beautiful and immersive VR game. Stranded on a deserted island you will solve various physics puzzles. Take your time in this atmospheric, family-friendly, physics puzzler.

title: Pyramid VR
desc: Classic text based adventure brought to VR life!

title: PyroSlam: VR Table Tennis
desc: Power-Ups, Explosions, and Upgrades make PyroSlam the ultimate VR Table Tennis experience. Compete against players across the globe in ranked online multiplayer or battle a slew of unique AI bosses. Meticulously precise physics make every shot feel like the real deal.

title: PYTHIAN
desc: PYTHIAN is a hard dance XR experience available worldwide. Within the realm of PYTHIAN you will find the hardest live performances that ever took place in VR. Let us reform your reality and witness the power of a virtual escape.

title: Quanero 2 - System Release
desc: Imagine you are a detective in the future, with the best surveillance system ever developed. You can reconstruct crime scenes in virtual reality, move freely and manipulate the time to carry out your investigations.

title: Quantum Legend - VR Experience
desc: A sneak action game,This software only provides visual and survival mode experience.

title: QuantumVR
desc: QuantumVR is a virtual reality game that teaches you to solve small quantum algorithms by placing simple quantum gates. In addition, a 2D version is available.

title: Queendoom
desc: Queendoom is an Archery Tower Defense game designed from the ground up for Virtual Reality. Be the Queen your kingdom needs and defend them, so go get your bow and manage your army in the campaign to slay the demon creatures that want to destroy you and your people.

title: Quest for Runia
desc: Quest for Runia – это расслабляющая VR головоломка. Вы должны уничтожить трехмерные структуры, объединив как минимум три куба одного цвета. Постарайтесь найти наиболее эффективный способ пройти каждый уровень.

title: Quick Draw
desc: Prove you have the fastest hands in the West with this high-speed virtual reality game. Practice your skills, challenge your friends, and prove your worth as the Sheriff of town by defending it from ruffians.

title: Quit Smoking VR Therapist
desc: Do you want to quit smoking? This application can help you to eliminate and erase your taste for a cigarette. Based on the latest knowledge in the field of psychology, neuroscience and hypnotherapy.

title: QuiVr Vanguard
desc: QuiVr Vanguard is a bite sized intro to VR Archery in a polished, replayable, and magical environment. Grab your bow and some friends and jump into the game that was shaped by the VR community.

title: Raatihuone
desc: Raatihuone is a virtual reality experience where you travel through the history of Kajaani city hall and solve interesting puzzles.

title: RacetronicVR
desc: Hover car driving, laser shooting, VR racing fun with a space freighter load of obstacles, shortcuts, power ups and secrets.

title: Racket Pinball
desc: A fast-paced VR fusion of pinball and racket sports! Smash your way through four vibrant arenas - Pirates, Space, Wild West, and Speed - using rackets to hit targets, trigger effects, and master thrilling challenges. Reflexes ready? Let the game begin!

title: RADtv
desc: Стреляй, ешь, бросай, руби, корми, бей, лови и развлекайся как можешь в RADtv — hotseat-игре для VR. Попотей со своими друзьями в борьбе за первую строчку рейтинга!

title: Rage Room
desc: Welcome to Rage Room. Leave your day behind, let loose and release your rage, every last bit of it. With over 50 weapons to fuel your fury our test dummies won’t know what hit them, or at least until they gain sentience. Then it’s time to battle for your life as the dummies hit back in their faceless uprising!

title: Rail Adventures - VR Tech Demo
desc: The Rail Adventures VR Tech Demo is a free product, showcasing the upcoming action game Rail Adventures.

title: Rail Gunner
desc: A sci-fi rail shooter for PC, PCVR and Mac. Defend your train against AI controlled robots which run, fly, rocket and roll in pursuit. Enemies are fully destructible and physically simulated. A variety of weapons and power-ups to unlock.

title: Range Day VR
desc: Too lazy to go to the range? Is your gun in the repair shop? Never fear Range Day VR is here. If you like playing with realistic guns in an open VR sandbox, then this might be the game for you. Range Day VR is designed to give players a taste of what an actual gun range is like while letting players explore iconic realistic firearms...

title: RANGER VS. DRONES
desc: This is a VR study.Your participation begins with our online survey.Please follow the link in the external links section.

title: Rangi
desc: Решайте сложные головоломки, исследуйте затерянные храмы, восстанавливайте древние статуи, избегайте смертельных ловушек и наслаждайтесь радостью полета, когда вы восстанавливаете жизненную силу Музыкальных Гигантов и возвращаете в мир ритм!

title: Rapid Fire
desc: Rapid fire is a virtual reality game that combats the villains as a gunman in the west. Fight quickly to remove the villains and keep the town peaceful.

title: RAYGUN COMMANDO VR 2
desc: a short on-rail reaction shooter in VR

title: RC Flight Simulator 2020 VR
desc: Virtual reality and RC airplanes together in this amazing RC Flight Simulator! This is the most epic and realistic radio & remote control simulator in the world! And it is pretty cool, especially in VR!

title: RC Rush
desc: RC Rush is an exciting arcade racing game featuring radio controlled trucks. Unlock trucks in grand prix cups, win races in campaign mode to unlock campaign events, compete in head to head battles to unlock even more trucks and level up your way to becoming the ultimate RC champion!

title: Reaching for Petals: VR Edition
desc: Rebuilt for VR, Reaching for Petals is a poetic adventure about love, loss, and ambition. You will travel to the peak of the ever-reaching mountain to uncover the true nature of your mysterious and seemingly unguided journey.

title: READY AIM FIRE
desc: What if you are on an elephant toy battling around in your child-hood toy room? Operate your favorite toy tank mechanically but easily to explore through the cartoon-styled world. Search for the targets, and Ready, Aim, Fire!

title: Real Al's Humanity Academy
desc: Real Al’s Humanity Academy combines wacky minigame action, a bizarre sense of humor, and the world’s most human robot to give you a VR party game unlike any other. There’s never been a better time to learn how to be human. Enroll today!

title: Real Fishing VR
desc: Real Fishing VR is a fishing game that travels around the world. You can easily catch over 100 kinds of fish with simple, rhythmic actions.

title: Reality Simulator
desc: This is a 3D simulation game walk through where we showcase how realistic next generation games can be and how far 3D realism has come 1. Walk through a house 2. Walk through a stage

title: Realmcraft VR
desc: RealmCraft — иммерсивное 3D VR-приключение в кубической песочнице, сочетающее творчество и выживание. Исследуйте огромный процедурно генерируемый открытый мир, добывайте ресурсы, создавайте и стройте всё, что захотите. Сражайтесь с врагами, ищите сокровища и наслаждайтесь плавным VR-геймплеем.

title: Realms of Reverie
desc: Realm of Reverie is a short VR exploration adventure game where you navigate the ruins of a sacred village and restore its lost energy after a disaster, inspired by artifacts from Mexico’s National Museum of Anthropology.

title: Reboant - Endless Dawn
desc: Reboant - Endless Dawn, with its huge worldview under Sci-fi backgrounds, cinematic graphics through all game levels, creative gameplay based on VR hardware features, full arm IK performance generated from advanced technologies, targets to be a pioneer product in VR game industry.

title: Red Bull Doodle Art - Global VR Gallery
desc: Where does the mind take you? In June 2017 the best doodlers from around the world were invited for the global finals of Red Bull Doodle Art, in San Francisco, where they could take doodling to the next dimension, literally. The resulting VR artworks were combined into the Global VR Gallery.

title: RED CUBE VR
desc: RedCube - это VR игра, созданная, чтобы помочь вам войти в контакт с вашим собственным сознанием. Погружая вас в самые глубокие уголки вашего разума и помогая исследовать самые большие страхи, RedCube предложит вам удивительный визуально и эмоциональный виртуальный квест, требующий безмятежности.

title: Red Rover
desc: RED ROVER is a Mars driving simulator that uses NASA HiRISE satellite data and imagery to replicate a traversable terrain on the PC for you to drive around and explore!

title: RED: Lucid Nightmare
desc: RED: Lucid Nightmare is a survival horror game. Play as Mercedes, as she tries to piece together a missing persons case and strange, recurring nightmares.

title: reD:起始的旋转之音(The beginning of the Melody)
desc: The main character, Mika, in order to recall her parents’ self-consciousness, signed in a project called reD. The reD official claimed that completing the tasks assigned by the organization could realize her dreams. But the detailed tasks were fairly questionable.

title: Redswood VR
desc: Redswood VR is a virtual retelling of the Red Riding Hood story. In this tale, you play as both Red and then the Huntsman, each separately tasked with making their way through a dying and unrecognizable forest from their pasts to the inevitable conclusion at Granny's house.

title: Reficul VR
desc: Designed Exclusively for VR, Reficul is a rogue-like open world survival horror game with a Hell of an atmosphere. Features realistic weapon handling, magical relics, and a unique enemy. Reficul is a scary apocalyptic survival horror game which will challenge your survival skills in every way.

title: Reflect Horizons
desc: Reflect Horizons is a VR immersive art installation that explores the idea of reality within a virtual world. It borrows from familiar real-world installations, that abstract and manipulate reality, to see what happens when what's being abstracted is not actually real.

title: Reflection
desc: Reflection is a Chinese VR puzzle game. The puzzle is innovative and unique. Players will challenge a multi-dimensional space created by the mirror, and use mirrors to solve puzzles by manipulating the world in mirror and enter it. Puzzles including Logic, Physics, Space, Time and so on.

title: Regenesis Arcade
desc: VR sci-fi shooter set in dystopian future ran by machines. Fighting the deadly killing machines will not be easy. Coming from all directions, covering both ground and air, each enemy requires different tactical approach.

title: Relativity
desc: Relativity will turn your world upside down. Curved surfaces and stairs allow you to walk from the floor, up the walls and across ceilings, shifting gravity and giving you a whole new perspective! Landscape platforms can be moved and rotated using buttons and wheels to transform the landscape and form bridges.

title: Relaxing VR Games: Mahjong
desc: Готовы сыграть в самый реалистичный маджонг всех времен? Выиграйте на 162 досках, находясь внутри потрясающе правдоподобной вселенной с возможностью обзора в 360°! Проникнитесь неповторимой атмосферой знаменитой игры в интерактивной виртуальной реальности!

title: Remnith
desc: Remnith is a chaotic arcade style VR shooter where enemy units feed off of the energy of every shot that isn't lodged directly into them. The more you miss the stronger they get.

title: Renters Revenge
desc: Renters have gone mad and they are coming to kill you. And why would they want to do that? Haven’t you always been a fair LANDLORD? Ah…nope! So call it justice, call it a cruel taste of revenge, or maybe just a terrible nightmare. Either way your life hangs by a thread.

title: Rescuties! VR
desc: Rescuties VR will have you dashing around your living room catching babies and tossing them into rescue vehicles in your mission to save the day. Put on that headset, pick up those controllers and get rescuin’... in Rescuties VR!

title: RESONARK X
desc: RESONARK X is an unprecedented rhythm game that offers a different way to play on the desktop and in VR. In desktop mode, players use 7 lanes + alpha and corresponding keyboard keys. In VR mode, you use a two-handed hand controller to clap your hands and manipulate six strings as you play.

title: Restaurant Simulator
desc: This is a realistic virtual Restaurant where you can order food and chat. Interested in having the restaurant experience from your home? Eat, order, chat and have server wait on you and bring your food.

title: Retronika
desc: Hop on your hoverbike and dive into Retronika, an immersive VR adventure! Fight challenging enemies, master 3D movement and shooting, and navigate vibrant cityscapes. Upgrade your bike, combine weapons, and tackle chaotic missions in this action-packed, story-driven single-player experience!

title: Return to Kurgansk
desc: Return to Kurgansk — игра в виртуальной реальности, в которой вам предстоит выжить в Зоне, населенной зомби и полной опасностей и загадок.

title: Return to Northbury Grove
desc: Return to Northbury Grove — это захватывающая VR-игра, созданная в дань уважения к слэшерам. Игрокам предстоит сбежать из запертого помещения и не стать жертвой кошмарного Убийцы из Призрачного леса. Сможете ли вы остаться в живых, попав в фильм ужасов?

title: RevelationTrestan-尸忆岛
desc: In 2033, a miniature meteorite from outer space crashed in a part of the south Atlantic ocean, when a country near the crash site led the fishing effort and secretly transported it to the isolated island institute near the crash site to study the virus, an event that attracted the attention of many large groups around the world.

title: Revenants: Spirit & Mind
desc: Explore, Investigate, Hunt. Become an Occult Investigator who uses new technology to locate, battle, and capture demonic entities. Solve the mystery of this occult case by exploring the academy and picturing evidence. Revenants is a single-player VR Action/ Adventure/ Horror game.

title: Revoke
desc: Revoke is a VR arcade shooter with breathtaking boss fights. You play as Major Miya, serving in the Rebel army, who has found herself being hunted by her former comrades. Use multiple special modules on your bionic hands to survive---Deformation Canon, Time Freezing! More crazy moves coming soon.

title: Rezzil Index / Lite
desc: Rezzil Index Lite is built on the same soccer simulation technology being used today in soccer clubs around the world to coach elite Premier League level players. Step onto the pitch and give it your best shot in Rezzil Index Lite's drills and challenges - VR soccer just got real.

title: Rhythm Defender
desc: Rhythm Defender is a VR Rhythm game where you need to punch UFO's that are trying to invade Earth synced to build-in music tracks or your own music.

title: Ricerca VR
desc: RICERCA, which in Italian means “search,” is an animated installation experience. In it, we follow the life of a man on a search who travels through different memories and worlds to find something he has lost.

title: Riding Away
desc: Riding Away is a VR music video featuring a new song by Kathy Snax. Listen to the harmonious melody as you walk and discover yourself.

title: RIFF VR
desc: RIFF VR is a one of a kind music role playing experience. Use VR technology to become the guitarist, drummer, or singer of your own band. Customize performance environments and band setups. Stream your gameplay with built in OBS and LIV support.

title: Rilla Shotgun
desc: Slay Demons as a Gorilla with a Shotgun in this 90's Pixel Art Style Boomer Shooter

title: Rings of Harmony
desc: Rings Of Harmony est un jeu de puzzle médiéval-fantastique VR dans lequel vous interagissez avec votre environnement pour mener à bien votre quête. Attirez des objets, lancez-les et tracez des lignes pour sauver le monde de la destruction dans un environnement immersif.

title: Rinlo
desc: Rinlo​ is an immersive third person puzzle adventure game designed for VR. Follow Agatha in her epic quest. Guide her through dioramas of this steam-powered city, and unlock the truth hiding behind its familiar, winding streets.

title: Rival Rides
desc: Rival Rides - the ultimate VR PARTY game! Compete, laugh, and mess with your friends in a 4-player online setting.Uncover ridiculously fun games. Who will dominate the competition? Strap on your VR headset, hop on your ride, and dive into a world of hilarity and excitement. Ready, set, ride!

title: Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition
desc: Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition is an immersive simulation game where you can become an equestrian champion from the comfort of your home. Raise, care for, and bond with your dream horses on a scenic ranch, then experience the thrill of the race track and the joy of horse riding!

title: RoadkillerZ
desc: RoadkillerZ is vehicular combat game with unique Kant control system specially designed for VR. Find yourself deep under our cities where secret world of violence and mayhem run by the masters of the undead. These half crazed drivers live for one thing: winning the Scumball Derby!

title: Robo Boop
desc: Roboboop is a VR game for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. Boop the floating boxes with your high-tech wands to set the right colour and send them flying away into the sky. Relax, take your time and listen to some music, or set a timer and try to beat the clock.

title: RoboDo
desc: RoboDo is a singleplayer/multiplayer VR puzzle game with plenty exciting features. Bunch of levels for you to complete, some are fast, reaction based and others will make you concentrate and think. Beat levels alone or join your friend for some Co-Op action!

title: RoboSports VR
desc: RoboSports is a vast collection of online multiplayer sports games!Our first game, “Crazy Dodgeball”, is all about attacking your opponent with an energy ball to score points. Dodge your opponent’s throws or go for the catch and land a devastating counter-attack!Play in an arena like no other!

title: Robot City Stadium
desc: Robot City Stadium is a competitive multiplayer disc-combat sport focused on skill, nuance, and mastery.

title: Robot Incursion
desc: Robot Incursion is a virtual reality wave shooter for SteamVR. You can't get away with just standing still and you will need to physically move around, taking cover and dodging bullets. You will need a play space of at least 2 x 1.5 metres.

title: Rock and Roots
desc: Rock and Roots is a captivating VR journey where you wield the power to dictate the ebb and flow of battle. Summon your enigmatic guardians of the woods with a magical hand to face the challenges. Conjure spells, dive into the magic world and reclaim your rightful place on the throne!

title: Rocket Armor
desc: Rocket Armor is the most realistic and exciting flight combat experience in VR today! It features a completely new type of flight control system and maneuvering capability – it’s like really flying using two huge rockets strapped to your arms!

title: Rocket Explorer
desc: Rocket Explorer is a rocket viewing experience, where you can view the rockets of the world with your own eyes. Also in Virtual Reality! Launch rockets, compare them side by side, and take them apart.

title: Rocket Swords
desc: FLY THROUGH THE AIR USING A UNIQUE MOTION SYSTEM, NEVER BEFORE SEEN IN VR!

title: RockTop
desc: Rock Top VR game is an online gameplay that adds multiplayer chase to traditional VR climbing gameplay. In addition to conquering different terrains, players can also play different roles in multiplayer mode to obtain more gems

title: Rockytown
desc: What happened to the people of Rockytown? Have fun at the village fair, with 4 exciting mini-games.

title: RogueViz Collection
desc: The discovery of non-Euclidean geometry has changed how we perceive the world... but geometry goes even more exotic than that! Games of various genres designed for Thurston and space-time geometries.

title: RollerCoaster Legends
desc: Прокатитесь на потрясающих американских горках и окунитесь в греческую мифологию: этого аттракциона вы не забудете никогда.

title: RollerCoaster Legends II: Thor's Hammer
desc: Experience Norse mythology in an unbelievable seven minute non-stop rollercoaster ride made for virtual reality. Meet giants, elves, trolls and a fire-breathing dragon while riding the coaster of a lifetime.

title: Rollercoaster Xperience
desc: Enter a new world where the music will join you in incredible fallings that will test your stomach... a new dimension of the experiences full of secrets and characters that will shoot up your adrenaline and make that you wish to enjoy this wonderful travel again and again... Be brave! Live the xperience!

title: RollerForce
desc: RollerForce is a high intensity VR Roller coaster/shooter mix. Battle your way through 10 tracks in two world locations, SHOOT TO SURVIVE!

title: RollerGirls From Beyond
desc: RollerGirls from Beyond brings side scroller action into VR. Skate, Jump, Ride and Stomp your way to save the Cows of the planet Bovina from Dr Creepy and his Alien Army.

title: ROMBIE
desc: Modular robotics & a Central Command was suppose to usher in prosperity, yet something went terribly wrong... ROMBIEs now scour the artificial wasteland for credits, modules & purpose. You, the Elite Recovery, spawned after a routine check on society started to fail...

title: Roomscale Coaster
desc: Roomscale Coaster is an intense, fast paced game designed to take full advantage of your playspace. Dodge, duck and collect to increase your high-score as your fly through the air on a sci-fi platform.

title: Roomscale Tower
desc: Roomscale Tower is a photogrammetric experience built for the HTC Vive. Become a knight of the Middle Ages and leave in search of wealth through towers filled with traps. Fight skeleton's army in intense survival mode. Climb mountains, catch piglets, throw knifes or relax at the tavern.

title: Roost
desc: Roost is a First Person Exploration Game where you attempt to unravel the mystery of your new apartment.

title: Rosebaker's Icy Treats - The VR Iceman Sim
desc: Rosebaker's Icy Treats is a virtual reality game that sends you into space to sell ice cream! You’re in charge of Rosebaker’s mobile icecream parlor, selling their famous icy treats to travelers in transit from around the galaxy!

title: Rotten Apple
desc: Join forces with up to 3 friends in Rotten Apple, a thrilling VR co-op zombie shooter! Face the apocalypse, tackle high-stakes challenges, and battle relentless undead hordes. Are you ready to conquer post-apocalyptic NYC together?

title: RPG Merchant
desc: Ever wondered what life is like for a merchant in a role-playing game? Wonder no more! Experience life behind the counter in RPG Merchant, a VR game that lets you serve customers and face unexpected challenges with the help of a mysterious wizard.

title: Rubber Ball VR
desc: Rubber Ball VR is a virtual reality game where you can satisfy your need to throw cool trickshots, all without the mess of having to go and fetch your ball again.

title: RunVR
desc: Experience the best way of moving through the virtual world by running, jumping, and climbing your way through RunVR.

title: Russian VR Coasters
desc: Испытайте 4 вида различных VR горок, которые подарят вам много новых удивительных ощущений!

title: Ryte - The Eye of Atlantis
desc: With a little help from the Historia Time Travel agency, set sail to the city of Atlantis for a VR Myst-ical adventure : Fill in the sandals of an Atlantean who recently broke out of prison, wield supernatural powers, solve esoteric puzzles and try to prevent the End of Atlantis !

title: SaberStyle
desc: Sabre style VR, a fighting game that makes you nervous and stimulates adrenaline soaring。

title: Sacred Four
desc: "Ziegwen" a godly sword on a chain which, once you release it, flies through the air like a flash of light to destroy evil. Master control of "Ziegwen" to fight monsters in this new style of VR action game!

title: Sacred Siren
desc: Sacred Siren is a psychedelic virtual reality experience created for ᔕᙡᓮᙢ ᔕᗢᘎᒪᔕ's debut album, "𝔾𝕠𝕕𝕕𝕖𝕤𝕤", released on Business Casual.

title: Saga of the Void: Admirals
desc: Saga of the Void: Admirals is a full, space based rts in vr!

title: Salary Man Escape
desc: Устали от работы? Выплесните свой гнев и разочарование в сатирической и захватывающей игре Salary Man Escape. Это увлекательная головоломка. Включает обычный режим и режим VR, а также эксклюзивные уровни для ПК.

title: Salmon Man
desc: Salmon Man is a unique VR platformer where armed with nothing but a paddle, you will climb upstream and explore a beautiful, absurd world filled with humor, physics-based challenges, and rage-inducing obstacles. Now with multiplayer!

title: Saloon Showdown VR
desc: Saloon Showdown VR is a virtual reality shooter based in the old west. Can you make your way through the town and stand toe to toe with the deadliest gun in west? Make use of cover, exploding barrels, moving carts & your trusty old 6-shooter and return peace to this lawless town.

title: Saloon VR
desc: Saloon VR is an arcade VR bartending simulator, where you focus on serving alcohol to your impatient customers as fast as possible, while also contending with other tasks behind the bar.

title: Salvage Op
desc: Включите серию операций по спасению на глубоководных кораблях, которые были захвачены. Этот шутер виртуальной реальности использует механизм телепорта, который дружелюбен с теми, у кого есть болезнь движения.

title: Samurai Sword VR
desc: It's Edo Japan. The country is in chaos. Awaken your inner samurai as you dash through and across thrilling locations, using shuriken and your katana to cut down obstacles and foes!

title: Sanctuary VR (Also contains non-VR version)
desc: "Sanctuary VR" is a first-person puzzle solving and exploration game designed for Oculus Rift, it has a strong narrative that is fully voice acted. The game is a seated VR experience played with a controller.

title: Santa Simulator
desc: You ring the mysterious bell. Next minute, you're riding in Santa's sleigh, dropping presents in chimneys. Welcome to Santa Simulator where kids squeal with delight and adults become kids again. This game is gifted free when you buy Richie's Plank Experience

title: Santa's Visit
desc: Discover you inner Santa Claus in this Virtual Holiday Experience! Take a ride across the world and then through Mistletoe County, leading up to the Smiths house. It's up to you to decide if they have been naughty or nice this year. Choose the right gifts and cause some mayhem before you leave!

title: Scary Buddies
desc: A multiplayer murder party game in VR, taking place in a mysterious mansion hiding many secrets...

title: sCATter
desc: sCATter is the world's first VR shooting rhythm game with a new feel. Test your rhythm with music and compare rankings with people all over the world. Easy difficulty levels that anyone can enter, to Extra difficulty levels for rhythm game masters!

title: SCP The Beginning
desc: Игра ужасов и выживания от первого лица в разрушающемся объекте. Исследуйте зоны, читайте сомнительные отчёты и выживайте среди враждебных сущностей; соблюдение процедур может быть столь же смертельным, как и их нарушение.

title: SCP-087 VR Survivor
desc: Virtual Reality survival rogue-like game based on the SCP-087 lore. You are scientist from SCP foundation inside SCP-087. How long you can survive? Can you find the way out?

title: Scrap Attack VR
desc: Enter the mysterious caves of Botanika, where the Boltheads are hell-bent on the destruction of the ancient Botanite Crystals. Your mission: Defend them at all costs, against unrelenting waves of frenzied robots. How far can you push yourself to protect the crystal from the robot onslaught?

title: Scraper: Gauntlet
desc: Scraper: Gauntlet is a VR RPG wave shooter featuring heavy weapon customization, unique missions and substantial enemy modifiers. You're an elite HRF Operative tasked with retrieving a highly classified weapon blueprint from a secret AI facility to fight back against the Humechs.

title: Sea Fishing Simulator
desc: Go fishing in the North Sea!

title: Secrets of Antares
desc: Explore a breathtaking alien world in VR with just your jetpack and curiosity. No combat, no goals—just peaceful walking, flying, and soaking in the beauty of Antares. From tranquil beaches to sudden storms, it’s a serene escape shaped by stunning views and shifting weather.

title: Seena VR (Beta)
desc: Seena VR [Beta]: The game features a Deserted map, characters, weapons, and game modes.Feel the VR Experience, Grab your weapon, wear your Armor, and prepare for war.

title: Self-knowledge VR
desc: A virtual reality experiment that aims to promote awareness on the benefits of self-knowledge to our brain. We present a series of tasks based on real-world psychological theories that collect and interpret your data while playing, providing you with insights about yourself that you can further explore.

title: Sensorium Galaxy
desc: Sensorium Galaxy invites you to experience the uncharted realms of PRISM. Immerse yourself in a revolutionary 30-minute set featuring tracks written, crafted and produced exclusively by Carl Cox for ‘Intermundium,’ his debut virtual show.

title: Shadow BoXR
desc: Shadow BoXR is a rhythm boxing game intended to make working out fun. Punch the targets and dodge the obstacles all while rocking out to your favorite music. This is your workout built by you for you.

title: Shadow of Valhalla
desc: Visceral physics-based VR combat set within an ancient realm of Viking lore and mystic powers! Discover magical runes and unlock spells while battling evil forces throughout eternity!

title: Shadowgate VR: The Mines of Mythrok
desc: The first book in the Shadowgate Saga, Shadowgate VR: The Mines of Mythrok brings the hit adventure series to virtual reality! Step into the fantasy world of Kal Torlin like never before and immerse yourself in this exciting action/adventure game made for PCVR!

title: Sharknado VR: Eye of the Storm
desc: Fight your way through swarms of hungry flying sharks in Sharknado VR! Slice them with the Chainsaw, shred them with machine guns or explode them with the RPG!

title: Shennong: Taste of Illusion
desc: This is a VR Real-time Animation. You can walk freely in this world. Shennong is an adventure story about a hero of prehistoric China, which describes a battle between Shennong and a beast from his illusion.

title: Sheriff Exam
desc: Pass the Sheriff Exam and enjoy a fantastic Wild West fps game in VR. Shoot your way through the selection process and become the next Sheriff! This is a challenging arcade game for testing shooting skills and your brain with different puzzles and memory games. Be precise and play smart!

title: Shibainu - VR Katana Simulator
desc: ShibaInu is a virtual reality (VR) Katana simulator. This game mainly focuses on proper Katana handling, physics interactions and cutting mechanics. Precise and controlled cuts are performed on Tatamis (traditional Japanese floor mat) rolled into a cylindrical shape.

title: Shinrin-yoku: Forest Meditation and Relaxation
desc: Welcome to Shinrin-yoku: Forest Meditation and Relaxation. In this VR experience, you will be transported to a northwestern forest, surrounded by trees, plants, insects and animals. Use the tools at your disposal, a stick and flashlight, to interact with the world around you, in day or night. Try it, it's free!

title: Ship It
desc: Fast-paced block stacking VR fun in a playful factory setting. Pack a box with colorful shapes, then ship it to earn your wage. Filling VR boxes is physically satisfying as you grab blocks, rotate them with you hands, and smash them home.

title: Shoot Mania VR: Fun Zombies
desc: В этой увлекательной и динамичной игре вам предстоит защитить ваш урожай тыкв от зомби тыквоедов, которые повадились навещать ваш огород!

title: Shoot The Zombirds VR
desc: Shoot The Zombirds VR is a gallery shooter starring undead birds, pumpkins and a crossbow. Excellent shooting fun for all skill levels.

title: Shoot! VR
desc: Shoot! VR is a first-person shooter simulation game using virtual reality. The game simulates the environment of an indoor shooting range. The game has different modes and offers a choice of different weapons.

title: Shooting Arena VR
desc: The VR Arcade Shooting Range Mix speed and accuracy to turn into a crazy shooting expert! Shoot, move, turn around, shoot again. Comfortable. Zero motion sickness.

title: Shooty Skies Overdrive
desc: Сбегите из этой аркады в Shooty Skies Overdrive, увлекательный VR-шутер, разработанный специально для VR. Уклоняйтесь, стреляйте и прокладывайте свой путь сквозь красочные ретро-миры и толпы смешных инопланетян.

title: Shopkeeper Simulator VR: Refreshed
desc: Manage your own shop in this VR tycoon game! Buy delicious items and sell them at a profit. Unlock helpful equipment to reach the end of the day!

title: Show Must Go On
desc: SHOW MUST GO ON is an easy to play rhythm VR game. Jump onto the stage and make your music show. Feel the beat. Hit the drums. Puncture the bubbles. Play with the rhythm. Fill the stage with colors and lights. If you like energetic music, rhythm, and drums, this game will give you a lot of fun!

title: Shuttle Commander
desc: Take command of the Space Shuttle as it embarks on various missions to the Hubble Space Telescope. Fly the shuttle in a full landing simulation based on real physics and flight dynamics.

title: SickWay VR
desc: Sickway is a realistic VR game where you drive a two wheeled electric vehicle in the heights of the city with the goal of getting down. Good advice: Avoid falling down! You can use your creative abilities in track editor, or you can become the fastest among your friends in multiplayer maps.

title: Siege Hammer
desc: Siege Hammer is an entry-level VR game created for the entire family to enjoy. Uniquely-designed for comfort, it delivers hours of fun-filled playtime. Are you the hammer…. Or the anvil?

title: Sign Here: _________
desc: $1,000,000, all just one signature away. Your job is simple; sign the contract. A job much easier said than done.

title: Silent Mansion : Part2
desc: Silent Mansion is a mystery place with a beautiful atmosphere. This game is a puzzle adventure game. You will find clues in this historic mansion and chase a witch!

title: Silent Slayer: Vault of the Vampire
desc: Become a vampire slayer and eliminate powerful sleeping monsters — an endeavor undertaken by only the bravest souls. In this jumpscare game with elements of horror and puzzle, you must destroy a clan of ancient vampires by carefully disarming their coffins’ defenses with the help of your guide.

title: Silicon War:Blitz
desc: Рогалик VR шутер с мехами и пулевым адом.Вы будете управлять своим мехом сквозь шквал бесконечных пуль и врагов! Каждое сражение - это решающее испытание ваших навыков реакции и стратегического планирования. Непрерывно улучшайте и модернизируйте свой мех, пока все противники не будут побеждены!

title: Simple Boxing Drills VR
desc: SImple Boxing Drills VR is a boxing fitness app that casually simulates the experience of hitting the mitts in a boxing class

title: Simple LOTO Simulator
desc: This Simple LOTO Simulator was developed to provide employers of any size, with a cost effective method to verify their employees' understanding of the Energy Control Procedure usually required under OSHA's Lockout/Tagout Standard.

title: Simple Snooker
desc: This is a two-player Snooker game, that runs on computer desktop or virtual reality device.

title: Singularity
desc: A Virtual Reality Art piece, exploring the Law of accelerating returns and the development of A.I.

title: Singulive
desc: Singulive is the gateway for artists and audiences to the world of virtual reality with music as the main protagonist. A place designed to enjoy the live experience and take a step forward with spectacular possibilities.

title: Six Feet Under
desc: Find yourself under ground in this selection of Halloween party mini games, designed to spook and scare as you explore three underground levels. Start by finding yourself in an open grave with options to enter The Crypt, The Pyramid and The Mine. Battle rising water levels, mummies and giant spiders.

title: Skader
desc: A sci-fi MOBA with unique ice-skating locomotion and a trail generator device to catch your enemies. Use power-ups to gain an advantage, coordinate with the team, and fight for your universe in the ultimate multiverse battle for the ancient artifact to save your universe from incursion

title: Ski Doom VR
desc: The classic ski survival game is back - and this time, in virtual reality. Pick your ride, hit the slopes, and outrun the mountain monster as long as possible. Compete for the #1 spot on the global leaderboards

title: Ski Jump VR
desc: Ski Jump VR is a ski jumping game for PC, and also HTC Vive and Oculus Rift that will include at least 10 hills.

title: Ski Jumping Pro VR
desc: Ski Jumping Pro для ВР пощекочет вам нервы спусками по снежному трамплину так, как не сделает ни одна игра. Наслаждайтесь ультрареалистичными ощущениями с ВР и испытайте несравнимое чувство высоты и скорости.

title: Skiing VR
desc: Ski anytime you want on perfectly designed slopes in VR. Find your way to the finish line in this arcade ski simulator and prove that you're the best skier! Enjoy different game modes alone or with your friends

title: Skills Hockey VR
desc: Discover the world of VR Hockey! Shoot some pucks, make some saves, and play the body hard!

title: Skinscape
desc: In this VR artwork, UK based artist Ian Truelove scales his paintings up to gargantuan proportions to show the beauty of the pixels they are made from.

title: Sky Squadron
desc: Jump in the bloomin' gunner seat as Keith Koala to save your mates & their island paradise from the evil invading empire! Sky Squadron offers a unique Aussie twist on shooter classics like Star Fox and Panzer Dragoon, while adding thrilling & immersive VR gunner gameplay.

title: Sky Tower
desc: Sky Tower is a relaxation VR experience. Whenever you are tired after a long day at work or just need a change of scenery, the tower is an ideal place for retreat. A personal place where you can just lay back, enjoy the atmosphere and watch your favorite videos.

title: Skydive Sim - Skydiving Simulator
desc: SkydiveSim now enables you to experience Skydiving and BaseJumping from your headset. You can choose from Airplane, Helicopter, Balloon or BaseJumps.

title: SkydiVeR
desc: "All you need is 20 seconds of insane courage and I promise you something great will come of it" - B. Mee SkydiVeR is the first parachuting simulator specifically made for VR. Launch yourself into the sky like never before!

title: SkyLeap
desc: SkyLeap is a non-stop VR parkour action game where your only goal is to climb higher and higher. Use jumps, a grappling hook, and telekinesis to move through a dynamic vertical world designed to keep your momentum flowing.

title: Skytropolis
desc: Build the world's first SKYTROPOLIS, a vertical mega city where you control its design, architecture, economy, and sustainability! Play both on desktop or in virtual reality.

title: Slackline VR
desc: Experience slackline like in real life in this built-for-VR game. Balance over rocks, trees, water, houses and much more. And remember - don't fall down! Can you get across all levels? I warn you, just like in real life, it's not easy.

title: Slappy Board
desc: Отпустите пар в Slappy Board! Погрузитесь в различные темы с многочисленными сценариями. Оставайтесь спокойными или теряйте контроль, выбор за вами. Но не забудьте весело провести время и ШЛЕПАТЬ!

title: Sleep Tight
desc: Sleep Tight - это быстро развивающаяся игра в жанре хоррор. Выживайте волны монстров, если можете, улучшайте различное оружие, чтобы помочь вам. Помните, обращайте внимание, слушайте внимательно и не позволяйте им поймать вас!

title: Slime Lab
desc: Become a slime scientist in your own VR lab and play with the most satisfying slimes! Experiment with fluid physics to create endless combinations, using unique colors and charms for your next customer.

title: Slow.Bullet VR
desc: Survive, Shoot, and Win! A co-op multiplayer zombie Survival Game, now in VR!

title: Slurpies FREE
desc: Snake, slither, SLURRPP! Chill out with your friends in this free multiplayer arcade game. Relax as you grow your colorful space snake by eating lots of food and avoiding playful baddies and other players. How long can you grow your Space Slurpie?

title: Smackitball
desc: Smackitball is a VR racket sport.

title: Smashing The Battle VR
desc: In the year 2085, a huge multiplex construction site becomes a victim of a massive scale hacking incident. Due to the hack, the construction robots start to attack the workers on site. What could have possibly happened?

title: Smashing time
desc: Симулятор разрушения VR, уничтожьте все в музее, овальном кабинете, ресторане или простой квартире! Посеять хаос и выпустить дьявола наружу!

title: SMUSH.TV - Competitive VR x PC Action
desc: The first hyper-competitive PC vs VR action-strategy game, bringing the spirit of competitive fighting games into VR through fast heart-thumping gameplay. Remote Play Together enabled!

title: Sneaky Bears
desc: Sneaky Bears — аркадная стрелялка, где вам нужно как можно быстрее остановить банду злобных плюшевых медведей, которые планируют захватить весь мир.

title: Sniper Rust VR
desc: Sniper Rust VR is a heart-pounding and immersive shooter that puts players directly behind the scope of a skilled marksman. Prevent the rise of a dangerous insurgency in a thrilling virtual reality game complete with real-world effects, realistic weapons and challenging threats!

title: Snow Games VR
desc: Snow Games VR is a single-player Virtual Reality snowball fight in a winter wonderland. Make and throw snowballs to hit targets, while under attack from the ever moving enemy snowmen.

title: Snow Scout
desc: In this exploration adventure on skis, which is experienced in virtual reality, you start a one-week stint as a volunteer for the Snow Scouts. Fixing up a remote ski resort, all alone high in the mountains, nothing can go wrong - right?

title: snowboarding
desc: Snowboarding is a 3D action skiing game. You can enjoy snowboarding just at home with it. There are two types of tracks for skiers to choose, which have different difficulty. Come here and have fantastic snowboarding experience!

title: Snowday
desc: Engage in VR snowfights that capture real snow play like no FPS (First Person Snowbrawler) you've played before! Throw, dodge, and sneak your way to domination of the neighborhood snowfield.

title: Snowrifters VEX
desc: This is a Virtual Vehicle Exhibition in a museum like environment where you can teleport around and look at the models. A Showcase Room for the vehicles, some props and weapons from the race game Snowrifters. Get an impression of the unique design from Timon Sager.

title: Soldier Sortie :VR Agent 006
desc: Soldier Sortie:VR Agent 006 is a shooting adventure game developed with HTC VIVE. The game will bring you exciting experience of VR technology. Breaking through the virtuality and reality, experience the intense gunfight and puzzle adventure in the virtual world.

title: Soldiers Of Freedom
desc: You are a soldier fighting for the freedom in the heart off fierce combat. Conquer different battlegrounds alongside your comrades. Realistic combat, fast paced action and advanced AI system will help you feel like on real battlefield.

title: Solitaire VR
desc: Play your favorite solitaire games in the luxury, warmth and grandeur of the Baron's ancient mountain keep. Klondike, Freecell, Yukon... they're all there - each deck placed around the magical keep. Explore & find your favorite spot to curl up & play. But be careful the keep is old and has secrets...

title: Sommad
desc: Sömmad gets you on an adventure in a self-overlapping VR maze to find a diamond with help of your friends outside VR. In this local multiplayer, walk freely in a large VR maze, make decisions with friends, and challenge your guiding skills using a mazy map!

title: Sonic Hunter VR
desc: The Sonic Hunter is our latest production, a kind of VR music rhythm game. Painting style of low poly is lovely and cool, it will take you into a fairy tale world.

title: Sort 'Em
desc: "Sort 'Em" позволяет проверить свои навыки сортировки, став фруктами сортировщик в местном продуктовом магазине! Держите магазин на складе по сортировке яблоки, апельсины, клубника и многое другое в контейнеры!

title: Soulace
desc: Soulace takes you on an audio-visual journey through the afterlife. Inspired by the Tibetan Book of the Dead, it provokes reflection on the mystery of dying. Immerse yourself in magical worlds and uniquely sculpted meditative environments!

title: SoundLites
desc: Use your Lite tool to build and explore a Sonic Light landscape.

title: Soundscape XR: 2024
desc: Exploratory musical metaverse hybrid reality warp world.

title: SpaBerry VR Experience
desc: The world's first and only hot tub VR experience, by SpaBerry!

title: Space Ball VR
desc: Play a fun game of Space Ball with your friends! Football and basketball: any mode you like is available in this sporty and dynamic game.

title: Space Bit Attack
desc: Space Bit Attack is an entirely new and captivating take on a retro arcade classic that gives you the space pilot experience you’ve always wanted from the cabinet games of yesteryear. Each level of this virtual world features a swarm of aliens poised to attack.

title: Space Dance Harmony
desc: Space Dance Harmony is a VR dance rhythm game where you replicate real dance choreographies with your entire body to play. Immersed in breathtaking environments shaped by the sound and aesthetics of popular dance music, Space Dance Harmony is your space to get free and to dance.

title: Space Dragon
desc: Take control of a pair of hatchling space dragons and blast your way through the cosmos with our innovative move-and-warp system. Fight the robotic armadas that have enslaved the massive beasts of the galaxy! Destroy suns, battle epic bosses, and leap to new systems through mind-bending wormholes!

title: Space Jones VR
desc: Space Jones is a FPS VR game. Story: At an era of human space colony expansion, a bounty hunter (the player) accidently picked up a mysterious treasure named “Star Box”. Therefore, the bounty hunter has been targeted by multiple space pirates. A major war will be triggered at any time.

title: Space Maze
desc: Это настоящий VR-экшен полный загадок, отличной графики и чувства полета! Добро пожаловать в Космический Лабиринт!

title: Space Merchants: Arena
desc: Space Merchants: Arena is a cross-platform online multiplayer game where futuristic spaceships engage in intense dogfights.3 game modes: Free for all/Team battle/Capture the Artefact.4 different maps: Faarlands, Tristar, Jupiter, Naussike system.Online leaderboards

title: Space Needle VR
desc: Set at Seattle, Washington's most iconic man-made landmark, the Space Needle VR experience offers an opportunity to explore the famous structure like never before.

title: Space Ninja Simulator
desc: Its a Space Game Simulator but your also an Ninja. Oh, and you'll destroy thousands of asteroids with your ninja powers!

title: Space Panic: Room Escape (VR)
desc: Space Panic VR (Room Escape) is a VR Escape Room unlike any other you've seen before. Set in the future aboard a space station, the game will challenge players to solve multiple complex puzzles in order to escape.

title: Space Slingshot VR
desc: Have you ever wondered how Angry-birds-like view might look in VR, And from the First Person perspective? You will definitely have a lot of fun with this game shooting rats as if in reality, Now it comes, Let's go.

title: Spacecats with Lasers VR
desc: Spacecats with lasers VR is a wave shooter where you can prove to be the su-purr-rior feline in the galaxy by destroying not so claw-ver rat enemies with your mighty lasers! Customize your spacecat and choose perks to improve it as you get to harder waves.

title: Spacefolk City
desc: Spacefolk City — прикольная и несложная игра в жанре строительства города. Постройте парящий город в космосе, украсьте его различными абсурдными предметами и сделайте космических жителей счастливыми.

title: Spaceteam VR
desc: A chaotic, cooperative party game! Shout technobabble at your friends until your spaceship inevitably explodes. Attempt to follow randomly generated, incorrectly assigned instructions. Work together… as a Spaceteam!

title: Spacetours VR - Ep1 The Solar System
desc: Discover space like never before in this aesthetic and inspiring experience. Travel to the eight planets of the Solar System. Features stunning visuals, bold sound effects, support of motion-controllers and level streaming with no loading screens for total immersion.

title: SpaceWalker
desc: You are about to be part of the SpaceWalker team. Let’s explore the the multiple dimensions yet to be known, obtain the knowledge and power of the cosmos and save the universe!In Early Access, Solar System Explorer, you will steer a spacecraft to visit planets in the solar system,.

title: Spartan VR
desc: Spartan, созданный исключительно для VR, переносит вас в самый эпицентр древнегреческих мифов! Станьте настоящим греческим героем и сражайтесь в реальном времени с мечами, щитами и копьями против легендарных существ Аида!

title: Special Delivery
desc: Dodge cars, dogs and tornadoes as you grow your subscriber base and expand your paper route in this arcade inspired newspaper delivery game.

title: Spectre
desc: Fright or be frightened in Spectre, a haunted new multiplayer horror game with full VR integration. Now with Oculus CV1 Support!

title: SpectrumGames
desc: Старая добрая Мафия в виртуальном пространстве, максимально приближенная к оффлайн версии. Станьте ведущим, пригласите игроков и выстраивайте иговую атмосферу как в реале! Или найдите открытую комнату, чтобы присоединиться в качестве игрока.

title: Speedy Gun Savage
desc: Speedy Gun Savage is a first person shooter VR game where Wolf, the hero of the game is an intergalactical bounty hunter and travels to different planets to collect bounties. The game has three different planets with several enemies and three main boss.

title: Spellbound
desc: Spellbound is a virtual reality game which lets you enter into storybooks and be one of the characters. Stop living a boring life, put on your robe and wizard hat, and become a real wizard!

title: SpellPunk VR
desc: In SpellPunk you will unleash extraordinary powers and turn into a mighty magician who will cast spells by drawing magical symbols in the air with his/hers own hands. And yes, you will be immersed in a stunning, abstract world, experiencing fast-paced magical duels.

title: Spermination: Cream of the Crop
desc: You may have beaten off others and came first a thousand times, but you've never tasted the sweet Cream of the Crop. This sequel is harder, faster and will blow your crusty socks off! Choose from 3 difficult leagues: Hand, Mouth and the coveted Cream Pie! Crack the egg & unlock your bundle of joy!

title: sphereFACE
desc: sphereFACE is a retro-styled 3D vector shooter, wrapped around the inside of a sphere. An unashamedly abstract shooter that ranges from slow, strategic sniping to frantic rock-dodging action, with roguelike elements of exploration, progression, discovery and permadeath.

title: Spider Fear
desc: Immersive Virtual Reality game where you fend off attacking spiders.

title: Spirit Realm
desc: Take a trip into another dimension in Spirit Realm! In this VR short, artist Matthew Reed brings his vision of spiritual worlds and astral planes to the immersive space of VR. No controllers necessary, experience by standing, sitting or laying down. Audio design by James Raymond.

title: Spooky Night
desc: Dive into "Spooky Night 🎃", a kid-friendly FPS! Trapped in Grimelda's haunted cemetery, defend your candy and battle eerie foes. Sequel offers new zones & challenges. Remastered for richer gameplay. Can YOU conquer the night? 🌙🔮👻

title: Spuds Unearthed
desc: Spuds Unearthed is an experimental combination of an action game and a real-time strategy. The game is distinguished by a polished setting, humor and a unique idea for the gameplay.

title: Squingle
desc: Squingle is the ultimate Mixed Reality 3D puzzle game. Navigate glass-like mazes called ‘Squingles,’ guiding orbs while avoiding edges and collecting points. Discover why it’s a critically acclaimed 5-star masterpiece!

title: Squishies
desc: Исследуйте миниатюрную трехмерную вселенную и помогите заплутавшим жмякам найти дорогу домой.

title: Stacksquatch
desc: Stack a surreal landscape with this oddly satisfying VR action-puzzle game. The higher it goes, the bigger you grow and the more you can pick up! Pile your surroundings with coordination and timing, feel the suspense of defying gravity, and find peace in the ancient art of stacking.

title: Stage Presence
desc: «Короли сцены» — это не игра про успешных рок-звезд. Это караоке-игра в жанре комедия/ужасы, где тебе придется силой голоса и интеллекта завоевать расположение капризной публики!

title: Star Chart
desc: Самый масштабный опыт виртуальной реальности – исследуйте Солнечную систему в этом красивом приложении с точным моделированием в режиме реального времени.

title: Star Legacy VR
desc: Star Legacy VR is an immersive virtual reality shooting game that incorporates intriguing Roguelike elements into gameplay. Players assume the roles of interstellar guardians who venture across diverse planets and traverse through various time zones.

title: Star Rage VR
desc: Star Rage VR is a FPS game that fights alien in outer space,it included a thrilling story with a great plot, exploring and many other diverse form of gameplay. You and your friends have to fight numerous aliens and reclaim the skies.

title: Star Rangers VR - Free Demo
desc: This free demo of Star Rangers VR is a short adventure set in orbit around the earth. The full Star Rangers game, to be released in five episodes (to start) has more missions, vehicles and adventures! Help us hit 30,000 demo users to kick off funded development.

title: Starbear: Taxi
desc: A fast-paced, VR-native title that really delivers. Race a spaceship taxi around Starbear’s tiny, futuristic city to deliver busy bear passengers to their desired destinations. Bears gotta be places too, you know?!

title: Starcaller
desc: Starcaller is a fast-paced, puzzle solving, score attack virtual reality game. Solve multiple unique puzzles as fast as possible, complete the ritual before time runs out, and become the Starcaller. It's easy to pick up and play, hard to master, but fun for everyone.

title: Starfighter Arduxim
desc: Strap into the cockpit of your Arduxim fighter and take on enemy starships in this first-person tactical space shooter. Harks back to the classic Wing Commander games. Playable in VR or on monitor.

title: Stargaze
desc: Gaze into the stars as a curious astronomer in this VR adventure of magic & science. Manipulate a strangely powerful telescope and influence a galaxy of planets and their inhabitants for the better. Take photos and conduct intricate research to uncover the deepest cosmic secrets.

title: StarMaker VR
desc: Start your music journey in StarMaker VR, sing to release the real you and dance with your souls in the melody of the music! You will enjoy what you have changed in this all new experience!

title: Starman's VR Experience
desc: Experience Starman's amazing journey through our solar system in Virtual Reality. See a 'live' view from the cherry red sports car or move in time to see future events.

title: Stars
desc: 《Stars》 - это игра VR о звездах. Вы можете расслабиться, посмотрев на небо и послушав историю каждого созвездия.

title: Starway: BaRaider
desc: This is a sci-fi VR action shooting game. Mechanical frenzy is coming! Players have to teleport to survive from thousands of bullets.

title: STAY ALIVE MY SON (VR): A True Story About A Father's Relentless Search For His Son
desc: Winner of the Producer's Guild Innovation Award, Stay Alive My Son is a virtual reality feature based on a true story of a Cambodian genocide survivor and father haunted by his past, to first-handedly experience an inspirational journey about family separation and the power of redemption.

title: Stealth Labyrinth
desc: Stealth Labyrinth is a first-person shooter game based on stealth mechanics. In a sci-fi labyrinth, the player must proceed, room after room, finding the right way until the end, before the time is out and everything explodes and avoiding all guard robot.

title: SteamHammerVR - The Rogue Apprentice
desc: London needs a Hero! Can you help save old London Town? A truly immersive story adventure staged in the iconic locations of Victorian London. In your steampunk exo-suit you are armed with ingenious 19th Century weaponry, Seek and Destroy all the foes... You are the SteamHammer!

title: Steampuff: Phinnegan's Factory
desc: Phinnegan's Factory is a frantically fun action shooter for the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. Jump, dodge, duck and shoot your way through endless waves of mechanical monstrosities and multiple levels of madness.

title: Stellar Cafe
desc: A first of its kind experimental title, where your voice is the controller. Chat with quirky robots, help solve their problems, and shape the story through real-time conversations in this cozy sci-fi cafe. From the co-creator of Job Simulator.

title: Stellar Echoes
desc: Это простое путешествие, в котором космический корабль, целевая планета является основной областью опыта.Для SteamVR необходимо установить режим OpenXR.

title: Steve's Pub - Soda on tap
desc: It's all about service! Welcome to your new job as a bartender! Steve's Pub is an amazing bartender simulator game for virtual reality with not too realistic physics and a lot of fun!

title: Stilt
desc: Хотите прыгать выше облаков? Желаете увидеть красивые места? Жаждите приключений? Надевайте ходули и прыгайте навстречу приключениям в новом увлекательном VR-платформере Stilt!

title: Stolen Steel VR
