desc: An room-scale VR arena swordfighting experience featuring one-on-one fencing with AI opponents.

title: Stranger Things VR
desc: Experience the world of Stranger Things from the never-before-seen perspective of Vecna as he explores unknown realities, forms the hive mind, and enacts his plan for revenge against Eleven and Hawkins.

title: STRAYLIGHT
desc: Swing, Soar, Die, Repeat! STRAYLIGHT uses a revolutionary movement mechanic to fling you through beautiful and deadly cosmic playgrounds. Designed from the ground up for comfortable VR movement, STRAYLIGHT is a new kind of platforming experience!

title: Street Champ VR
desc: An endless road crossing experience taken into the Virtual Reality realm.

title: Streetball VR
desc: The classic streetball arcade sport is back! Experience the pleasure of basketball when you step into the street one on one with the top finest in basketball action and play in different streets with beautiful backgrounds in VR.

title: StressOut
desc: Chaos. Havoc. Destruction. A race against time and evil, twisted, yet entertaining AI living in your wristwatch forces you to use weapons and incredible superpowers to destroy everything around you. Compete against leaderboards or simply use destruction to relax...

title: Struggle For Survival VR : Battle Royale
desc: You will fighting on this island full of civilization remains, face to hostile human and zombies, no one was spared.

title: STUMPER
desc: STUMPER presents a new paradigm for experiencing music in VR.Pick up your shields and crash crystals flying through the air to the rhythm.

title: Stunt Corgi VR
desc: You are the parent of one daring corgi that dreams of being the most famous stunt pet in the world! Place your props, build the course and direct your corgi's routine. Call “Action!” to watch the stunt unfold. It won't always go the way you plan, but that's the fun!

title: Subject 264
desc: You wake up in a room with a total black out, a lot of creepy noises can be heard, you want to leave but this place doesn't want to let you go. Your only chance to escape will be to remember your past and to overcome any obstacles placed on your paths. Will you escape ?

title: Submarine VR
desc: Submarine VR takes you on a adventure-filled underwater simulation experience! Dive deep and cruise through the endless uncharted nature of the ocean and you will see clownfish, dolphins, penguins and mysterious sea animals. Get close to the sea surface and sail in the open sea with your cruise ship

title: Submerged: VR Escape the Room
desc: Trapped inside a room filling with water, you will decipher secrets and tools to aid your escape. Hold your breath and dive for answers within a submarine deep below the ocean.

title: SUM
desc: Through SUM VR, try to survive on another uninhabited island. Here you can build buildings, eat food, and do whatever you want to do. Buy now and get all future updates for free.

title: Summer times Afternoon
desc: "Summer times Afternoon" is a story to the VR puzzle game, players will be able to create a VR room to spend a number of wonderful days, through time, back to the space 90 years of China, to experience the humanities and customs at the same time Using the controller to pick up items in the room to find clues to understand the lo

title: Super 3D Table Tennis
desc: Overview: The game is as it says, Table Tennis (or Ping Pong). The game is VR only.

title: Super Amazeballs
desc: SUPER AMAZEBALLS is a VR dexterity puzzle game that'll twist your brain! Using both hands: Tilt, spin, and rotate 3D 'amazeballs' to roll a pinball through mind bending tracks!

title: Super Cat Herding: Totally Awesome Edition
desc: A wacky physics sandbox game where you herd super-powered kittens, fight aliens, and destroy the world to solve the mystery of the missing catnip!

title: Super Kaiju
desc: Super Kaiju – the greatest and most anticipated sports tournament on the planet is here!

title: Super Ultra Monster Smash!
desc: The city-smashing VR experience you've been waiting for. Go on a room-scale RAMPAGE through New York City! Smash buildings, play with humans, and show Lady Liberty what real freedom looks like!

title: Super VR Trainer
desc: Unleash your power shooting your opponents with your bow, deflecting blaster shots with your laser swords, surviving an infested hospital, being the king of basket or surfing with your hoverboard. Welcome to Super VR Trainer!

title: SUPERHYPERCUBE
desc: SUPERHYPERCUBE is a retro-futuristic spatial reasoning puzzle game. Control a cluster of cubes, rotating it as it approaches a wall in front of you - fit your cluster through the hole in the wall to increase your score and advance to the next wall!

title: Supermarket VR and mini-games
desc: With this games you can go shopping! You will feel for the first time what future purchases will be like from your home or workplace. You will have to buy the products from a shopping list, with money and a limited time. And you will also have to avoid colliding with the other people who are buying.

title: Survival Simulator VR
desc: A sand-box virtual reality survival game. See if you can survive stranded on an island with only the objects you can scavenge or craft from resources available on the island.

title: Survival VR
desc: “Survival VR” is a Virtual Reality zombie shooting survival game for the HTC Vive. The player has to kill waves of zombies to survive. Shot them in the head and mind your bullets. Struggle for survival!

title: Survive The Dark
desc: Survive The Dark is a story-driven, physics-based first person simulator in a post-apocalyptic mountain overrun by zombies. Clinging to life, you find yourself in the mountain full of zombies. Your goal is to survive in the depths of a nightmarish environment using truly intuitive means to escape.

title: Swarm
desc: "SPIDER-MAN WITH GUNS — this is what VR was made for!" SWARM is a fast-paced, arcade-style grapple shooter, with quick sessions, bright colorful worlds and globally competitive leaderboards that will take you back to the glory days of Arcade Games.

title: SWARM 2
desc: Swarm 2 is a roguelike shooter built VR with a unique movement mechanic, global leaderboards, and weekly challenges. Endlessly replayable and infinitely challenging. It's like Spider-Man with Guns!

title: Sweeper Zero
desc: They still come! Alien base is invaded by alien species. As the last hope of mankind, take up your arms, sweep them out !

title: swingmania
desc: swingmania is a note slicing VR rhythm game focused at competitive ranked play, customizability, ultra high performance and cats!

title: Synth Ninja
desc: Synth Ninja brings together the unforgettable Synthwave theme of the 80's with ninjas and offers a unique VR experience. Your goal in the game hit the targets with shurikens. Each target have random blue and red colors. You have to shot with shuriken that match the color of targets.

title: Synthesis Universe -Episode 00-
desc: Welcome to Synthesis Universe, the host of a musical civilization, their technology is music. -Story- mixes harmonics and aesthetics Every notes, every beat is alive and surrounds you.

title: SYREN
desc: SYREN is an intense survival horror game in which you must use your wits to navigate through a labyrinthine underwater base. In episode 1, you must use stealth, and solve puzzles to survive, while in episode 2, you must blast your way through the deadly swarm of syrens stalking you.

title: System Override
desc: System Override is a first-person, single player heist game where you play as a hacker clearing a route through a variety of traps that block the way of your non-playable companion on the field.

title: SZEN
desc: "The Symphony of Mysteries!" SZEN is a musical Virtual Reality safe-space, where we can leave our hectic, busy lives for a moment and enter a world where you experience a place of melodic tranquility and wonder. Sit back, relax, let SZEN take you away!

title: Szybowcowa '87
desc: Travel back in time to the 1980s and explore a secret printing house of Fighting Solidarity nestled within a residential block on Szybowcowa Street in Wrocław's Gądów district. Immerse yourself in virtual reality and feel the pulse of the underground movement during that tumultuous period.

title: Taekwondo Demonstration Team Simulator
desc: The Taekwondo Demonstration Team Simulator brings you a new experience. You can decorate the demonstration team by configuring the cool Taekwondo movements as a show stage.

title: Tahul
desc: Tahul is a virtual reality experience based around a fictional lost world reminiscent of ancient, Moroccan culture and was created to highlight the winners of the SIGGRAPH 2020 VR Theater.

title: Taiko Frenzy
desc: Taiko Frenzy: A rhythmic adventure that lets you drum to the beat! Master the art of Taiko drumming in this captivating VR rhythm game.

title: Tainted Fate
desc: Play as a demon in this story driven slasher horror game. Summoned from the depths of hell into our world, use your demonic abilities to gruesomely take down everything between you and your path back to the underworld. Be the horror.

title: Tale of the Fragmented Star: Single Fragment Version / 星の欠片の物語、ひとかけら版
desc: Help a stranded girl escape with just your eyes in this puzzle game designed specifically for VR. From the stationary convergence point between the two worlds, use the "Focus Lock" to tell her the steps she has to take in order to put the star back together.

title: Tales Of Glory 3 : Fists of Legend
desc: “Relive the 80’s beat’em up spirit in VR! Tales of Glory 3: Fists of Legend brings 10 maps, 13 combat styles, and mystical powers to Sho Ren’s epic kung fu adventure.”

title: Tales of Sintra: The Dark Vortex
desc: Tales of Sintra — это VR-экшен-приключение с сражениями на мечах, с щитом и луком. Исследуйте древние руины, решайте головоломки и сразитесь с Тёмным Вихрем в улучшенной версии для PCVR с обновлённой графикой.

title: Tank Hero VR
desc: Come and enjoy the Tank VR journey!!!

title: Tank Mechanic Simulator VR
desc: Tank Mechanic Simulator VR отличается высокой детализацией, реалистичностью и нацеленностью на достоверное моделирование работы механика танка.

title: Tanks VR
desc: Tanks VR is a multiplayer VR tank simulator set in the events of World War II. Immerse yourself in engaging 5v5 battles with other players and see them react to your maneuvers. The intuitive controls allow you to operate a tank on your own. Pick a tank from your garage and use it to fight for the axis or allies.

title: TankVR
desc: TankVR is a open world arcade tank game, where you have to destroy all hostile tanks. The objective is to destroy all tanks on the map. After the game is finished, your score is now shown in the leaderboard. Challenge your friends, if you are brave enough.

title: Target React Force
desc: Target React Force is a realistic tactical VR experience where you can Train, Plan and Execute your ideas, with gameplay focused on randomisation and replayability. Use your tactical skills to navigate through the Live Scenarios and Training layouts to neutralise the targets and save the hostages.

title: Taxi Driver Life VR
desc: Experience the thrill of real taxi driving in Taxi Life! Navigate through city streets, encounter diverse customers and tackle various tasks as you manage your taxi.With realistic graphics, dynamic weather and detailed vehicle controls, immerse yourself in the world of taxi driving like never before

title: Team Up VR (Beta)
desc: Immerse yourself in the world of ultimate war between Terminators and Humans. Choose your hero from different playable characters. Fight and claim your victory in an epic VR death match.

title: Tech Support 2077
desc: You are an AI sent to battle an overwhelming tide of computer viruses and malware - in VR! Shoot them with your explodo-revolver, or slash them down with waves of deadly energy from your plasma sword, and if they get too close you'll have to beat them back with your bare hands!

title: Technolust
desc: Technolust is a fully realized cyberpunk dystopia presented as an interactive visual novel. Unravel a mystery involving mass suicide and corporate control... or just hang out in the arcade and play mini games. This is your world now. Trust your TECHNOLUST.

title: Teknedia
desc: Teknedia is a first person arcade platforming game. Jump your way through dozens of vibrant levels, and unlock the mysteries behind this alien world. Compete against your friends and the world for best times, and seek out hidden, difficult to obtain collectibles.

title: Temple of Aluxes
desc: Have you ever wanted to explore a lost temple? This is your chance. Find the treasures and escape the Temple of Aluxes by solving various puzzles and challenges.

title: TendyTrainer
desc: TendyTrainer is a VR app made for goalies to refine their skills in VR space. The goal of TendyTrainer is to provide the most realistic off-ice training environment possible. It is designed to build good habits that directly translate to the ice.

title: Tennis Arcade VR
desc: Tennis Arcade VR is an arcade tennis game featuring many interesting game modes, realistic physics, global leaderboards and even a PvP mode where you can prove your tennis skills to the world!

title: TennisVR
desc: The first VR tennis game on steam featuring Newtonian physics! Experience the feeling of tennis in your home.

title: TEOT - The End OF Tomorrow
desc: IMPORTANT!!! This is a demo prerelease beta version.Game guide:To start Choose the language and level of difficulty using Vive Controller. Direct it to "Enter Virtual Reality" and hard pull the Vive trigger button twice. The game will start when the visual start.In game need to know: Press the grip to hold the gun or dagger.

title: TERMINAL VR
desc: Experience Earth's final descent into Armageddon in Virtual Reality as extreme weather violently spreads destruction, death, and a twisted virus across most of the planet.

title: TERMINUS
desc: Embark on a psychedelic 30 minute VR journey into a mysterious universe of alien architecture, populated by humanoid clones and cryptic symbols.

title: Tesseract VR
desc: Tesseract VR is a puzzle game placed in a fantastic environment.

title: Thalassic
desc: Thalassic is a VR underwater horror survival game where you explore a planet a few thousand years after its evacuation. Explore the depths of this new world ocean with your capsule communicator George. Encounter different creatures as you go deeper and find what lurks down in the depths.

title: The 18th Floor
desc: In Ancient Eastern Mythology, miscreants and sinners who have lived a life of evil and deception are sent to “18 Floors” after death. Their souls are doomed to suffer an endless torture, forever cursed with pain and anguish, as punishment for their wicked lives.  In 1930, a young Eastern woman was brutally murdered on a train.

title: The Amusement
desc: An abandoned amusement park, a tangled memory, a family shattered by the Great War… Discover an intense story in this redirected-walking VR adventure in which every step counts.

title: The Art Theft by Jay Doherty
desc: The Art Theft by Jay Doherty is an interactive VR narrative that injects 3D drawings created by the user into the unfolding narrative of a reimagined “Mad Libs” experience. Go down a rabbit hole with Butch the Bear, Wesley the Wolf, and Mr. Maple the Goat, who make you feel like you’re on a classic heist.

title: The Beanstalk
desc: The Beanstalk is a virtual reality fairytale experienced based around the classic, "Jack and the Beanstalk." It's a student project created by a team at BYU Provo, and now we're releasing it so that you can try it out for free.

title: The Beast of Stormy Forest
desc: Time travel to the past as Detective Cobie Cromwell. Find clues and solve puzzles in this story rich, immersive, virtual reality escape room game. Game to be released in successive chapters, with four total planned.

title: The Cable Center - Virtual Archive
desc: The Cable Center is proud to announce our Virtual Reality Archives Exhibit. The Center started experimenting with virtual reality in late 2013 with the goal of capturing objects to share in exhibits and videos. Four years later, we have elevated our work to a whole new level.

title: The Cathedral: Allison's Diary
desc: Two years later from "The Hospital", you are interested in visiting the place where Rachel and Alfredo should have been buried. "The Cathedral" is the second chapter of the Allison's Diary horror saga. In the sacred cathedral of Sant'Andrea there is something frightening waiting to be discovered.

title: The Cavern
desc: The Cavern is a puzzle-adventure game designed exclusively for room-scale VR. Solve puzzles, piece together stories and venture deeper into the darkness in search of one of the greatest lost treasures of our time.

title: The Cinder Pact
desc: Dive into a 4-player VR Co-op RPG! Choose from 4 unique classes, master powerful ranged skills, and battle through evolving dungeons. Face overwhelming monster hordes, collect Cyan Crystal Jade to power up your hero, and experience deep RPG mechanics in this 100% Free-to-Play adventure.

title: The Climb
desc: The Climb is a casual platformer game which involves accurate jumps through different obstacles and speedy gameplay as you rise to the very top. Try not to fall though as you only continue wherever you land. Complete the game with a record time and you can even obtain a piece of art in real life!

title: The Crystal Nebula
desc: Fly your spaceship from wormhole to wormhole, navigating dangerous space station obstacle courses and collecting crystals from the wreckage of fallen enemies. The Crystal Nebula demands your highest dexterity and accuracy in order to shoot and dodge your way through its waves of opposition!

title: The Curious Study of Dr. Blackwood:  A VR Tech Demo
desc: Explore a room full of magic and mystery in our free VR tech demo! Experiment with spectral power, reveal hidden secrets, or just chill . . . in The Curious Study of Dr. Blackwood!

title: The Dark Method
desc: Either play the randomly generated mansion to exorcise the hauntings or jump into a long story driven campaign where you get to explore scary environments, solve classic adventure game style puzzles and battle monsters along the way.

title: THE DESCENT VR
desc: Descent VR, хоррор-симулятор ходьбы в шахте Rockwell Mine, погружает игроков в суровую жизнь шахтеров и тревожные встречи в шахте. Играйте за следователя, раскрывающего тайну родного города.

title: The Desert's Rose
desc: The Desert's Rose is a Virtual Reality Adventure game created by Eddie O'Hagan. It consists of an interactable world with everyday household items and some items not so....household. This is an Early Access game that is constantly updated with 100% free content.

title: The Energy Lab
desc: You find yourself at the threshold of an abandoned lab containing technology of unknown origins. Welcome to The Energy Lab. You've found your way in, now find a way out.

title: The Enlightened League of Bone Builders and the Osseous Enigma
desc: Reckon yourself to be a most esteemed anatomist, do you? Well then immerse yourself in an intriguing Victorian parlour of curios to see how quickly you can piece together Yorick's complete skeleton. There are lots of other things to explore too, so stop your lollygagging and see if you've got the right stuff to join the Enlightened...

title: The Events at Unity Farm
desc: Adventure, dark fantasy and a dash of steampunk, EVENTS AT UNITY FARM is a fresh take on Open World VR. Use your ancestral power to cast spells, overcome undead evils and merciless bosses. Gather and craft potions, search for clues to solve puzzles all to stop the impending Multipocalypse.

title: The First Class VR
desc: 《THE FIRST CLASS》 научно-фантасти. вспоминает поиск воздушно-космического дела. Вы видите космическую столетнюю историю с Братьев Райт, вплоть до ракеты SPACEX №9. С помощью VR реализовать популяризацию знаний, приветствовать дух новаторства.

title: The First Settlement VR
desc: Build and manage a growing medieval town in The First Settlement VR. Place over 50 buildings, manage citizens and merchants, run production chains and trade with neighbouring towns. All in an evolving sandbox city builder experienced entirely in VR.

title: The Five Cores Remastered
desc: Heavily inspired by the 90s graphic puzzle games, The Five Cores Remastered is a surreal and poetic adventure that you can explore in VR.

title: The Gallery: Heart of the Emerald
The Great Exhibition of 1851 in VR
desc: Use your SteamVR system to visit the 1851 Great Exhibition in London's Hyde Park

title: The Green Room Experiment (Episode 1)
desc: You're locked in a dream and you need to wake up. Unravel the mysteries of this surreal exploration game and immerse yourself in a dreamlike, strange and solitary universe.

title: The Homestead
desc: The most visually stunning representation of a real-world environment. This is a real location, a real art-gallery based in Auckland New Zealand. The art-work has been scanned to a level of detail not demonstrated in any other traditional VR experience.

title: The Homestead Invasion
desc: Shore up your home, take up arms, and hope the night ends with this terrible enemy returning from whence they came. Reclaim and defend your outpost against an onslaught of monstrous invaders using whatever you can to keep them at bay.

title: The Hospital: Allison's Diary
desc: "The Hospital: Allison's Diary" is a new horror virtual reality experience, putting the user alone in an abandoned hospital searching for the unknown with only the help of a single torch. You will face true fear in a way you had never thought possible.

title: The Impossible Travel Agency
desc: Travel to a distant world pulsing with life in this beautiful VR experience set to music.

title: The Journey
desc: The Journey is a VR experience classified as a scientific, educational and adventure game which is based on the exploration of the human body.

title: The Journey Home
desc: A VR interactive story about family, dreams, and the meaning of life. You will be an astronaut who failed the mission, gets stuck in space and haunted by past memories.

title: THE KNIGHT OF QUEEN
desc: Dive into the world of old-school RPG in VR !! Become the Hero of her majesty the Queen, and travel to defeat the evil Devil King, bringing peace to the world !!

title: The Last Dinner
desc: "The Last Dinner" is a horror experience based on virtual reality technology. The game uses the first perspective to bring an immersive horror experience. In the game, the player will use the handle to control the protagonist to explore the villa in the mountains, and unravel the horror secret buried in the villa in the guide.

title: The Last Operator
desc: Infiltrate, locate and retrieve. Be the PRO that takes down Monolith Corp by taking on objective based missions to collect evidence against them. Single Player classic tactical action for VR.

title: The Last Taxi
desc: Conversations at the end of the world. You are the last human taxi driver in a desperate future where the last remains of civilization are propped up by surveillance, automation and human modification. The hours are long, and the pay is terrible – but hey, at least you have a job!

title: The Line
desc: “The Line” is great for showcasing VR for first-time users. This award-winning experience is a 15-20 minutes interactive story of two figurines who are perfect for each other but reluctant to live out their love.

title: The Link
desc: This application lets you use a webcam and a microphone to play any game with real-world movements and voice commands.

title: The Long Survival
desc: The Long Survival is a cooperative shooter in which you'll have to survive waves of enemies. Protect the nexus by fortifying your area with various structures and prepare for the siege. Upgrade your weapons, strategize with your teammates, or play as a solo warrior. Will you Survive?

title: The Lost VR
desc: The Lost is ultimate FPS VR game. You must defend yourself from enemies with various guns. The Lost is only available in single mode, and you can gradually clear the stages according to the difficulty. Take over best teleport spots and choose proper guns strategically to defeat enemies!

title: The Maze VR
desc: You can play multiplayer The Maze VR with up to 8 people. Race, Punch, Grab, Shoot and Think your way through each challenge. Find your teamplayers to unlock the Big Master Multiplayer Room and defeat The Maze!

title: The Midnight Sanctuary
desc: "А ты… может, тоже из мертвецов?" История о странных событиях в городке Дайусу, погрузиться в которую помогут сюрреалистичные визуальные образы и голоса профессиональных актеров. Таинственный и мрачный визуальный роман от создателей "This Starry Midnight We Make" и "Forget-Me-Not Organ".

title: The Moonlight Circus
desc: In this first-person VR-Horror game, you wake up in the middle of an empty circus arena, with a syringe in your arm and the feeling of being watched. Solve puzzles and discover clues to unveil the tragic backstory and find your way out.

title: The Murder Room VR
desc: The Murder Room is a Virtual Reality escape game. You're trapped in a apparently normal room, where you must find items and solve puzzles to escape. But not everything is as it seems. In the way, you may find hidden objects. How fast can you escape?

title: The Museum of Hauntology
desc: The Museum of Hauntology stands as a monument to a future that never was. Featuring counterfactual digital artefacts drawn from an alternative 1970s that did not quite happen. The work is intended to prompt contemplation of the recent past and the type of future in which we now find ourselves.

title: The Muybridge Mausoleum
desc: Like an art installation in virtual reality, The Muybridge Mausoleum playfully blends elements of shadow play, 19th century magic lantern shows, and early film set design. The result is a cinema for neanderthals.

title: The Night The Carsons Disappeared
desc: On April 6th 2009 the Carson family disappeared from their home in Richmond, and were never heard from again. The last known communication with the family came when Mr.Carson contacted local police to report the occurrence of a series of unexplained phenomena.

title: The Obsessive Shadow
desc: The Obsessive Shadow is a Survival Horror Game about a stalker you can't exactly Identify. With nothing but your eyes and a flashlight at your disposal, it's up to you to survive whatever horrific person or thing is out there watching you...

title: The OmniGallery
desc: The OmniGallery is a VR multiverse of art exhibits

title: The Peak Climb VR
desc: Peak Climb VR will bring you an action-packed full-time professional climbing experience and give you exciting moments. While every part of this experience will entertain you, it will also provide you with a tiring calorie burn and game music will provide you with spiritual therapy.

title: The Perfect Sniper
desc: The Romano family has taken over the city. Corrupt politicians and police agencies do nothing to stop them. Become the morally ambiguous champion this city needs as a Sniper in Virtual Reality.

title: The Phoenix Gene VR
desc: Вы управляете Фениксом прямо в своих руках. Летайте по научно-фантастическому фэнтези, уничтожая врагов, уклоняясь от пуль и препятствий, защищая персонажей и уничтожая опасную сыворотку бессмертия. Этот реалистичный рельсовый шутер предлагает захватывающую сюжетную тренировку.

title: The Pirate: Republic of Nassau
desc: Command iconic pirate ships of the early 18th century and experience life as a true sea captain, sailing freely across the open world. Engage in naval battles, expand your fleet, recruit legendary captains, and manage resources to support your life at sea.

title: The Polynesian Cultural Center VR Experience
desc: Experience the Polynesian Cultural Center in 3D 360VR!

title: The Professor Presents: #GotHandles
desc: Have what it takes to go head to head with one of the greatest ball handlers of all time? #GotHandles puts you on the court with streetball legend The Professor to see if you can match him move for move. Interact, dribble, and compete to see how many of The Professor's moves you can complete.

title: The Purge Man
desc: You feel tired of your own existence, you feel like everything is going wrong, there is no way out of this. The only way is to PURGE.

title: The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR ~ITSUKI~
desc: The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR ~ITSUKI~ is the first official VR adventure game based on the popular manga series. Play as Futaro Uesugi and enjoy spending time with the youngest Quint, Itsuki, in this VR adventure game.

title: The Rabbit Hole Remastered
desc: You find yourself in a strange place, a place full of darkness and mad things. After falling down the rabbit hole, what mysteries lies beyond? Are you ready to escape it? Be fast, be smart and survive this grim reality! Now Remastered!

title: The Riese Project
desc: Те, кто спустился под землю, не вернулись. Но под руинами что-то всё ещё дышит. The Riese Project — это нарративный триллер FPP/VR о месте, которое не забыло никого.

title: The Ruins: VR Escape the Room
desc: As an archaeologist following in the footsteps of your grandfather, you find yourself trapped in an arcane site. Uncover artifacts and solve ancient puzzles to fulfill your legacy. There's a great secret held here; what will you discover?

title: The Same Crime
desc: The Same Crime is a VR secret room escape game(first part) developed by Fuzhou immersed Network Technology Co. Ltd. Play games in an abandoned mental hospital from the first person perspective, find props, unlock the organs, and find useful clues to unravel the mysteries.

title: The Scent of Summer
desc: This is a short story of a boy and girl in elementary school 6th grade in Japan. You can experience to go back home from school with a girlfriend who goes the same cram school in the early summer evening. Special things don't happen but you can being with a girlfriend in a sentimental atmosphere of dusk.

title: The Slingshot VR
desc: Вы когда-нибудь думали о том, с какой скоростью летит камень запущенный из рогатки? В этой игре камень - Вы! Вам предстоит пережить огромные нагрузки на свой организм и получить положительные эмоции!

title: The Sniper VR
desc: Shaky hands? Hate the VR Shiver in Sniper Games? Well this game is for you! Try out our stabilization system which completely removes the VR Shiver and allows you to be a great sniper even with shaky hands! Just squeeze the trigger slowly before shooting to stabilize then make precise adjustment

title: The Station VR
desc: The Station VR is a first-person sci-fi mystery set on a space station sent to study a sentient alien civilization. Assuming the role of a recon specialist, players must unravel a mystery which will decide the fate of two civilizations.

title: The Steadfast VR Challenge
desc: The Steadfast VR Challenge is a hybrid of First Person Shooter and Tower Defense that forces you to incorporate strategy with marksmanship in a virtual world! It's delivered in an infinite wave based format where you'll find yourself frequently combining fast, deliberate decisions with quick reflexes to pull off the unthinkable.

title: The Stray Cat
desc: Virtual Reality Games Pick up the objects on the ground to protect it, or watch the cute it falls

title: The Surreal Imaginarium
desc: Enter "The Surreal Imaginarium", a virtual gallery full of other-worldy interactive paintings waiting for you to unlock their secrets.

title: The Take
desc: The Take is a local hotseat VR game where two players assume the role of competing spies in a Golden Age comic book, racing against the clock to hide and seek classified intel while setting (or avoiding) traps!

title: The Tavern of Magic
desc: Welcome to the Tavern! Craft, buy or sell Magic Cards to form your perfect deck and conquer other mages in Duels. Crawl together through Dungeons and more.

title: The Technician
desc: The Technician is a VR action puzzle game about hacking your way through security systems. Usually while being shot at.

title: The Torus Syndicate
desc: Experience the intense, non-stop action of the arcade rail-shooter in virtual reality! Play as Lucas Lawson, a rookie cop swept into the dramatic underworld of the Torus Syndicate. Put your shooting and dodging skills to the test as you battle across metropolis in a quest for justice.

title: The treasure of civilization
desc: VR文旅解谜冒险游戏；多人玩家的欢快VR游戏体验！射箭、密室、砍海盗等等丰富玩法，还能体验到大唐烟花等奇特盛宴！

title: The Uncertain: VR Experience
desc: В The Uncertain: VR Experience вы сможете глубже окунуться в атмосферу игры, изучая от первого лица модели персонажей и игровые предметы. Наша интерактивная галерея будет развиваться с выходом каждого нового эпизода, и она всегда будет абсолютно бесплатна.

title: The Unwelcomed
desc: The Unwelcomed is an escape the room (EtR) type game created for VR and was inspired by such classics as Crimson Room. The Unwelcomed starts by inviting you to come to your late uncle's mansion to claim it as your own. Once you arrive, however, it's going to be hard to leave...

title: The Villa: Allison's Diary
desc: A villa, a daily routine and an apparently happy family. Here is where everything began. Relive through flashbacks, immersive cinematic effects and terrifying jump scares, the night Allison killed her parents in 1956.

title: The Virtual Reality Museum of Immersive Experiences
desc: The (Virtual) Reality Museum of Immersive Experiences is a very special kind of museum. It exhibits projects originally designed for large-scale immersive environments in a simulation that is true to the physical manifestation of these systems.

title: The Wire
desc: "The Wire" is a casual puzzle game with plenty of levels, which is designed to suit the needs and abilities of players of all ages. Play with the electronic background music, you just need to move the controller to go forward. The most import thing is making sure it is going on the track.

title: The Wire Loop Game VR
desc: The Wire Loop Game VR brings this traditional well known game into virtual reality. The aim of the game is to guide the metal hoop along the length of the wire without it touching. If it touches the wire, or you don't complete it in time, then the buzzer will sound and you will fail.

title: The Woods: VR Escape the Room
desc: After a walk in the woods, you find yourself locked in a swaying cage above the forest floor, with no recollection of how you got there. Discover the mysteries this forest has to offer. Solve puzzles, decipher ancient texts, and uncover the mystical secrets hidden within these woods for many years.

title: Thick Air
desc: В мире, свободном от нас, наши разумные машины остались имитировать жизнь, которую они когда-то знали. Рейсеры, низшая каста машинного общества, построенные ради одной цели - гонки - соревнуются друг с другом до бесконечности на просторах опустевшей Земли.

title: THOSE DAMN ALIENS! VR
desc: Aliens have boarded your ship; It's time to take arms and defend yourself from the incoming hive. 'Those Damn Aliens' is a VR wave based first person shooter with campaign and survival modes.

title: Those Who Crawl VR
desc: Crawl through tight cave tunnels and avoid monsters in this claustrophobic VR spelunking game. Escape inhuman monsters and deadly environments as the cave walls turn to flesh.

title: ThrounnelVR
desc: ThrounnelVR is a tetris-like puzzler with a first-person view. The goal of ThrounnelVR is to fit the shape of blocks into a distant hole. You control the movement of the blocks by your HMD, and the rotation by game controller or keyboard.

title: Throw Anything
desc: Get secret missions from Secret Delivery Agency (SDA) and save the world from zombie horde in the VR action game,Throw Anything!

title: Throw The Ball In the Hole
desc: Just how accurate are you? In this VR-game you literally have to throw the ball in the hole, that's it! You'll soon find out it's much easier said than done. With 15 unique puzzles, each one offering a different challenge. You will have to combine precision, speed, and a little creativity to even complete this game.

title: Thunderballs VR
desc: High in the clouds, a storm is brewing. Join the mayhem with up to 4 players in this tactical VR action game. Obliterate your foes with futuristic weapons and bring their base down around them with old fashioned artillery!

title: Thunderbird: The Legend Begins
desc: Journey deep into the heart of an ancient realm of myth and legend in this epic interactive virtual reality adventure series.

title: ThunderGod
desc: Окажитесь в роли Тора, погрузившись в удивительный мир виртуальной реальности этой аркадной игры, в которой вам предстоит освоить навыки использования величественного молота Мьёльнир, чтобы защитить деревню людей от нашествия гигантов.

title: Timberman VR
desc: «Timberman VR» — это VR-игра, в которой игрокам предлагается рубить деревья, избегая веток с помощью различных инструментов. Легко научиться трудно освоить.

title: Time
desc: Time is a musical experience designed for Virtual Reality where geometry and materials react to audio while using 3D sounds to increase the immersiveness.

title: Time Hacker
desc: Ваше единственное оружие в «Time Hacker»– это возможность ненадолго заморозить время. В этой игре вы можете стать супергероем, взять врагов под свой контроль, внести хитрые изменения в сцену и тем самым победить их. Затем откиньтесь в кресле и насладитесь последствиями своего замысла.

title: Time Transit VR
desc: Step into the world as it was millions of years ago! Time Transit uses its cutting edge technology to send you back in time on an adventure of a lifetime. Navigate through mesmerizing landscapes from the depth of the oceans to the peaks of mountains. Experience wildlife from bygone ages close up.

title: Time Travelling Navy Seal Ninja Warrior
desc: Using the skills of a Navy Seal and the grace of a Ninja Warrior, travel through time to different eras to defeat the forces of evil! Use stealth and mercy to avoid damaging the space time continuum. Or ignore that and kill everyone!

title: TimeLab
desc: TimeLab is a VR platform for virtual time travel. Experience well-researched historical events and visit historical locations. Currently, you can relive the Apollo 11 moon landing and journey to Ludwig II’s dream castle Falkenstein, with more DLCs to come.

title: Timeless Paradox VR
desc: Our champion failed in her mission two years ago. Everything about this battle remains mysterious. Now you have the chance to go back. Will you change the history? Will you defy this fate with her?​ Your hearty VR journey Starts here!

title: TimingSpace
desc: You'll be immersed in a realistic virtual world, with precise hand tracking allowing you to swing your weapon freely and feel real feedback from every hit. Supports two-player battle mode and online ranking, allowing you to compete with friends and players from other regions.

title: Tiny Flock
desc: Tiny Flock - уютная VR-головоломка для всех возрастов отт создателей Human Fall Flat. Используйте окружение, чтобы провести милых заблудших овечек через красочные диорамы!

title: Tiny Island
desc: Медитативный VR-симулятор Бога, где вам предстоит помогать умилительным пельмешкам с помощью… палочек для еды!

title: Tiny Love
desc: TINY LOVE! is a ride with colorful, cute main characters specially suited for introducing children to the VR realm and highly recommended for a fun family time. TINY LOVE! follows the adventure of Nefasto and Lubella who fall in love at first sight. Come experience the TINY LOVE of a life time!

title: Tiny Wheels
desc: Tiny Wheels is a VR sandbox where you can create tracks and steer a remote control car through your creations. There's no rules, no score, no objective. You can create challenging tracks and see if you can navigate your tiny car through it or just enjoy the act of creating.

title: Tomboy Adventure 2
desc: Окунитесь в беззаботное летнее приключение вместе со своей своенравной подругой (а там, глядишь, и девушкой)!

title: Tomorrow
desc: ‘Tomorrow’ is a VR experience about how humans have evolved through language over time. It takes us on a mesmerizing journey from prehistoric caves and the Amazonian jungle to the top of the Himalayas. We finally approach ‘Tomorrow’, our next phase of evolution where VR is the new language.

title: Toon Ocean VR
desc: Toon Ocean VR is a collection of four magical experiences in which you can meet friendly inhabitants of the ocean.

title: Top Floor
desc: Welcome to Top Floor Experience. It is time to enjoy virtual reality and push yourselves beyond the limits. This elevator is going to take you very high above ground. Remember this experience is safe. Relax.

title: Tornuffalo
desc: Humankind has faced earthquakes, volcanoes, floods and hurricanes—but the most dangerous natural disaster is a weather phenomenon known as the "Tornuffalo." Get ready to dodge, block and hit in this room-scale VR game.

title: Touch Grass VR Simulator
desc: Touch Grass VR Simulator is a VR experience lets you reconnect with nature without leaving your room, breaking a sweat, or making eye contact with another human. Experience hyperrealistic grass, peaceful skies, and zero chance of bug bites or allergic reactions. Because going outside is cringe.

title: ToVer Defense
desc: Do your best to defend your virtual castle from enemies trying to invade it! Can you get the most out of resources such as crossbow, teleportation and... magic?!

title: Towards a perilous journey
desc: Situated midway between shoot'em up and musical game, Towards a Perilous Journey puts you in charge of a squad of two ships in Virtual Reality. Go through each of the 24 chronicles and face the many enemies that will appear according to the rhythm and intensity of the music.

title: Tower VR
desc: Tower VR is a virtual reality based tower defense game. It is a strategy game where you open the monster gate and build and upgrade the tower by selecting the appropriate location and type to stop the monsters from running all over the place. But Tower VR is not just a strategy game.

title: Towers and Powers
desc: Пришло время быть богом! Спасите своих людей и защитите их острова от порабощения силами хаоса в этой тактической VR игре в жанре Tower Defense.

title: Toy Clash
desc: Get ready for a fierce battle of cute toys on table-top! Use your mighty magic and unique toys to stop annoying opponents from making a disturbance.

title: Trains VR
desc: Hop on the Puzzle Train! Welcome to the fantasy world of railroads, locomotives, and stations where you can become both a constructor and a conductor. Relive your childhood dreams with 40 levels packed with logical puzzles and multiple solutions. Build, Ride, Fail, Repeat, Succeed!

title: Trajectory Fracture
desc: A fully physics based game featuring challenges that revolve around breaking items in satisfying ways and letting off some steam doing it

title: Tranquil Cove
desc: Your mother recently passed away, and her mysterious childhood home in a small town called Tranquil Cove was passed down to you. In an attempt to learn about your mothers mysterious past, you go to investigate. Nothing could prepare you for what you find there...

title: Transfusion
desc: Slice enemies into tiny pieces and wield the power of blood magic to survive another day in this fast-paced VR hack and slash!

title: Tranzient
desc: Make beats in VR. Full looping music production and sequencing environment in VR with visuals.Who made the beats? You did! This is not a rhythm game.

title: Trapped VR
desc: Trapped VR is a VR puzzle game that focuses on how the player interacts with the game world. To win you must solve the puzzles surrounding you to figure out the secret code that unlocks the container doors.

title: Trash Time
desc: Trash Time is a virtual reality game that can teach you how to recycle in a fun way. Burnt trash accumulates CO2 gas, that is one of the leading causes of global warming. Try to save the Earth by playing as a alien robot with flexible hands, recycle trash using powerups and power tools.

title: Travel VR
desc: “If we were meant to stay in one place, we would have roots rather than feet!”

title: Treasure At The Top
desc: Slice monsters. Release energy balls. Uncover mysteries.

title: Treekeepers
desc: Coordinate, fly, and blast your way through an oversized cartoon world in this 1-4 player co-op adventure!

title: Trenches VR
desc: Trenches VR is a psychological horror game where your microphone becomes part of the terror - enemies can hear your real-life breathing, whispers, or cries for help. Stay quiet, stay hidden… or they’ll come for you.

title: TRESPASS - Episode 2
desc: Trespass – Episode 2 is a game that will test your wits through puzzle solving elements and action packed scenarios. Assist Samuel Rodriguez through different environments by searching for clues and interacting with surrounding objects in order to escape.

title: Trial of the Gods
desc: Challenge your wits, test your mettle, prove you are worthy of a second chance by completing the riddles and puzzles of the Egyptian Gods! Escape from the ancient Egyptian tomb or seal your fate forever!

title: Trinity VR
desc: Trinity is the pilot for the first live-action, immersive, interactive, virtual reality sci-fi experience… In a future where humans have long been extinct, the last surviving androids fight a final war for freedom against an all-powerful Singularity, their God…Who am I? What role do I play in the story?

title: TripSync
desc: A machine-learning utilizing application for immersing in a bundle of multi-world diverting storylines of random interesting scenarios in which the characters are vocally interactable.

title: Triumph in the Skies
desc: Triumph in the Skies is a flight simulation game exclusive to VR. It makes flight learning easy and safe. Even rookies can drive training aircraft or fighters in many scenarios. Players can also use the keyboard to join the game in 2D mode. In addition, the game also has a lot of Chinese elements.

title: Tropical Air Hockey
desc: Air Hockey game provides you with the best VR experience! Feel like you are on a lovely tropical beach. Have fun and chill out playing this addicting arcade game. If you like classical air hockey, you will love this one even more!

title: Tropical Girls VR
desc: Experience amazing moments with beautiful girls on the Tropical Island in the middle of the ocean.

title: Truck Driver: The American Dream
desc: Отправляйся в погоню за американской мечтой и построй карьеру водителя грузовика! Начинается новая жизнь! Выполняй заказы, получай доступ к новым грузовикам, покупай запчасти и путешествуй по открытой дороге. Узнай, что именно нужно для того, чтобы стать успешным дальнобойщиком!

title: Truck Parking Simulator VR
desc: Truck Parking Simulator VR is a fully interactive, realistic and immersive parking experience. But also an open world where you can deliver goods by truck. The game has one of the best truck physics simulations in VR.

title: True Blades™
desc: TRUE BLADES™ is a cutting edge medieval fighting adventure which provides a very realistic and immersive sword fighting experience for VR. Fight hordes of monsters or strategically duel against highly skilled knights and develop true-to-life fighting skills.

title: Trump and Virus
desc: В начале катастрофы те, которые, казалось бы, не имеют отношения к ранним предупреждениям, всегда будут чувствовать, что это несерьезно, например, вирусная атака.

title: TrumPiñata
desc: Trumpiñata is a political piñata experience you won't want to miss. Use a baseball bat to rip him apart!

title: TSA Frisky
desc: In TSA Frisky, you are a TSA agent with the daunting task of surviving your shift. Manage lines, luggage, and leisure, to keep from blacking out on the job. Survive your shifts to earn promotions and upgrades to become the TSA's most effective employee.

title: Tsukai Furushita Kotoba Ya Uta Wo MV
desc: It is a game that allows you to watch the song “Tsukai Furushita Kotoba Ya Uta Wo” by Shippu-P in VR space with particle effects.

title: Tsuro - The Game of The Path - VR Edition
desc: The award-wining puzzle strategy game, now for Steam VR.

title: Turn Me On
desc: Race through neon tracks in VR but, plot twist, you'll need to hit lamps to turn the track on. Turn Me On is an arcade style racing game for Vive, make it to the end of the track and try to beat your high score.

title: TURRET SYNDROME VR
desc: Tower Defense game in first person view, it can be played in VR with Oculus Rift or in non VR.

title: Two Worlds - The 3D Art Gallery
desc: The theme of the exhibition is values that affect everyone all the time. The society surrounding us defines what people appreciate. The paintings illustrate a reverse value system. This means, for example, showing poverty as something people admire and seek.

title: Tyrgard Archer VR
desc: Prepare yourself against the incoming hordes of unique enemies! Dodge flying spears, magical ravens and kamikaze dragons! Immerse yourself in a stylish low-poly environment. Upgrade your bow, improve your skill and become the champion Tyrgard needs you to be!

title: Uizuno Blade VR
desc: Uizuno Blade is an action Sci-Fi game designed for Virtual Reality. Fight with laser guns and energy swords against hostile soldiers and monsters. This version contains five levels of action and will be updated with more levels in the coming months.

title: UNBINARY
desc: UNBINARY is a VR puzzle adventure, entirely hand-painted. Meet Webby, a super AI made from human behavior data and candidate to rule planet Earth. Wear three masks that offer varied physical interactions in VR, and change the way the world reacts to you. Is she ready to fulfill her purpose?

title: UNCORPOREAL - "Alcatraz Island Lofts"
desc: "Alcatraz Island Lofts", an experimental VR short, is a dark comedy monologue set in 2025 San Franciso that imagines a rather cynical solution to San Francisco's housing crisis: converting the historic prison on Alcatraz Island into over-priced lofts. Run length is 1 min 30 secs.

title: UNCORPOREAL - "Fluffy!"
desc: "Fluffy!", an experimental VR short, is pure camp horror with a script based loosely on the iconic 80's horror film "An American Werewolf in London". A surrealistic motel is imagined in the world of the original film, starring a peculiar bellmen who's obsessed with "pets'. Run length is 1 min 30 secs.

title: Underture
desc: UNDERTURE is a short 6DoF immersive VR experience set in the New York City subway. Multi-axis freedom of movement, combined with spatialized audio, creates a uniquely immersive and transporting experience for the viewer.

title: Unearthing Mars 2: The Ancient War
desc: You will play the role of Deputy Commander in the 'Unearthing Mars' mission, trying to unravel the secrets hidden in the Phobos Fragment from the Ark Research Center's closed-door study. Through the Ark Device, you will experience a war across outer space and return to the Earth and Mars of ancient times.

title: Unforgiven VR
desc: Conquer the west by becoming the best duelist ever. Unforgiven brings you the thrill and tension of a true western VR duel. Face another player in an experience where a split second can decide who lives and who dies. Thrive in the ruthless social world of Unforgiven and become a true legend.

title: UNHALLOWED: THE CABIN
desc: Jump into this creepy VR horror title. Investigate you family’s ancestral cabin and collect clues as eldritch secrets are revealed and you discover what grotesque fate has befallen your brother and his missing family.

title: Unknown Pharaoh
desc: Unknown Pharaoh will immerse you in an incredible adventure. You will take on the role of an archaeologist exploring an ancient Egyptian pyramid. Decipher genuine ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs. Discover ancient Egyptian artifacts. Watch out for traps. This game uses arm swings locomotion.

title: Unpatterned Cut
desc: "Unpatterned Cut" - это VR-экшн-рефлексия, в которой вам предстоит завершать эпизоды, убивая врагов, чтобы выжить в симуляторе и, возможно, спасти своих близких. Кроме того, набирайте очки и поднимайтесь по рейтингу в таблице лидеров в сравнении с другими игроками.

title: Unruly Ghouls
desc: Do you hate ghouls? Would you like to obliterate ghouls using your anti-ghoul inventions? Unruly Ghouls is a fun arcade style defense shooter set in a beautifully spooky environment. Experience what it feels like to be inside an arcade game.

title: Uphold The Realm
desc: Uphold The Realm is a VR Tower Defense game that lets you take command of your wargames style campaign map to interact with levels and manage towers. When your ready - Shrink down onto the table and use your archery skills to defend against the oncoming hordes.

title: V-Air Traffic Control
desc: Станьте диспетчером воздушного движения в захватывающем симуляторе VR! Управляйте самолетами на земле и в воздухе, избегайте столкновений в сложных сценариях. Почувствуйте азарт башни и оттачивайте навыки в этой реалистичной игре-симуляторе.

title: V-Art- VR Painting Studio
desc: A casual VR painting simulation. It's free. And goofy.

title: Vanguard V
desc: Vanguard V is a fast-paced flight adventure game, designed for Virtual Reality, with diverse settings including flights through space, Earth’s surface, and the worlds below. You are the sole defender and greatest weapon against the Parasites. The freedom of flight meets action adventure!

title: Vast Haven-1 VR
desc: Step into Haven-1, the world's first commercial space station. Unlock its hatch to navigate through the interior of the station, where you can interact with the storage area, the crew quarters, the Haven-1 Lab, and a stunning, 180-degree view of Earth.

title: VE FPSO TOUR in VR
desc: FPSO Tour. Live some of the everyday scenarios offshore workers must face.

title: VE GSIM Tower Crane Simulator
desc: Experience how it is to work an a tower crane operator lifting loads from lift shaft, landing on walk way scaffolding, lifting from truck or lifting in strong wind. Change weather from sunshine to rain or snow. Realistic construction site.

title: Vector Velocity
desc: In Vector Velocity movement is the name of the game. Run, Jump, Slide, Climb, Grind, Skid, Zipline and ultimately race your way from point A to B as fast as you can.

title: VectorWave
desc: VectorWave translates the traditional tower defense experience into virtual reality, allowing you the freedom to buy, place, toss, and move towers as you see fit with minimal menu interaction.

title: Vehicle VR
desc: Welcome to Vehicle, an addicting and rage-inducing game. Your goal is to complete levels by getting to the finish box. All maps are made to test your common knowledge and quick reflexes. Compete with your friends and people around the globe to get the fastest times! VR is not required.

title: Velocity Vector
desc: Velocity Vector grants you a chance to challange your VR gaming skills in a form of a fast paced action/platformer/racing game. You jump on platforms, you drift through the race track, you fly in tunnels!

title: Vendetta Forever

desc: Immerse yourself in a spectacular luxury apartment full of magic for you to explore!

title: VROOM: Galleon
desc: Experience virtual life at sea aboard a pirate ship!

title: VRQ Test
desc: A simple test will help you measure and better understand your sensitivity to VR so that you can have a better VR experience.

title: VRtender
desc: VRtender is a virtual reality bartending game set in your very own dive bar. You'll make cocktails, pour beers, entertain your patrons, and much more as you take up all the responsibilities of a bartender... without the mess.

title: VRWorkout
desc: Fitness rhythm game with full body engagement. Transform your living room into a personal gym on 4 square meters.

title: VTB Basketball League VR
desc: В этом VR приложении вы сможете ознакомиться с командами и лучшими игроками лиги ВТБ, а также сыграть в баскетбольные мини-игры!

title: Waba
desc: Waba is the wobbliest, cuddliest, virtualest VR pet.

title: Wacktory
desc: Wacktory is the 2019 UCSC Games Showcase Grand Prize Winning - Best In Show - VR + Couch Co-op title. Over 6 months in our senior year, a team of 12 undergraduates took Wacktory from initial concepts to a full playable demo.

title: Wacky Wings VR
desc: Launch into this idyllic, arcade-style ride and take to the skies to explore the thrilling and diverse VR world of Wacky Wings!

title: Waddle Home
desc: The Penguins are trapped and they need your help! Guide them to the Rescue Ship by opening doors and moving blocks, while making sure to help them waddle around traps and escape patrolling guards!

title: Walk On Mars
desc: Experience Mars virtually like never before.

title: Wall Town Wonders
desc: Wall Town Wonders — это уютный симулятор жизни, в котором вы строите очаровательный город с нуля, помогаете забавным персонажам в увлекательных квестах и настраиваете каждый элемент по своему вкусу. Исследуйте, стройте и влюбляйтесь в свой город как никогда раньше.

title: War Link - 2111 AD
desc: War Link has evolved, and so has the best online FPS on Virtual Reality

title: War Platform
desc: Море и воздух работают вместе, чтобы защититься от насыщенной атаки стратегического и тактического оружия.

title: Warden of the Isles
desc: Use Magic and a Powerful Throwing Arm to defeat enemies in VR as you Build and Command Troops in this RTS and Mage Simulator. Uncover the threat facing the Isles in the Campaign or battle in Multiplayer or Skirmish modes as you become... Warden of the Isles!

title: Wardens of the Amber Cage
desc: A cooperative action dungeon crawler. Support Virtual Reality headsets. Become a warmage and keep the horrors inside the Amber Cage !

title: Wardwell House VR
desc: This is the VR version of Wardwell House which is an innovative and realistic horror game with outstanding atmosphere. You must find hidden clues and objects of interest that slowly reveal the haunting story. Feel the build-up of fear as you traverse the forest and make your way through the House.

title: Warka Flarka Flim Flam
desc: From the creator of ‘BLARP!’ , ‘L U N E’ and ‘My Lil’ Donut’ comes new Fast-paced, Physical game for Vive : “Warka Flarka Flim Flam” . Every mistake you make will be punished, starting you over again and again on your Journey to become the #1 Warka of Flarkas!

title: Warp Out
desc: A VR exclusive shoot 'em up, Warp Out projects you in four different worlds full of enemies to destroy. Only your skill can bring you to the top of the leaderboards!

title: Warpaint
desc: Warpaint - это настольная игра физики, в которой вы командуете армией гномов и запускаете катапульты. Ударьте страх в своего противника с помощью вашей расписанной армии. Победа достигается за счет превосходного тактического позиционирования и ловкости в осаде. Поднимайтесь по рангу и хвастайтесь своими боевыми мозгами.

title: Warplanes: Air Corp
desc: Engage in combat at the core of the modern battlefield in Warplanes: Air Corp in VR. The third installment of the best-selling Warplanes series introduces a new era of modern military aviation. In addition to fighter jets and multirole combat aircraft you are able to pilot attack helicopters!

title: Warriors Of Titus - F2P
desc: Warriors of Titus is a first-person MOBA (Mutliplayer Online Battle Arena)for VR. Finally you can be immersed in a MOBA as you battle to reclaim Titus.

title: Watching Grass Grow In VR - The Game
desc: A thoughtful and inspired VR game about watching grass grow during the end of the world. Rain death and destruction upon your foes with your rocket launcher as you fight to the very end to have the most glorious grass in the world.

title: Wave Magic VR
desc: Be a mage in virtual reality. Learn and cast powerful magic spells to fight off the golems, an army of mindless creatures left behind from the battles of the past. Fight with a variety of control schemes including: Vive Wands and Leap Motion.

title: We Are Stars
desc: We Are Stars is the most immersive science documentary in the Universe! This 360°, 3D, high-framerate experience seeks to answer some of the biggest questions of all time. What are we made of? Where did it all come from? Explore the secrets of our cosmic chemistry and our explosive origins.

title: We're Here, Papa
desc: We're Here, Papa is a VR horror game. In the dark depths of the sewer, you must find your way and escape on your own. But you are not alone down there. Something is pursuing you. You don’t know what it is, but one thing is certain… you must not let it catch you.

title: Welcome Above
desc: “Welcome Above” is a stylized VR-Flight experience that allows the players to enjoy the natural feeling of flying.

title: Welcome Home, Love
desc: What lies in store for Jess? Experience her world and find the secret buried at the end. Welcome Home, Love is a narrative-driven VR experience with hundreds of interactable items, and fully voiced dialogue for all characters and pickups.

title: WellTown
desc: Have you ever wanted to take a trip to the creative heart of New Zealand? Grab your headset and join our exuberant guide on your own personal virtual tour of Wellington!

title: Welme
desc: We are the first virtual reality streaming platform that improves the relationship between streamers and their audience. We connect streamers with super fans who want to have a more direct, immersive and exclusive relationship than the current one.

title: Wet Dog Corp
desc: Race against the clock and clean up these mucky pups! Created by Virtual Reality Development students at Ringling College of Art and Design.

title: Whack-a-Vote: Hammering the Polls
desc: Whack a Vote: Hammering the Polls is a Virtual Reality game that allows you to vote in 2016’s Presidential Election in new innovative ways through the use of various new voting utensils. Shamelessly spend taxpayer money to cast your vote now!

title: Wheelchair Simulator VR
desc: Ты когда-нибудь переходил дорогу? Легко, правда? А теперь попробуй-ка пересечь город, крутя колеса инвалидной коляски в Wheelchair Simulator VR. Присядь в кресло, надень шлем и возьми в руки джойстики. Ну что, погнали?

title: Where Thoughts Go
desc: Discover the dreams, fears and secrets of other players - and leave your own for others to find. In this award-winning social experience, awake creatures to reveal the voice messages of others that have previously visited. To progress you must leave your own stories behind. What will you say?

title: Wild Gun
desc: You are the sheriff. Robbers roam the village and pillage. Your mission is to catch robbers and bounties. Fight them to protect your town.

title: Wild West VR
desc: Wild West VR is a first-person shooter unfolding in a western setting. Two gamepads are used as weapons. The interface is maximum smooth. Game features have been enhanced with the introduction of the waves of attacks of various levels of difficulty.

title: Wildland
desc: Сядьте за руль одного из советских внедорожников и выживайте в пост-советском мире Последней Коммуны: исследуйте, добывайте припасы, торгуйте, помогайте жителям Коммуны и постарайтесь дожить до финала, смерть в этом мире необратима.

title: Winds & Leaves
desc: Путешествуйте по обширному бесплодному миру и возвращайте его к жизни, выращивая собственные леса. Откапывайте древние семена, пробуждайте достопримечательности и собирайте знания, чтобы остановить надвигающийся катаклизм.

title: Winter Fury: The Longest Road
desc: Battle for survival against intimidating bosses like Tiger tanks, Steam Trains, and Messerschmitt Bf 109 fighter aircraft. From close-quarter combat in concrete bunkers to sinking a destroyer with cannon fire, each mission offers arcade shooting action.

title: Witching Tower: Heroes
desc: Fight the undead with four sets of weapons. Beat the bosses to save the kingdom from enemies. Relentless arcade action suitable even for people new to VR! Breathtaking visuals and dark fantasy environments are waiting for you!

title: With Loneliness
desc: "With Loneliness" is an athletic VR game that aims to escape from "garbage world" by clearing obstacles.

title: Wolf and Pigs
desc: Wolf & Pigs: Out for Vengeance is a fresh take on the classic fable “The Three Little Pigs.” When the notorious Pig Brothers Gang invades the New World to build their compound, an unlikely protector vows to put an end to the Pigs greedy, nature-destroying ways!

title: Wolf At Evergreen
desc: **A Research Demo from 2021** A supernatural-mystery, interactive-narrative VR experience. Are the rumours of a werewolf sighting true? Talk with townspeople and explore the museum to discover what's truly happening in the small town of Evergreen.

title: Workshop Simulator VR
desc: Workshop Simulator VR is a simulation game where you take on the role of a workshop owner, equipped with a range of specialized tools. Become a master of restoring various items!

title: World Apart
desc: World Apart is an Episodic VR Adventure. Every World Apart episode will deliver a new world to explore, each with it’s own unique story and interact-able environment. Delve deep into the conspiracy, uncover the secrets as you aid scientists, and save your world.

title: World Builder
desc: World Builder is creative tool that will allow anyone to easily create in worlds and landscapes in VR.

title: World horror story
desc: World horror story - это кооперативная игра на выживание в жанре хоррор, где вам нужно изгнать зло, прежде чем оно уничтожит вас. В игре вы можете общаться голосом с призраками и демонами, но будьте осторожны, если призраки вам отвечают - это не значит, что они дружелюбные.

title: World of Golf
desc: World of Golf is a virtual reality game that allows you to play golf right at home. Grab your full set of clubs and play our 18 hole course without leaving your living room. With full swing physics you are in complete control of every shot.

title: World VR Competition
desc: The ultimate VR party game! Invite your friends over and go for the gold in this thrilling game of international competition. Or challenge the world records and leaderboards in singleplayer!

title: Worldy Cup
desc: Retro futuristic arcade football. On regular screen and in VR. It's like you're inside a futuristic version of an 8bit world.

title: WREST
desc: WREST is a sci-fi horror VR game about delving into nightmares to save an out-of-control spaceship from disaster. Solve a dark, twisted story and master edge-of-your-seat combat — but whatever you do, don’t close your eyes.

title: X-Fire VR
desc: X-Fire VR is a Rogue-lite Duck & Cover experience in a futuristic world full of hostile aliens and robots. The game features over 15 different enemy types, massive large levels with just the first mission taking up 1 hour or more to complete.

title: Xenociders
desc: Скрывайтесь. Охотьтесь. И на вас будут охотиться. Xenociders – это игра жанра стелс-экшен в виртуальной реальности на планете, покрытой буйной растительностью, на которой хозяйничают свирепые инопланетные динозавры-хищники.

title: XLR
desc: XLR is a multiplayer team based arena shooter. Party up into teams (with friends, or just join a random match), select a player class, then deploy to the arena for battle. Or practice your skills against enemies in singleplayer training mode. Choose from different player classes to even the odds.

title: You Are a Bird
desc: You Are a Bird is an immersive VR bird flight sim where your real arms become wings. Flap and angle your wings to explore and hunt in VR. Based on real bird flight mechanics and soaring flight physics.

title: You are next
desc: "You are next" is a murder mystery for Virtual Reality. Gather your detective instinct and identify the killer!

title: Your World VR
desc: The ultimate VR building game! Build just about anything you can imagine. Build obstacle courses, dungeons, custom npc's. There are many items to choose from that are all customizable. Share and experience other worlds through the Steam Workshop.

title: Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station
desc: In Yupitergrad 2, the players have extended mobility, a wider selection of tools, and a much richer game world with an open-ended structure. This is a VR adventure worth waiting for. The legend is back, bigger and better.

title: Zanshin
desc: Slice and dice! Zanshin is a sword fighting simulator, where you can test yourself in challenging sword fights. Try your agility, reaction, speed. Move, block and strike your enemies down and then slice them into thousand pieces. Fight with hundred waves of enemies and survive as long as you can.

title: Zen Universe
desc: Explore а bundle of 4 real-life and legendary locations - shot, scanned, and hand-polished into realistic interactive environments. Early Access includes 2 experiences and 2 more will be updated for free.

title: Zenith: The Last City
desc: Аниме-MMORPG для виртуальной реальности.

title: Zero Days VR
desc: Based on the Oscar short-listed Participant Media documentary Zero Days, Scatter's Emmy Award-winning, immersive documentary Zero Days VR visualizes the story of Stuxnet in a new way: placing you inside the invisible world of computer viruses, experiencing the high stakes of cyber warfare at a human scale.

title: ZhanDou (VR and Non-VR)
desc: Developed by KX Games, Zhandou is one of the first MOBA style games available on VR and Non-VR platforms. Along with Zhandou's unique theme, playable characters, environments, and fighting system, Zhandou will be the first game based on ancient Chinese civilization and mythology. The game is considered "early release"

title: Zombie Buster VR
desc: Zombie Buster VR aims to be an authentic action shooting game that has maximized the feeling of shooting and coolness of battle, which has been the most essential element lacking in existing Shooting VR games.

title: Zombie City
desc: Are you ready for the zombie apocalypse? We've done the research and want to make sure you're prepared. Fought to the end. Requires the virtual reality headset.

title: Zombie Hobby VR
desc: Zombie Hobby is an atmospheric action VR shooter where your weapons - the most affordable objects from your daily life. Train to be a shapshooter and kill as many zombie-aliens as you can.

title: Zombie school-丧尸学院
desc: Use virtual reality to enter a fictional open comic world, freely experience a horrible time with black and white comics, explore the story of each character and their respective destiny and ending

title: Zombie Season
desc: Zombie Season is an Open World FPS, made for Oculus Rift. Walk, drive or fly around Pine City, find some weapons and try to stay alive!

title: Zombie Slaughter VR
desc: The world is in danger. Make your way to the evacuation center, take part in the great battle for survival, and discover the cause of the invade!

title: Zombie Town VR
desc: ZombiesTown is a FPS game base on VR device.ZombiesTown is cartoon style which is different from the other vr game! You will meet those lovely zombies in this beautiful town,and they just want to give you a warm hug! Get your weapon and try to survive in the party !

title: ZombVR
desc: Immersive SP and Coop MP VR COD-style zombie shooter with free-range or teleport motion, area unlocks and upgrades. Various other game modes like Sniper Defense, Onslaught, shooting range, shooting gallery, raining heads. Realistic guns and melee combat including sniper rifles and swords.

title: Zomcade
desc: Zomcade is a challenging action-horror arcade style game for Steam VR. Immerse yourself in over 15 different ways to play.

title: Zoo World VR
desc: Intentio Education Game Studios gives you a passport to all parts of our vibrant planet. As you crisscross the globe you’ll be able to study and learn about the native species while you help out your new four-legged friends through a series of challenging, environmental-themed quests.

title: Zuma Legend VR
desc: Have you ever play Zuma in VR, and what if i tell you it is a First-Person perspective game? You will definitely have a lot of fun with this game shooting balls as if in reality, Now it comes, Let's go.

title: Ворота Куликова поля. Битва за Епифань
desc: Окажитесь в центре решающей битвы за русские земли. Вы — стрелец 16 века. Дайте отпор войску крымчаков, проявите доблесть и смекалку в бою. Дойдет враг до Москвы или нет, зависит от вас!

title: Гордость Улыпа. VR-легенды Чувашии
desc: Сказочный VR-квест перенесет вас в волшебный лес, где фольклор сливается с реальной историей. Встретьтесь лицом к лицу с богатырем-великаном из народных сказаний и бросьте вызов Старейшине чувашских дубрав. Решите загадки орнамента и услышьте легенду о хане Кубрате и серебряных булгарах.

title: Игра ремесел. VR-погружение в мир народных промыслов
desc: В ваших руках – народные промыслы России! Откройте их тайны вместе с волшебной птицей Кикой. Распишите мир вокруг под Жостово и Палех согласно традициям. Или отбросьте все правила и сформируйте собственный народный стиль, чтобы вернуть цвета в дом Кики!

title: Машина времени
desc: Эта 'машина времени' доставит вас туда, куда другие машины времени не пойдут.

title: Мэнни Бокс VR
desc: Мэнни Пакьяо — единственный чемпион мира в восьми весовых категориях в истории бокса, завоевавший двенадцать основных мировых титулов. Наслаждайтесь боксом со всемирно известной звездой бокса Мэнни Пакьяо!

title: Объемная История
desc: Бесплатный игровой проект об истории России!

title: Путешествие по Приморью на воздушном шаре
desc: Совершите увлекательное путешествие на воздушном шаре в Виртуальной реальности вокруг Владивостока и южного Приморья.

title: РУВН Конкурса Перезагрузка
desc: Опыт визуальной новеллы основанный на крипипасте с имиджборд

title: Секретные сокровища фараона
desc: Это захватывающее приключение в стиле рогалик, загадочный лабиринт древних египетских пирамид, и страшные неизвестные монстры будут преградой на вашем пути вперед. Выберите свое любимое оружие, исследуйте древние артефакты и уничтожьте древнее проклятие.

title: Слепое касание VR
desc: Испытай слепоту в VR. Перемещайся по миру тьмы с помощью трости и погрузись в сенсорное путешествие через звук и прикосновение.

title: Туманные источники Misty Onsen
desc: Психологический хоррор от первого лица в японском горном онсэне. Вы — новый смотритель. Чтобы выжить: носите яркую одежду, не сходите с тропы, не отвечайте на голоса, бегите при странном запахе. Соблюдайте правила — иначе не выбраться.

title: からかい上手の高木さんVR 2学期
desc: Virtually experience the playful and relentless teasing of heroine, Takagi-san, in Teasing Master Takagi-san VR - 2nd Semester (Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san VR). Go heads up in poker with Takagi-san, go fishing together, and more!

title: 三国虎将传VR2-Sanguo Warriors VR2
desc: Sanguo Warriors VR2 is the second version of our Sanguo series VR games. Base on the history of three-kingdom, players can fight to the famous warriors lived in 2000 years ago. You must learn how to maximize the attack by using the cold weapon in hand. It has the best picture quality and fighting effect.

title: 夕鬼 零 Yuoni: Rises
desc: "夕鬼 -Yuoni:rises-" is a VR visual novel game where players sit at a desk and relive the characters’ experiences while progressing through the story. The story is set in mid-90s Japan when the Internet was still not widely used and cell phones were owned by a select few adults.

title: 夢獸之島Isles of Monsters
desc: 由臺灣文學館推出的《夢獸之島》，從葉石濤、張深切、龍瑛宗、林海音、姚一葦這五位作家取得靈感，設計成各種不同關卡，為第一人稱射擊VR遊戲。

title: 恐惧深处（Fear deeps）
desc: This is a horror game where the player controls the protagonist (Tom) to go to a mental sanatorium to find Lily, but who knows that there is something weird in the sanatorium! You'll need to explore the sanatorium, find Lily, and uncover the final truth!

title: 无奇刀 Wookie's Blade
desc: Come on, hero! Get the blade and start your legend!

title: 迷禁 Lost in Abyss
desc: Lost in Abyss is a first-person VR horror game about a man trapped in a twisted and terrifying dream. Warm memories and terrible realities are intertwined and tragedy unfolds as you explore a long-forgotten nightmare.
